records.title_en: AI and Our Economic Future
records.title_cn: 人工智能和我们的经济未来
records.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) will likely be the most transformative technology of the modern era. What if machines—AI for cognitive tasks and AI plus advanced robots for physical tasks—can perform every task a human can? This essay makes three main points. First, even though US growth rates have been stable at roughly 2 percent per year for 150 years, it is distinctly possible that automating intelligence leads economic growth rates to accelerate. Second, this acceleration is likely to be slowed by the presence of "weak links." While we each have access to 100 million times more transistors on our desktop computer than people in the 1970s, we are not 100 million times more productive. Computers can invert matrices at lightning speed, but we humans must still decide what matrix to invert, what hypothesis to test, and so on. Accelerating economic growth requires the vast majority of the weak links to be automated away, which delays the large gains. Finally, even though weak links slow the benefits, they may actually speed up the risks. When a chain is only as strong as its weakest link, damaging one link in the chain can be very costly. A powerful AI that is superhuman at software engineering could be misused by a bad actor to do substantial harm by hacking the financial system or a virology lab.
records.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）很可能是现代最具变革性的技术。如果机器——用于认知任务的AI，以及用于物理任务的AI加先进机器人——能够执行人类可以执行的每一项任务，会怎样？本文提出三个主要观点。第一，尽管美国经济增长率在150年间大致稳定在每年2%，自动化智能完全可能使经济增长率加速。第二，这种加速很可能因“薄弱环节”的存在而放缓。虽然我们每个人能够使用的台式计算机晶体管数量，比1970年代的人多100000000倍，但我们的生产率并没有高出100000000倍。计算机可以以闪电般的速度求逆矩阵，但我们人类仍须决定要对哪个矩阵求逆、检验什么假设，等等。加速经济增长需要将绝大多数薄弱环节自动化消除，这会推迟巨大收益的实现。最后，尽管薄弱环节会减缓收益，它们实际上可能加速风险。当一条链的强度取决于最薄弱环节时，破坏链条中的一个环节可能付出高昂代价。一个在软件工程方面超越人类的强大人工智能，可能被恶意行为者滥用，通过入侵金融系统或病毒学实验室造成重大损害。

records.title_en: The Emerging Market for Intelligence: How Firms Buy and Sell AI
records.title_cn: 新兴的人工智能市场：企业如何买卖人工智能
records.abstract_en: We describe the emerging business-to-business market for large language model (LLM) inference and document key empirical patterns in its supply, pricing, and dynamics, using data from OpenRouter. First, supply has expanded rapidly: the number of commercially available models, model creators, and inference providers has grown sharply, driven heavily by open-source entrants. Second, the price of intelligence has fallen roughly a thousandfold, and open-source models now cost about 90 percent less than comparable closed-source ones. Third, the market is highly dynamic, with frequent turnover among leading models and creators. Fourth, we document substantial horizontal and vertical differentiation: no single model dominates across use cases, and demand for intelligence varies widely across applications. We place these patterns in historical perspective alongside earlier general-purpose technologies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用来自 OpenRouter 的数据描述了大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理的新兴企业对企业市场，并记录了其供应、定价和动态方面的关键经验模式。首先，供应迅速扩大：在开源进入者的大力推动下，商业模型、模型创建者和推理提供商的数量急剧增长。其次，情报的价格已经下降了大约一千倍，开源模型的成本现在比同类闭源模型低约 90%。第三，市场活跃度高，领军模特、创作者更替频繁。第四，我们记录了显着的水平和垂直差异：没有单一模型在用例中占主导地位，并且不同应用程序对智能的需求差异很大。我们将这些模式与早期的通用技术放在历史的角度来看。

records.title_en: US Tariff Policy since 1789
records.title_cn: 自1789以来的美国关税政策
records.abstract_en: We use a newly assembled, tariff-line-level dataset spanning the full history of US trade policy to revisit the evolution of tariffs since 1789. We document the institutional shift from Congressional setting to multilateral negotiation, the steady growth in granularity of the tariff code alongside expanding administrative capacity, and the under-appreciated role of specific tariffs, which feature prominently throughout US history and whose ad valorem equivalent moves mechanically with prices. We discuss the implications of this relationship for how we interpret past liberalization episodes and for empirical identification of tariff effects. Finally, we outline how the new data can advance research on the political economy of tariff-setting and on the macroeconomic and distributional consequences of trade policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用新组装的涵盖美国贸易政策完整历史的关税线级别数据集来重新审视自1789以来关税的演变。我们记录了从国会设置到多边谈判的制度转变、关税法规粒度的稳步增长以及行政能力的扩大，以及从量关税的作用被低估，这些关税在美国历史上占据着突出的地位，其从价等价物随着价格机械地变化。我们讨论了这种关系对于我们如何解释过去的自由化事件以及关税效应的实证识别的影响。最后，我们概述了新数据如何推进关税设定的政治经济学以及贸易政策的宏观经济和分配后果的研究。

records.title_en: Labor Market Responses to Tariffs: Frictions, Dynamics, and Policy Responses
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场对关税的反应：摩擦、动态和政策反应
records.abstract_en: This article introduces the evidence and associated modeling frameworks contemporary economists use to understand the effects of trade and trade policy on labor markets, with a particular emphasis on labor-market frictions and adjustment dynamics. The effects of trade shocks differ across industries, regions, and occupations, implying the presence of important adjustment frictions in labor markets, and these effects evolve slowly over time, implying the need for dynamic frameworks rationalizing slow transitions. After reviewing the key insights from this literature, we discuss policies aimed at mitigating costs to workers and ensuring that the gains from trade are shared more equitably.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了当代经济学家用来理解贸易和贸易政策对劳动力市场影响的证据和相关模型框架，特别强调劳动力市场摩擦和调整动态。贸易冲击的影响因行业、地区和职业而异，这意味着劳动力市场存在重要的调整摩擦，而且这些影响随着时间的推移缓慢演变，意味着需要动态框架来合理化缓慢的转型。在回顾了这些文献的主要见解后，我们讨论了旨在降低工人成本并确保更公平地分享贸易收益的政策。

records.title_en: Should We Tax Trade? A Pigouvian Perspective
records.title_cn: 我们应该对贸易征税吗？庇古的观点
records.abstract_en: We develop a simple and intuitive Pigouvian perspective on optimal trade policy. Our approach unifies a wide range of rationales for taxing trade, from the classical optimal tariff argument to contemporary debates about global carbon emissions and geopolitics. We also clarify when trade policy intervention is warranted and when alternative domestic instruments should be used instead.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对最优贸易政策提出了简单直观的庇古观点。我们的方法统一了对贸易征税的广泛理由，从经典的最优关税论点到当代有关全球碳排放和地缘政治的辩论。我们还澄清何时需要进行贸易政策干预以及何时应使用其他国内工具。

records.title_en: The Incidence of Tariffs: Rates and Reality
records.title_cn: 关税的发生率：税率与现实
records.abstract_en: In 2025, statutory tariff rates on US imports rose to levels not seen in over one hundred years. What were the implications for prices? On the one hand, shipping lags, exemptions, and enforcement gaps kept the actual implemented rates at only half of the statutory rates, moderating the tariffs' impact. On the other hand, tariff pass-through to US import prices reached 92 percent, so the United States bore a large share of the costs. We study the incidence of the 2018–2019 and 2025 US tariffs and discuss implications for US sourcing, domestic manufacturing costs, and the dollar.
records.abstract_cn: 2025，美国进口产品的法定关税税率升至一百多年来未见的水平。这对价格有何影响？一方面，运输滞后、豁免和执法差距使实际执行的税率仅为法定税率的一半，减轻了关税的影响。另一方面，关税对美国进口价格的转嫁达到92%，因此美国承担了很大一部分成本。我们研究 2018-2019 和 2025 美国关税的发生率，并讨论对美国采购、国内制造成本和美元的影响。

records.title_en: Global Imbalances, Tariffs, and Industrial Policy
records.title_cn: 全球失衡、关税和产业政策
records.abstract_en: Global imbalances denote the distribution of countries' current account balances, identically equal to the difference between two forward-looking aggregate variables: national saving and domestic investment. Industrial and trade policies have traditionally not been considered important drivers of aggregate saving or investment, and therefore of current account balances. The former because most industrial policies are small in scope; the latter because permanent tariffs have no intertemporal effect in the textbook model, with an offsetting appreciation of the real exchange rate. The rapidly growing use of both industrial and trade policies in recent years calls for a reassessment. This paper presents a framework to think about the role of both policies. For industrial policy, we make the important distinction between the traditional sector-specific policies via subsidies or other targeted instruments ("micro industrial policy") and broader policies ("macro industrial policy") that aim to promote industrial developments and competitiveness through the deployment of more aggregate instruments such as financial repression, foreign reserve accumulation, or capital controls. A key finding is that micro industrial policy tends to increase external balances if it fails to raise aggregate productivity. By contrast, macro industrial policy can, under some conditions, boost the current account, forcing other countries to adjust. Yet, these policies often come at the cost of suppressed domestic consumption and possibly domestic welfare. Our analysis confirms that tariffs are a weak tool to improve current account balances. Finally, traditional macroeconomic drivers—such as fiscal policy, demographics or credit cycles—remain critical drivers of global imbalances, especially for the United States and China.
records.abstract_cn: 全球失衡是指各国经常账户余额的分布，同样等于两个前瞻性总体变量：国民储蓄和国内投资之间的差额。传统上，工业和贸易政策不被视为总储蓄或投资的重要驱动因素，因此也不被视为经常账户余额的重要驱动因素。前者是因为大多数产业政策的范围较小；后者是因为大多数产业政策的范围较小。后者是因为永久关税在教科书模型中没有跨期效应，并会抵消实际汇率的升值。近年来，工业和贸易政策的使用迅速增加，需要重新评估。本文提出了一个思考这两项政策作用的框架。对于产业政策，我们对通过补贴或其他有针对性的工具（“微观产业政策”）的传统特定部门政策（“微观产业政策”）和更广泛的政策（“宏观产业政策”）进行了重要区分，后者旨在通过部署金融抑制、外汇储备积累或资本管制等更多总体工具来促进产业发展和竞争力。一个重要的发现是，如果微观产业政策不能提高总生产率，它往往会增加外部平衡。相比之下，宏观产业政策在某些情况下可以增加经常账户，迫使其他国家进行调整。然而，这些政策往往是以抑制国内消费和可能的国内福利为代价的。我们的分析证实，关税对于改善经常账户余额来说是一个较弱的工具。最后，财政政策、人口结构或信贷周期等传统宏观经济驱动因素仍然是全球失衡的关键驱动因素，尤其是对美国和中国而言。

records.title_en: Evaluating the Fiscal and Distributional Implications of Tariffs
records.title_cn: 评估关税的财政和分配影响
records.abstract_en: The Trump administration has enacted a series of significant taxes on imports, including an across-the-board tariff on nearly all imports. Tariffs are now expected to raise nearly 1 percent of GDP in revenue. Given tariffs' growing importance as a source of revenue, it is important to understand their implications for federal finances and the wellbeing of households. This paper describes and reviews current revenue and distributional analyses of tariffs.
records.abstract_cn: 特朗普政府对进口产品征收了一系列重大税款，包括对几乎所有进口产品征收全面关税。目前预计关税将增加近 1% 的 GDP 收入。鉴于关税作为收入来源的重要性日益增加，了解其对联邦财政和家庭福祉的影响非常重要。本文描述并回顾了当前的收入和关税分配分析。

records.title_en: Correct (and Incorrect) Inference with a Single Instrumental Variable: Practical Takeaways from the Weak Instruments Literature
records.title_cn: 使用单个工具变量进行正确（和不正确）的推断：弱工具文献的实用要点
records.abstract_en: Most empirical economists have encountered the warning that instrumental variables can be "weak," but the underlying issues—what makes an instrument weak, why weakness distorts inference, and what to do about it—are less widely understood. This article offers an accessible introduction to the weak instruments problem for the common just-identified case of a single endogenous regressor and a single instrument. We explain why the usual two-stage least squares t -ratio and its "±1.96 times the standard error" confidence interval can yield incorrect inferences, much as homoskedasticity-only standard errors do when errors are not homoskedastic. We then describe practical, robust-to-weak-instrument solutions—including the Anderson-Rubin and tF methods—that deliver valid confidence intervals whatever the instrument's true strength, and we offer some do's and don'ts, notably why the popular " F greater than 10" rule has no theoretical justification in this setting.
records.abstract_cn: 大多数实证经济学家都遇到过工具变量可能“弱”的警告，但根本问题——是什么导致工具弱，为什么弱会扭曲推论，以及如何应对——却不太被广泛理解。本文针对刚刚确定的单个内生回归量和单个工具的常见情况，对弱工具问题进行了简单易懂的介绍。我们解释了为什么通常的两阶段最小二乘 t 比及其“±1.96 乘以标准误差”置信区间可能会产生错误的推论，就像当误差不是同方差时仅同方差的标准误差一样。然后，我们描述实用的、稳健到弱的仪器解决方案（包括 Anderson-Rubin 和 tF 方法），无论仪器的真实强度如何，它们都能提供有效的置信区间，并且我们提供了一些注意事项，特别是为什么流行的“F 大于 10”规则在这种情况下没有理论依据。

records.title_en: Leniency Designs: An Operator's Manual
records.title_cn: 宽大设计：操作员手册
records.abstract_en: We develop a step-by-step guide to leniency (a.k.a. judge or examiner instrument) designs, drawing on recent econometric literatures. The unbiased jackknife instrumental variables estimator (UJIVE) is purpose-built for leveraging exogenous leniency variation, avoiding subtle biases even in the presence of many decision-makers or controls. We show how UJIVE can also be used to assess key assumptions underlying leniency designs, including quasi-random assignment and average first-stage monotonicity, and to probe the external validity of treatment effect estimates. We further discuss statistical inference, arguing that non-clustered standard errors are often appropriate. A reanalysis of Farre-Mensa et al. (2020), using quasi-random examiner assignment to estimate the value of patents to startups, illustrates our checklist.
records.abstract_cn: 我们借鉴最近的计量经济学文献，制定了宽大处理（又称法官或审查员工具）设计的分步指南。无偏折刀工具变量估计器 (UJIVE) 是专门为利用外生宽大变异而构建的，即使在存在许多决策者或控制的情况下也能避免细微的偏差。我们展示了如何使用 UJIVE 来评估宽大设计背后的关键假设，包括准随机分配和平均第一阶段单调性，并探讨治疗效果估计的外部有效性。我们进一步讨论统计推断，认为非聚集标准误差通常是合适的。 Farre-Mensa 等人的重新分析。 （2020）使用准随机审查员分配来估计专利对初创企业的价值，说明了我们的清单。

records.title_en: Stefanie Stantcheva, 2025 Clark Medalist
records.title_cn: 斯蒂芬妮·斯坦切娃 (Stefanie Stantcheva)，2025 克拉克奖章获得者
records.abstract_en: The American Economic Association awarded the 2025 John Bates Clark Medal to Stefanie Stantcheva of Harvard University. Her research ranges widely in the field of public economics. It includes theoretical contributions to optimal income taxation, empirical contributions to the study of how income tax rates across countries and states affect the mobility of inventors and the level of innovation, and contributions in the development and execution of on-line surveys to measure respondents' beliefs about economic primitives, such as the distribution of income or the rate of inflation, and the way these beliefs influence policy preferences. She has demonstrated that randomized controlled trials can be embedded within on-line surveys and used to the way informational interventions and other treatments affect economic beliefs and policy preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 美国经济协会将2025约翰·贝茨·克拉克奖章授予哈佛大学的斯蒂芬妮·斯坦切娃。她的研究广泛涉及公共经济学领域。它包括对最佳所得税的理论贡献，对研究不同国家和州的所得税税率如何影响发明者流动性和创新水平的实证贡献，以及对开发和执行在线调查的贡献，以衡量受访者对经济原语的信念，例如收入分配或通货膨胀率，以及这些信念影响政策偏好的方式。她证明，随机对照试验可以嵌入在线调查中，并用于研究信息干预和其他治疗方法影响经济信念和政策偏好的方式。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Imposing Policy on Reluctant Actors: The Hospital Desegregation Campaign and Black Postneonatal Mortality in the Deep South
records.title_cn: 对不情愿行为者施加政策：医院去种族隔离运动与深南部黑人产后新生儿死亡率
records.abstract_en: In 1966, Southern hospitals were barred from participating in Medicare unless they discontinued their longstanding practice of racial segregation. Using data from five Deep South states and exploiting county-level variation in Medicare certification dates, we find that gaining access to an ostensibly integrated hospital had no effect on Black postneonatal mortality. Similarly, there is little evidence that the campaign contributed to the trend toward in-hospital births among Southern Black mothers. These results are consistent with descriptions of the hospital desegregation campaign as producing only cosmetic changes and illustrate the limits of antidiscrimination policies imposed on reluctant actors.
records.abstract_cn: 在1966，南方医院被禁止参与Medicare，除非它们停止长期存在的种族隔离做法。使用来自五个深南部州的数据，并利用Medicare认证日期在县一级的差异，我们发现获得进入一家表面上整合的医院的机会对黑人产后新生儿死亡率没有影响。同样，几乎没有证据表明该运动促进了南方黑人母亲住院分娩的趋势。这些结果与将医院去种族隔离运动描述为只产生表面变化的说法一致，并说明了对不情愿行为者施加反歧视政策的局限。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: The Summer Drop in Female Employment
records.title_cn: 女性夏季就业下降
records.abstract_en: We provide the first systematic account of summer declines in women’s labor market activity. From May to July, U.S. women’s employment-to-population ratio declines 1.1 p.p., whereas men’s rises; women’s hours worked fall 9.8%, twice the decline among men. School closures for summer break provide a unifying explanation. The summer drop aligns with cross-state differences in school closure timing, is concentrated among mothers with young school-aged children, and coincides with increased time spent on child care. Gender differences both within and across jobs explain gender gaps in summer exits from employment. Women’s summer work interruptions contribute to gender gaps in pay.
records.abstract_cn: 我们首次系统梳理了女性劳动力市场活动在夏季下降的现象。从5月到7月，美国女性的就业人口比下降1.1个百分点，而男性的就业人口比上升；女性工作时长下降9.8%，降幅是男性的两倍。学校暑期放假为这些变化提供了统一解释。夏季下降的时间与各州暑期放假时间的差异相吻合，主要集中于有年幼学龄子女的母亲群体，同时伴随着儿童照料时间的增加。同一岗位内部及不同岗位之间的性别差异共同解释了夏季退出就业的性别差距。女性在夏季的工作中断加剧了薪酬方面的性别差距。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: What Lies Behind the Returns to Schooling: The Role of Labor Market Sorting and Worker Heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 教育回报背后是什么：劳动力市场排序与工人异质性的作用
records.abstract_en: Do more educated workers earn higher wages partly because they have access to high-paying firms and occupations? We rely on linked employer-employee data to combine the estimation of AKM (Abowd-Kramarz-Margolis) models with the decomposition of the returns to schooling. We exploit exogenous variation in education driven by changes in compulsory education. We show that education provides access to better-paying workplaces and occupations: 30% of the overall return to education operates through the workplace channel and 12% through the occupation channel. The remainder is associated exclusively with the individual. Match quality plays a modest role in the returns to education.
records.abstract_cn: 受教育程度更高的工人工资更高，是否部分因为他们能够进入高薪企业和高薪职业？我们利用关联雇主-雇员数据，将AKM（Abowd-Kramarz-Margolis）模型的估计与教育回报的分解相结合。我们利用义务教育变化所驱动的教育外生变动。我们表明，教育提供了进入薪酬更高的工作场所和职业的机会：总体教育回报中30%通过工作场所渠道实现，12%通过职业渠道实现。其余部分则完全与个人相关。匹配质量在教育回报中发挥的作用不大。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Misperceived Social Norms and Willingness to Act Against Climate Change
records.title_cn: 被误解的社会规范与应对气候变化的意愿
records.abstract_en: We document the individual willingness to act against climate change and study the role of social norms in a large sample of U.S. adults. Individual beliefs about social norms positively predict pro-climate donations, comparable in strength to universal moral values and economic preferences. However, we document systematic misperceptions of social norms. Respondents vastly underestimate the prevalence of climate-friendly behaviors and norms. Correcting these misperceptions in an experiment causally raises individual willingness to act against climate change and individual support for climate policies. The effects are strongest for individuals who are skeptical about the existence and threat of global warming.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个美国成年人的大样本中记录了个人应对气候变化的意愿，并研究了社会规范的作用。个人关于社会规范的信念正向预测亲气候捐赠，其强度与普遍道德价值观和经济偏好相当。然而，我们记录了社会规范的系统性误解。受访者极大地低估了气候友好行为和规范的普遍性。在一项实验中纠正这些误解，因果性地提高了个人应对气候变化的意愿和个人对气候政策的支持。对于怀疑全球变暖的存在和威胁的个体，这些效应最强。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Regulation by Reputation? Intermediaries, Labor Abuses, and International Migration
records.title_cn: 声誉监管？中介、劳动虐待与国际移民
records.abstract_en: Migrant workers and employers rely on intermediaries to facilitate labor market placements. If information frictions obscure their reputation, however, intermediaries may underinvest in placement quality. Using data on more than 1.5 million Sri Lankan migrants to the Gulf region, we examine the effects of a government-run intermediary rating program that publicly revealed ratings two years after it was announced. Prior to the ratings’ public release, underperforming intermediaries invest in the rating criteria and place migrants in less abusive and more remunerative employment. Our results suggest the government’s threat of quality revelation induced intermediaries to prospectively screen employers and improve placement quality.
records.abstract_cn: 移民工人和雇主依赖中介来促进劳动力市场配置。然而，如果信息摩擦使中介的声誉不为人知，中介可能对安置质量投资不足。利用超过1.5百万斯里兰卡移民到海湾地区的数据，我们考察了一项政府运营的中介评级计划的效果，该计划在宣布两年后公开披露评级。在评级公开披露之前，表现不佳的中介会投资于评级标准，并将移民安置到虐待更少且报酬更高的工作中。我们的结果表明，政府威胁披露质量促使中介前瞻性地筛选雇主并提高安置质量。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: No Line Left Behind: Assortative Matching Inside the Firm
records.title_cn: 不落下一行：企业内部的匹配选择
records.abstract_en: We leverage the high degree of worker mobility across production lines in a large Indian manufacturer to estimate the sorting of workers to managers, using data on daily worker productivity. We find negative assortative matching (NAM): better workers tend to be matched with worse managers. Estimates of the production technology, however, reveal that productivity would increase by up to 4% under positive sorting. Exploiting a survey of managers and data on orders from multinational brands, we document that NAM arises, at least partly, because maintaining valuable relationships with buyers provides strong incentives to avoid delays on any given production line.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一家大型印度制造商中生产线上工人高度流动的特点，使用工人日生产率数据来估计工人对管理者的分类匹配。我们发现负向匹配（NAM）：更好的工人往往与更差的管理者匹配。然而，对生产技术的估计显示，在正向匹配下，生产率将提高多达4%。利用对管理者的调查和来自跨国品牌的订单数据，我们记录到，NAM的出现至少部分是因为与买家保持有价值的关系提供了强烈激励，以避免任何给定生产线上的延误。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Social Preferences and Redistributive Politics
records.title_cn: 社会偏好与再分配政治
records.abstract_en: We study the link between social preferences and a behaviorally validated measure of support for redistribution. We uncover three fundamentally distinct social preference types: predominantly selfish, inequality averse, and altruistic individuals. Inequality averse and altruistic individuals display a much stronger support for redistribution, particularly if they are more affluent. Beliefs about the role of effort and luck for success play no role for selfish individuals but are highly relevant for other-regarding individuals. Finally, while inequality averse individuals display strong support for policies aimed at reducing the incomes of the rich, altruistic individuals are considerably less supportive of these policies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了社会偏好与一种经过行为验证的再分配支持度衡量指标之间的联系。我们发现了三种根本不同的社会偏好类型：以自利为主、不平等厌恶和利他主义个体。不平等厌恶和利他主义个体对再分配表现出强得多的支持，尤其是当他们更为富裕时。关于努力和运气对成功作用的信念对自利个体不起作用，但对顾及他人的个体高度相关。最后，虽然不平等厌恶个体对旨在降低富人收入的政策表现出强烈支持，但利他主义个体对这些政策的支持要低得多。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Language Barriers in Multinationals and Knowledge Transfers
records.title_cn: 跨国公司中的语言障碍与知识转移
records.abstract_en: We study communication frictions within multinationals (MNCs), hypothesizing that language barriers reduce management knowledge transfers within the organization. A distinct feature of such MNCs is a three-tier hierarchy: foreign managers (FMs) supervise domestic managers (DMs) who supervise production workers. Tailored surveys from our setting—MNCs in Myanmar—reveal that language barriers impede interactions between FMs and DMs. A first experimental protocol offers DMs free English courses and confirms that lowering communications costs increases their interactions with FMs. A second experimental protocol that asks human-resource managers at domestic firms to rate hypothetical resumes reveals that multinational experience and, specifically, DM-FM interactions are valued in the domestic labor market. Together, these results suggest that reducing language barriers can improve transfers of management knowledge, an interpretation supported by improvements in soft skills among treatment DMs in the first experiment. A model in which communication within MNCs is noncontractible—a realistic feature of workplace life—reveals that the experimental results are consistent with underinvestment in language training and provide a rationale for policy intervention.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究跨国公司（MNCs）内部的沟通摩擦，假设语言障碍会减少组织内部的管理知识转移。此类跨国公司的一个显著特征是三层等级结构：外国经理（FMs）监督本国经理（DMs），本国经理再监督生产工人。我们在缅甸的跨国公司环境中进行的定制调查显示，语言障碍阻碍了FMs与DMs之间的互动。第一个实验方案向DMs提供免费英语课程，并证实降低沟通成本会增加他们与FMs的互动。第二个实验方案要求本国企业的人力资源经理对假设的简历进行评分，结果显示，跨国公司经历，特别是DM-FM互动，在本国劳动力市场中受到重视。综合来看，这些结果表明，减少语言障碍可以改善管理知识的转移，这一解释得到了第一个实验中处理组DMs软技能提升的支持。一个将跨国公司内部沟通视为不可契约的模型——这是职场生活的一个现实特征——表明实验结果与语言培训投资不足相一致，并为政策干预提供了依据。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Disentangling the Effects of the 2018–2019 Tariffs on a Globally Connected U.S. Manufacturing Sector
records.title_cn: 解析2018-2019关税对全球关联的美国制造业部门的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the relationship between the U.S. tariff increases of 2018–2019 and outcomes in domestic manufacturing. Despite being intended to boost manufacturing activity, we find U.S. industries more exposed to tariff increases experience relative reductions in employment, as a small positive effect from import protection is offset by larger negative effects from rising input costs and retaliatory tariffs. Higher tariffs are also associated with relative increases in producer prices due to rising input costs. Last, we document broader labor market impacts, as counties more exposed to rising tariffs exhibit relative increases in unemployment and declines in labor force participation. No rights reserved. This work was authored as part of the Contributor's official duties as an Employee of the United States Government and is therefore a work of the United States Government. In accordance with 17 U.S.C. 105, no copyright protection is available for such works under U.S. Law.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了2018-2019美国关税上调与国内制造业结果之间的关系。尽管旨在提振制造业活动，我们发现受关税上调影响更大的美国行业经历了相对就业减少，因为进口保护带来的小幅正向效应被投入成本上升和报复性关税带来的更大负向效应所抵消。更高的关税还与投入成本上升导致的生产者价格相对上涨相关。最后，我们记录了更广泛的劳动力市场影响，因为受关税上升影响更大的县表现出失业率相对上升和劳动力参与率下降。无权利保留。本作品是作为美国政府雇员作者的官方职责的一部分创作的，因此是美国政府的作品。根据17 U.S.C. 105，此类作品在美国法律下不享有版权保护。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Immigration and Worker-Firm Matching
records.title_cn: 移民与工人-企业匹配
records.abstract_en: Positive assortative matching increases both the wages of more productive workers and wage dispersion. We study the effect of immigration on positive assortative matching using French employer-employee data from 1995 to 2005. We find that increases in the share of immigrants, driven by historical networks across local labor markets, generated stronger positive assortative matching between workers and firms. We present evidence suggesting that this effect was associated with higher wages for more productive workers and that the findings are consistent with increased workers’ screening by firms.
records.abstract_cn: 正向 assortative matching 同时提高生产率更高工人的工资和工资离散度。我们使用 1995 至 2005 的法国雇主-雇员数据研究移民对正向 assortative matching 的影响。我们发现，由本地劳动力市场历史网络驱动的移民份额增加，在工人与企业之间产生了更强的正向 assortative matching。我们提供的证据表明，这一效应与生产率更高工人工资更高相关，并且这些发现与企业对工人筛选增强相一致。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Asymptotics of Cointegration Tests for High-Dimensional Var(⁠ 𝑘 ⁠)
records.title_cn: 高维VAR(⁠𝑘⁠)协整检验的渐近性质
records.abstract_en: The paper studies nonstationary high-dimensional vector autoregressions of order ⁠ , VAR( ⁠ ⁠ ). Additional deterministic terms such as trend or seasonality are allowed. The number of time periods, ⁠ , and the number of coordinates, ⁠ , are assumed to be large and of the same order. Under this regime the first-order asymptotics of the Johansen likelihood ratio (LR), Pillai-Bartlett, and Hotelling-Lawley tests for cointegration are derived: The test statistics converge to nonrandom integrals. For more refined analysis, the paper proposes and analyzes a modification of the Johansen test. The new test for the absence of cointegration converges to the partial sum of the Airy point process. Supporting Monte Carlo simulations indicate that the same behavior persists universally in many situations beyond those considered in our theorems. The paper presents empirical implementations of the approach for the analysis of S&P100 stocks and of cryptocurrencies. The latter example has a strong presence of multiple cointegrating relationships, while the results for the former are consistent with the null of no cointegration.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究阶数为⁠、VAR(⁠⁠)的非平稳高维向量自回归。允许趋势或季节性等附加确定性项。时间期数⁠和坐标数⁠被假定为很大且同阶。在此机制下，推导了Johansen似然比（LR）、Pillai-Bartlett和Hotelling-Lawley协整检验的一阶渐近性质：检验统计量收敛于非随机积分。为进行更精细的分析，本文提出并分析了一种Johansen检验的修正。新的无协整检验收敛于Airy点过程的部分和。支持性Monte Carlo模拟表明，相同行为在许多超出我们定理所考虑的情形中普遍持续存在。本文给出了该方法在S&P100股票和加密货币分析中的实证应用。后一个例子存在强烈的多重协整关系，而前者的结果与无协整的原假设一致。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: A Fundamental Connection: Exchange Rates and Macroeconomic Expectations
records.title_cn: 一个根本性联系：汇率与宏观经济预期
records.abstract_en: We disprove the exchange rate macroeconomic disconnect puzzle by showing that macroeconomic news can explain most variation in exchange rates at monthly and quarterly frequencies, accounting for up to 91% of the quarterly exchange rate variation during U.S. recessions and 65% over all periods. The main driver of the reconnect is exchange rates responding to past news—a result inconsistent with the theory of uncovered interest rate parity under full information rational expectations (UIP-FIRE). We discuss theoretical models that can explain this surprising result, including models featuring currency risk premia, regulatory or institutional frictions, or deviation from FIRE.
records.abstract_cn: 我们否定了汇率宏观经济脱节之谜，表明宏观经济新闻可以解释月度与季度频率下汇率的大部分变动，在美国衰退期间可解释高达91%的季度汇率变动，在所有时期可解释65%。重新连接的主要驱动因素是汇率对过去新闻的反应——这一结果与完全信息理性预期下的无抛补利率平价理论（UIP-FIRE）不一致。我们讨论了能够解释这一惊人结果的理论模型，包括具有货币风险溢价、监管或制度摩擦，或偏离FIRE特征的模型。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Coarse Wage Setting and Behavioral Firms
records.title_cn: 粗放式工资设定与行为型企业
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that the bunching of wages at round numbers is partly driven by firm coarse wage setting. Using data from more than 200 million new hires in Brazil, I first establish that contracted salaries tend to cluster at round numbers. Then, I show that firms that tend to hire workers at round-numbered salaries have worse market outcomes. Next, I develop a wage-posting model in which optimization costs lead to the adoption of coarse rounded wages and provide evidence supporting two model predictions using two research designs. Finally, I examine some consequences of coarse wage setting for relevant economic outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，工资在整数金额上的聚集部分是由企业的粗放式工资设定驱动的。使用来自巴西超过200百万新雇员的数据，我首先确认合同工资往往聚集在整数金额上。然后，我表明倾向于以整数金额工资雇佣工人的企业市场表现更差。接下来，我构建了一个工资发布模型，其中优化成本导致采用粗略取整的工资，并使用两种研究设计提供了支持两个模型预测的证据。最后，我考察了粗放式工资设定对相关经济结果的一些影响。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Time Use and Macroeconomic Uncertainty
records.title_cn: 时间利用与宏观经济不确定性
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of uncertainty on time use and their macroeconomic implications. Employing data from the American Time Use Survey and the Bureau of Labor Statistics, we document that heightened uncertainty increases housework and reduces market hours, mildly impacting leisure. We then propose a model that quantitatively accounts for these estimates. We show that substitution between market and housework provides self-insurance to households, weakening precautionary motives. However, it also reduces aggregate demand, ultimately amplifying uncertainty’s recessionary impact. Time reallocation can lead to higher inflation, particularly when uncertainty is coupled with policies redirecting time use towards housework (e.g., lockdown restrictions).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究不确定性对时间利用的影响及其宏观经济含义。利用美国时间使用调查和劳工统计局的数据，我们记录到不确定性加剧会增加家务劳动并减少市场工作时间，对闲暇的影响轻微。随后，我们提出一个模型，该模型在数量上解释了这些估计结果。我们表明，市场工作与家务劳动之间的替代为家庭提供了自我保险，削弱了预防性动机。然而，它也减少了总需求，最终放大了不确定性的衰退影响。时间重新配置可能导致更高的通胀，尤其是当不确定性与将时间利用转向家务劳动的政策（例如封锁限制）相结合时。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: The Long-Run Effects of Monetary Policy
records.title_cn: 货币政策的长期效应
records.abstract_en: We document that the real effects of monetary shocks last for over a decade. Our approach relies on identification of exogenous and nonsystematic monetary shocks using the trilemma of international finance; merged data from two new international historical cross-country databases; and econometric methods robust to long-horizon inconsistent estimates. Notably, the capital stock and total factor productivity (TFP) exhibit greater hysteresis than labor. When we allow for asymmetry, we find these effects with tightening shocks, but not with loosening shocks. When extending the horizon of the responses reported in several recent studies that use alternative monetary shocks, we find similarly persistent real effects, thus supporting our main findings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录到货币冲击的实际效应持续超过十年。我们的方法依赖于利用国际金融三难困境识别外生且非系统性的货币冲击；合并来自两个新的国际历史跨国数据库的数据；以及对长期不一致估计具有稳健性的计量经济学方法。值得注意的是，资本存量和全要素生产率（TFP）表现出比劳动更大的滞后效应。当我们允许不对称性时，我们发现这些效应在紧缩冲击下存在，但在宽松冲击下不存在。当我们将几项近期使用替代货币冲击的研究中报告的响应期限延长时，我们发现同样持久的实际效应，从而支持我们的主要发现。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: The Unobserved Returns to Entrepreneurship
records.title_cn: 创业的未观测回报
records.abstract_en: This paper presents an alternative perspective to a long-standing empirical puzzle: that most entrepreneurs persevere despite persistently low earnings. Because entrepreneurial earnings are notoriously difficult to measure, I approach the question from an expenditure angle. I look at how switching into self-employment corresponds to changes in reported earnings versus expenditure. Using 45 years of longitudinal data, I find that individuals report earning 27.7% _less_ in self-employment, while spending 3.8% _more_ . This household expenditure premium accrues with entrepreneurial experience and is not offset by lower savings or longer work hours. The results hold in highly educated and incorporated business owner subsamples.
records.abstract_cn: 本文对一个长期存在的经验谜题提出了另一种视角：即大多数创业者尽管收入持续偏低却仍坚持创业。由于创业收入以难以衡量著称，我从支出角度切入这一问题。我考察了转入自雇状态如何对应于所报告的收益与支出的变化。利用45年的纵向数据，我发现个人报告在自雇状态下收入27.7%_更少_，而支出3.8%_更多_。这种家庭支出溢价随创业经验而累积，且未被更低的储蓄或更长的工作时间所抵消。该结果在受过高等教育和注册企业主子样本中依然成立。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Universal Basic Income: Inspecting the Mechanisms
records.title_cn: 全民基本收入：机制考察
records.abstract_en: We examine the mechanisms driving the aggregate and distributional impacts of Universal Basic Income (UBI) through model analysis of various UBI programs and financing schemes. The main adverse effect is the distortionary tax increase to fund UBI, reducing labor force participation. Secondary channels are a decline in demand for self-insurance, depressing aggregate capital, and a positive income effect that further deters labor force participation. Due to these channels, introducing UBI alongside existing social programs reduces output and average welfare. Partially substituting existing programs with UBI mitigates the adverse effects, increases average welfare, but does not deliver a Pareto improvement.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过对各种全民基本收入（UBI）方案和融资计划的模型分析，考察驱动全民基本收入（UBI）总体影响和分配影响的机制。主要不利影响是为全民基本收入融资而增税造成的扭曲，降低了劳动力参与率。次要渠道是自我保险需求下降，压低总资本，以及进一步阻碍劳动力参与的正面收入效应。由于这些渠道，在现有社会计划之外引入全民基本收入会降低产出和平均福利。用全民基本收入部分替代现有计划可减轻不利影响，提高平均福利，但不会带来帕累托改进。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: When Nurses Travel: Labor Supply Responses to Peak Demand for Nurses
records.title_cn: 当护士出行：护士峰值需求的劳动供给反应
records.abstract_en: We study how a market uses temporary workers to accommodate extraordinary demand shocks. When COVID-19 surges, hospitals need additional nurses—especially in specialties central to COVID-19 care. By comparing markets for COVID-relevant and other specialties, we show that the market for travel nurses expands dramatically, and we estimate travel nurse labor supply across space. Supply is quite elastic, as workers can choose to travel where they are needed. Workers travel longer distances to temporary jobs when payment increases, suggesting that an integrated national market facilitates reallocation when demand spikes. But when national cases peak, travel distance is less responsive to local demand.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究市场如何利用临时工来应对异常的需求冲击。当COVID-19激增时，医院需要额外的护士——尤其是在COVID-19护理核心的专业领域。通过比较COVID相关专业与其他专业的市场，我们表明旅行护士市场急剧扩张，并估计了旅行护士在空间上的劳动供给。供给相当富有弹性，因为工人可以选择前往需要他们的地方。当报酬增加时，工人会为临时工作走更远的距离，这表明一个一体化的全国市场在需求激增时促进了重新配置。但当全国病例达到峰值时，旅行距离对当地需求的反应减弱。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Estimating Nursing Home Quality with Selection
records.title_cn: 估计存在选择时的养老院质量
records.abstract_en: We use variational inference (VI), a technique from the machine learning literature, to estimate a mortality-based Bayesian model of nursing home quality accounting for selection. We demonstrate how one can use VI to quickly and flexibly estimate a high-dimensional economic model with large datasets. Using our facility quality estimates, we examine the correlates of quality and find that public report cards have near-zero correlation. We then show that in contrast to prior literature, higher-quality nursing homes fared better during the pandemic: a one standard deviation increase in quality corresponds to 2.5% fewer COVID-19 cases.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用变分推断（VI），一种来自机器学习文献的技术，来估计一个基于死亡率的贝叶斯养老院质量模型，并考虑选择问题。我们展示了如何使用VI快速灵活地估计具有大型数据集的高维经济模型。利用我们的设施质量估计，我们考察了质量的相关因素，发现公共报告卡的相关性几乎为零。然后我们表明，与先前文献相反，高质量的养老院在疫情期间表现更好：质量提高一个标准差对应于2.5%更少的COVID-19病例。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Raising State Minimum Wages, Lowering Community College Enrollment
records.title_cn: 提高州最低工资，降低社区大学入学率
records.abstract_en: Changes in the minimum wage may impact college enrollment and educational attainment. Using institutional data on college enrollment and program completion, we find that enrollment falls markedly among students at public two-year institutions in response to increases in the minimum wage. The largest enrollment effects are seen for those students who are enrolled part-time at community colleges. We find little evidence of negative effects on the attainment of certificates or degrees, suggesting that increases in the minimum wage are unlikely to divert students from degree attainment.
records.abstract_cn: 最低工资的变化可能影响大学入学率和教育程度。利用关于大学入学率和项目完成情况的机构数据，我们发现，面对最低工资的提高，公立两年制院校的学生入学率显著下降。入学率效应最大的是那些在社区大学非全日制入学的学生。我们几乎没有发现对证书或学位获得产生负面影响的证据，这表明最低工资的提高不太可能使学生偏离学位获得。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Misspecified Exponential Regressions: Estimation, Interpretation, and Average Marginal Effects
records.title_cn: 误设的指数回归：估计、解释与平均边际效应
records.abstract_en: Exponential regressions are frequently used when outcomes are non-negative. They are attractive because they are easy to interpret and to estimate, using pseudomaximum likelihood (PML). However, the validity of these methods depends on the correct specification of the conditional expectation, and little is known regarding their properties when the conditional expectation is misspecified. We show that PML estimators of misspecified exponential models provide optimal approximations to the conditional expectation, in a weighted mean squared error sense, and we give conditions under which their Poisson PML estimator identifies average marginal effects.
records.abstract_cn: 当结果变量非负时，指数回归常被使用。它们之所以有吸引力，是因为易于解释和估计，可采用伪极大似然（PML）。然而，这些方法的有效性取决于条件期望的正确设定，而当条件期望被误设时，关于其性质所知甚少。我们表明，误设指数模型的PML估计量在加权均方误差意义下提供了对条件期望的最优近似，并给出了其泊松PML估计量识别平均边际效应的条件。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: A Comment on “Raising Health Awareness in Rural Communities: A Randomized Experiment in Bangladesh and India” by Siddique et al. (2024)
records.title_cn: 对Siddique等人（2024）《提高农村社区的健康意识：在孟加拉国和印度的一项随机实验》的评论
records.abstract_en: Siddique et al. ( 2024 ) report large effects of a mobile phone-based health awareness campaign in a field experiment conducted in rural Bangladesh and India during the COVID-19 pandemic. Treatments are stated as being randomized at the village level in the Bangladesh arm, but analyses of available replication materials from this and related field experiments show that this was not the case: participants retained their treatment group assignment from two earlier studies run by the same NGO. Because these earlier studies reported large and persistent treatment effects, the treatment groups in Siddique et al. ( 2024 ) could plausibly differ systematically, raising issues of confounding and interaction effects that invalidate the analyses and interpretations of this study, affecting both internal and external validity.
records.abstract_cn: Siddique等人（2024）报告了在COVID-19疫情期间于孟加拉国和印度农村进行的一项实地实验中，基于手机的健康意识宣传活动产生了巨大效果。文中称在孟加拉国分支中处理是在村庄层面随机化的，但对来自该实验及相关实地实验的可用复制材料的分析表明，情况并非如此：参与者保留了由同一非政府组织运行的两项早期研究中的处理组分配。由于这些早期研究报告了巨大且持续的处理效应，Siddique等人（2024）中的处理组可能存在系统性差异，引发了混杂和交互效应的问题，使本研究的分析和解释无效，影响了内部效度和外部效度。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Response to the Comment on “Raising Health Awareness in Rural Communities: A Randomized Experiment in Bangladesh and India” (Siddique et al., 2024)
records.title_cn: 对《提高孟加拉国与印度农村社区健康认知的随机试验》评论的回应（Siddique 等，2024）

records.title_en: Markups Across Space and Time
records.title_cn: 跨空间与时间的加成率
records.abstract_en: In this article, we provide direct evidence on the behaviour of markups in the retail sector across space and time. Markups are measured using gross margins. We consider three levels of aggregation: the retail sector as a whole, the firm, and the product level. We find that: (1) markups are relatively stable over time and mildly procyclical; (2) there is a large regional dispersion in markups; (3) there is a positive cross-sectional correlation between local income and local markups; and (4) differences in markups across regions result from differences in the assortment of goods sold in different regions, not from deviations from uniform pricing. We propose a simple model consistent with these facts.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提供了关于零售部门加成率在空间和时间上行为的直接证据。加成率使用毛利率来衡量。我们考虑三个层次的加总：整个零售部门、企业和产品层面。我们发现：(1) 加成率随时间相对稳定，并具有温和的顺周期性；(2) 加成率存在较大的区域差异；(3) 当地收入与当地加成率之间存在正向的横截面相关性；以及 (4) 不同区域间加成率的差异源于不同区域销售的商品种类差异，而非偏离统一定价。我们提出了一个与这些事实一致的简单模型。

records.title_en: The Macroeconomics of Irreversibility
records.title_cn: 不可逆性的宏观经济学
records.abstract_en: We study aggregate capital dynamics in an investment model with idiosyncratic productivity shocks, fixed capital adjustment costs, and irreversibility driven by a wedge between capital purchase and resale prices. We derive sufficient statistics that capture the role of investment frictions in aggregate capital fluctuations, measure these statistics using investment microdata, and exploit them to discipline the capital price wedge. Irreversibility doubles the persistence of capital fluctuations and is crucial for reconciling micro-level investment behaviour with macroeconomic propagation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个投资模型中的总体资本动态，该模型包含异质性生产率冲击、固定资本调整成本以及由资本购买价格与转售价格之间的楔子驱动的不可逆性。我们推导出捕捉投资摩擦在总体资本波动中作用的充分统计量，使用投资微观数据测量这些统计量，并利用它们来约束资本价格楔子。不可逆性使资本波动的持续性加倍，并且对于调和微观层面的投资行为与宏观经济传导至关重要。

records.title_en: Patent Term, Innovation, and the Role of Technology Disclosure Externalities
records.title_cn: 专利期限、创新与技术披露外部性的作用
records.abstract_en: I examine the impact of patent term on R&D and innovation in the presence of policy anticipation, common in real-world settings. Using a difference-in-difference design, I exploit quasi-experimental variation in US patent term across technological fields due to the ratification of TRIPs agreements in 1995. Despite a general increase in average patent term, in most fields innovators faced a considerable probability of patent term reduction for future innovations. Three key findings emerge: (1) R&D and innovation accelerate more in fields with a higher probability of patent term reduction, i.e. a shorter average patent term extension, before implementation. (2) This heightened activity persists for at least 5 years postimplementation, driven by indirect effects where the news-related acceleration fosters further innovation through technological externalities linked to cumulative knowledge creation. (3) Conversely, the direct effect of a shorter extension in patent term would stimulate relatively less innovation, absent the indirect effects of anticipation.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了在政策预期存在的情况下（这在现实世界中很常见），专利期限对研发和创新的影响。利用双重差分设计，我利用了因TRIPs协议在1995年批准而导致的美国各技术领域专利期限的准实验性变化。尽管平均专利期限普遍延长，但在大多数领域，创新者面临着相当大的未来创新专利期限缩短的可能性。出现了三个关键发现：（1）在实施前，专利期限缩短概率较高（即平均专利期限延长较短）的领域，研发和创新加速更多。（2）这种增强的活动在实施后至少持续5年，这是由间接效应驱动的，其中与新闻相关的加速通过累积知识创造相关的技术外部性促进了进一步的创新。（3）相反，如果没有预期的间接效应，专利期限缩短的直接效应将刺激相对较少的创新。

records.title_en: Diversification, Market Entry, and the Global Internet Backbone
records.title_cn: 多元化、市场进入与全球互联网骨干网
records.abstract_en: In many industries, buyers diversify their supplier base to manage supplier disruption risk. We investigate the importance of such diversification as a determinant of demand and supplier entry in the context of the internet backbone, the worldwide network of undersea fibre-optic cables that underpins the internet. We specify a model of international bandwidth demand and cable operators’ dynamic entry and supply choices. The model is estimated using novel data on cross-border data flows, prices, cable characteristics, and disruptions. Counterfactual analysis reveals that supplier diversification accounts for a large share of entry and surplus created between 2005 and 2021. Relative to the socially optimal level of entry, distortions due to suppliers’ inability to capture fully the social benefits of diversity are as large as distortions due to business stealing.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多行业中，买家会分散其供应商基础以管理供应商中断风险。我们研究了这种多元化作为需求和供应商进入决定因素的重要性，背景是互联网骨干网——支撑互联网的全球海底光缆网络。我们构建了一个国际带宽需求和电缆运营商动态进入及供应选择的模型。该模型使用关于跨境数据流量、价格、电缆特性和中断的新数据进行估计。反事实分析显示，供应商多元化解释了2005至2021期间创造的进入和剩余中的很大一部分。相对于社会最优进入水平，由于供应商无法完全获取多元化的社会效益而导致的扭曲，与因业务窃取导致的扭曲一样大。

records.title_en: Inflation Risk and the Finance-Growth Nexus
records.title_cn: 通胀风险与金融-增长关系
records.abstract_en: When firms finance using long-term nominal debt issued by financial intermediaries, changes in expected inflation lead to a wealth transfer across sectors. Higher expected inflation decreases firms’ real liabilities and default risk, which helps reduce debt overhang. However, it hurts intermediaries’ real assets, leading to a contraction in credit supply. We theoretically demonstrate that intermediary financing conditions play a key role in the transmission of nominal shocks, influencing the premium investors require for bearing inflation risk. We provide empirical evidence supporting our novel inflation transmission mechanism and connect our findings to the banking stress of 2023. We also show that Taylor rules responding to both financial and real variables can help stabilise our economy.
records.abstract_cn: 当企业通过金融中介发行的长期名义债务进行融资时，预期通胀的变化会导致跨部门的财富转移。更高的预期通胀降低了企业的实际负债和违约风险，有助于减少债务积压。然而，这损害了中介机构的实际资产，导致信贷供给收缩。我们从理论上证明，中介融资条件在名义冲击的传导中发挥关键作用，影响投资者为承担通胀风险所要求的溢价。我们提供了支持我们新颖的通胀传导机制的实证证据，并将我们的发现与2023的银行业压力联系起来。我们还表明，同时响应金融和实际变量的泰勒规则有助于稳定我们的经济。

records.title_en: Education and the Margins of Cyclical Adjustment in the Labour Market
records.title_cn: 教育与劳动力市场周期性调整的边际
records.abstract_en: Allocative wages—the labour costs considered when deciding to form or dissolve a long-term employment relationship—are more sensitive to cyclical conditions for more educated workers. Specifically, college-educated workers’ allocative wages are highly pro-cyclical, while high school dropouts’ wages exhibit only moderate cyclicality. Further, as education increases, an increasing share of the sensitivity of allocative wages is driven by the persistent scarring effects of the cyclical position at the time of hiring on the wages associated with higher levels of tenure, amounting to more than a third of the overall sensitivity for the college educated. The greater job stability of the more educated—and therefore the exposure to scarring—contributes to these differences. In addition, more significant scarring at each horizon of tenure amplifies the effect. In service of documenting these facts, I develop new methods for inferring the sensitivity of labour costs to shocks when agents are forward-looking and wages may be intertemporally smoothed.
records.abstract_cn: 配置性工资——即在决定建立或解除长期雇佣关系时所考虑的劳动力成本——对于受教育程度更高的工人而言，对周期性条件的敏感度更高。具体来说，受过大学教育的工人的配置性工资具有高度顺周期性，而高中辍学者的工资仅表现出适度的周期性。此外，随着教育程度的提高，配置性工资敏感度中越来越大的份额是由雇佣时周期性位置的持续疤痕效应对更高任期水平工资的影响所驱动的，对于受过大学教育的人来说，这占总体敏感度的三分之一以上。受教育程度更高的工人具有更大的工作稳定性——因此暴露于疤痕效应——导致了这些差异。此外，在每个任期水平上更显著的疤痕效应放大了这一影响。为了记录这些事实，我开发了新方法，用于在代理人具有前瞻性且工资可能进行跨期平滑的情况下推断劳动力成本对冲击的敏感度。

records.title_en: The Illiquidity of Water Markets
records.title_cn: 水市场的非流动性
records.abstract_en: We investigate the efficiency of a market relative to a non-market institution—an auction relative to a quota—as allocation mechanisms in the presence of frictions. We use data from water markets in southeastern Spain and explore a specific change in the institutions to allocate water. On the one hand, frictions arose because poor farmers were liquidity constrained. On the other hand, farmers who were part of the wealthy elite were not liquidity constrained. We estimate a structural dynamic demand model by taking advantage of the fact that water demand for both types of farmers is determined by the technological constraint imposed by the crop’s production function. This approach allows us to differentiate liquidity constraints from unobserved heterogeneity. We show that the institutional change from an auction to a quota increased total efficiency for the farmers considered. Welfare increased by 23.4 real pesetas per farmer per tree, a 6 % increase in total production relative to the market.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在存在摩擦的情况下，市场相对于非市场制度——拍卖相对于配额——作为分配机制的效率。我们使用了西班牙东南部水市场的数据，并探讨了水资源分配制度的具体变化。一方面，摩擦的产生是因为贫困农民受到流动性约束。另一方面，富裕精英阶层的农民则不受流动性约束。我们利用两类农民的水需求由作物生产函数所施加的技术约束决定这一事实，估计了一个结构性动态需求模型。这种方法使我们能够区分流动性约束与不可观测的异质性。我们表明，从拍卖到配额的制度变化提高了所考虑农民的总效率。福利增加了23.4真实比塞塔每农民每棵树，相对于市场，总产量增加了6%。

records.title_en: Selection in Surveys: Using Randomized Incentives to Detect and Account for Nonresponse Bias
records.title_cn: 调查中的选择：使用随机激励检测并解释无回应偏差
records.abstract_en: We show how to use randomized participation incentives to test and account for nonresponse bias in surveys. We first use data from a survey about labour market conditions, linked to full-population administrative data, to provide evidence of large differences in labour market outcomes between survey participants and nonparticipants, differences which would not be observable to an analyst who only has access to the survey data. These differences persist even after correcting for observable characteristics. We then use the randomized incentives in our survey to directly test for nonresponse bias and find evidence of substantial bias. Next, we apply a range of existing methods that account for nonresponse bias and find they produce bounds (or point estimates) that are either wide or far from the ground truth. We investigate the failure of these methods by taking a closer look at the determinants of participation, finding that the composition of participants changes in opposite directions in response to incentives and reminder emails. We develop a model of participation that allows for two dimensions of unobserved heterogeneity in the participation decision. Applying the model to our data produces bounds (or point estimates) that are narrower and closer to the ground truth than the other methods. Our results highlight the benefits of including randomized participation incentives in surveys. Both the testing procedure and the methods for bias adjustment may be attractive tools for researchers who are able to embed randomized incentives into their survey.
records.abstract_cn: 我们展示了如何使用随机参与激励来检验并解释调查中的无回应偏差。我们首先使用一项关于劳动力市场状况的调查数据，该数据与全人口行政数据相关联，提供了调查参与者和非参与者之间劳动力市场结果存在巨大差异的证据，这些差异对于仅能获取调查数据的分析者而言是无法观察到的。即使在校正了可观察特征之后，这些差异仍然存在。接着，我们利用调查中的随机激励直接检验无回应偏差，并发现了显著偏差的证据。然后，我们应用了一系列现有的处理无回应偏差的方法，发现它们产生的界限（或点估计）要么过宽，要么远离真实值。我们通过更仔细地审视参与的决定因素来调查这些方法的失败原因，发现参与者的构成对激励和提醒邮件的反应方向相反。我们开发了一个参与模型，允许参与决策中存在两个维度的不可观测异质性。将模型应用于我们的数据，产生的界限（或点估计）比其他方法更窄且更接近真实值。我们的结果凸显了在调查中纳入随机参与激励的好处。检验程序和偏差调整方法都可能成为能够将随机激励嵌入其调查的研究人员的有吸引力的工具。

records.title_en: Devaluations, Deposit Dollarization, and Household Heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 贬值、存款美元化与家庭异质性
records.abstract_en: We study the aggregate and redistributive effects of currency devaluations in a small open economy model with leverage-constrained banks and heterogeneous households. Our framework captures three stylized facts about financial dollarization in emerging economies: (1) a sizable share of domestic deposits is denominated in foreign currency; (2) these deposits represent significant foreign currency liabilities for local banks; and (3) dollar deposits are mainly held by wealthier households. A devaluation increases the real burden of foreign currency debt, causing an erosion of banks’ net worth, which depresses credit supply and economic activity. While richer households are partially insulated through their dollar deposits, poorer households cut consumption sharply in response to rising borrowing costs and falling real labor income. In our model deposit, dollarization amplifies the contractionary effects of a devaluation on output, investment, and consumption, in line with new empirical evidence for emerging economies. To achieve this result, both constrained intermediaries and heterogeneous households are crucial. In our framework, regulating dollarization can result in widespread welfare gains, especially for poorer households.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有杠杆约束银行和异质性家庭的小型开放经济模型中，货币贬值的总量效应和再分配效应。我们的框架捕捉了新兴经济体金融美元化的三个典型事实：(1) 国内存款中有相当大比例以外币计价；(2) 这些存款对当地银行而言代表了显著的外币负债；(3) 美元存款主要由较富裕的家庭持有。贬值增加了外币债务的实际负担，导致银行净值侵蚀，从而抑制信贷供给和经济活动。虽然较富裕的家庭通过其美元存款在一定程度上受到保护，但较贫穷的家庭因借贷成本上升和实际劳动收入下降而大幅削减消费。在我们的模型中，存款美元化放大了贬值对产出、投资和消费的紧缩效应，这与新兴经济体的新经验证据一致。要实现这一结果，受约束的中介机构和异质性家庭都至关重要。在我们的框架中，对美元化进行监管可以带来广泛的福利收益，尤其是对较贫穷的家庭而言。

records.title_en: Life-Cycle Wages and Human Capital Investments: Selection and Missing Data
records.title_cn: 生命周期工资与人力资本投资：选择与缺失数据
records.abstract_en: We derive wage equations with individual-specific coefficients from a structural model of human capital investment over the life-cycle. This model allows for interruptions in labour market participation and deals with missing data and attrition problems. We propose a new framework that deals with missingness at random and is based on factor decompositions that allow for flexible control of selection. Our approach leads to an interactive effect wage specification, which we estimate using long administrative panel data on male wages in the private sector in France. A structural function approach shows that interruptions negatively affect average wages. Interestingly, they also negatively affect the inter-decile range of wages after twenty years. This is only partly due to the fact that interruptions are endogenous.
records.abstract_cn: 我们从生命周期中人力资本投资的结构模型中推导出具有个体特定系数的工资方程。该模型允许劳动力市场参与中断，并处理缺失数据和损耗问题。我们提出了一个新框架，该框架处理随机缺失，并基于允许灵活控制选择的因子分解。我们的方法导致了一个交互效应工资规范，我们使用法国私营部门男性工资的长期行政面板数据对其进行估计。结构函数方法表明，中断对平均工资产生负面影响。有趣的是，它们还对二十年后的工资十分位距产生负面影响。这仅部分归因于中断是内生的这一事实。

records.title_en: Bank Information Production Over the Business Cycle
records.title_cn: 银行信息生产与经济周期
records.abstract_en: The information banks produce drives their lending decisions and macroeconomic outcomes, but this information is inherently difficult to analyse because it is private. We construct a novel measure of bank information quality from confidential regulatory data that include banks’ private risk assessments for US corporate loans. Information quality improves as local economic conditions deteriorate, particularly for new loans, large loans, and loans with higher expected losses. Information quality also declines during periods of rapid local house price appreciation. Our results provide empirical support for theories of countercyclical information production in credit markets.
records.abstract_cn: 银行产生的信息驱动着它们的贷款决策和宏观经济结果，但这类信息本质上是私密的，因此难以分析。我们利用包含美国公司贷款私人风险评估的机密监管数据，构建了一个衡量银行信息质量的新指标。当地方经济状况恶化时，信息质量会提高，尤其是对于新贷款、大额贷款和预期损失较高的贷款。在地方房价快速上涨期间，信息质量也会下降。我们的结果为信贷市场中信息生产的逆周期理论提供了实证支持。

records.title_en: The Economics of Equilibrium with Indivisible Goods
records.title_cn: 不可分割商品均衡的经济学
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a theory of competitive equilibrium with indivisible goods based entirely on economic conditions on demand. The key idea is to analyze complementarity and substitutability between bundles of goods, rather than merely between goods themselves. This approach allows us to formulate sufficient and essentially necessary conditions for equilibrium existence—which unify settings with complements and settings with substitutes. Our analysis has implications for auction design.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于完全的需求经济条件，发展了一套不可分割商品竞争均衡理论。关键思想在于分析商品束之间的互补性与替代性，而非仅仅分析商品本身之间的互补性与替代性。这一方法使我们能够提出均衡存在的充分且本质上必要的条件——这些条件统一了具有互补品和具有替代品的情形。我们的分析对拍卖设计具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Latent Heterogeneity in the Marginal Propensity to Consume
records.title_cn: 边际消费倾向中的潜在异质性
records.abstract_en: We estimate the unconditional distribution of the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) using clustering regression applied to the 2008 economic stimulus payments. By deviating from the standard approach of estimating MPC heterogeneity using interactions with observables, we can recover the full distribution of MPCs. We find households spent between 4 and 133% of the rebate within a quarter, and individual households used rebates for different goods. While many observable characteristics correlate individually with our estimated MPCs, most of these relationships disappear when tested jointly. Notable exceptions are income and the average propensity to consume, which correlate positively with the MPC. Household observable characteristics explain only 8% of MPC variation, highlighting the role of latent heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用聚类回归方法应用于2008经济刺激支付，估计了边际消费倾向（MPC）的无条件分布。通过偏离使用可观测变量交互项来估计MPC异质性的标准方法，我们能够恢复MPC的完整分布。我们发现，家庭在一个季度内花费了退税的4至133%，且不同家庭将退税用于不同商品。虽然许多可观测特征与我们的估计MPC单独相关，但在联合检验时，这些关系大多消失。显著的例外是收入和平均消费倾向，它们与MPC正相关。家庭可观测特征仅解释了MPC变异的8%，凸显了潜在异质性的作用。

records.title_en: A Robust Test for Weak Instruments for 2SLS with Multiple Endogenous Regressors
records.title_cn: 多个内生回归变量下2SLS弱工具变量的稳健检验
records.abstract_en: We develop a test for instrument strength based on the bias of two-stage least squares (2SLS) that (1) generalizes Stock and Yogo’s and Sanderson and Windmeijer’s tests to be robust to heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation, and (2) extends Montiel Olea and Pflueger’s robust test for models with a single endogenous regressor to multiple endogenous regressors. Our test can be based either on an absolute bias criterion or on the 2SLS bias relative to a worst-case benchmark. We also develop extensions to test whether weak instruments cause bias in individual 2SLS coefficients. In simulations, our test controls size and is powerful, and we provide efficient code packages for its practical implementation. We demonstrate our testing procedures in the context of the estimation of state-dependent fiscal multipliers, following recent leading estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于两阶段最小二乘（2SLS）的偏误开发了一种工具变量强度检验，该检验（1）将Stock和Yogo以及Sanderson和Windmeijer的检验推广为对异方差和自相关稳健，并且（2）将Montiel Olea和Pflueger针对单一内生回归变量模型的稳健检验扩展到多个内生回归变量。我们的检验既可以基于绝对偏误准则，也可以基于相对于最坏情况基准的2SLS偏误。我们还开发了扩展，以检验弱工具变量是否导致单个2SLS系数产生偏误。在模拟中，我们的检验控制了规模且具有功效，我们提供了高效代码包以供实际实施。我们以状态依赖财政乘数的估计为背景，遵循近期领先的估计，展示了我们的检验程序。

records.title_en: Firm Quality Dynamics and the Slippery Slope of Credit Intervention
records.title_cn: 企业质量动态与信贷干预的滑坡效应
records.abstract_en: A salient trend in crisis intervention has emerged in recent decades: government and central banks have offered funding directly to nonfinancial firms, bypassing banks and other credit intermediaries. We analyse the long-term consequences of such policies by focussing on firm quality dynamics. In a laissez-faire economy, firms with high productivity are more likely to survive crises than those with low productivity. The government funding support saves more firms but cannot be customized based on firm productivity, dampening the cleansing effect of crises. The policy distortion is self-perpetuating: a downward bias in the firm quality distribution necessitates larger interventions in future crises. Our mechanism is quantitatively important: we show that if policymakers ignore such distortionary effects on firm quality dynamics, the resultant credit intervention would almost double the optimal amount.
records.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，危机干预出现了一个显著趋势：政府和中央银行绕过银行及其他信贷中介，直接向非金融企业提供资金。我们通过聚焦企业质量动态来分析此类政策的长期后果。在自由放任经济中，高生产率企业比低生产率企业更有可能在危机中幸存。政府资金支持拯救了更多企业，但无法基于企业生产率进行定制，从而削弱了危机的净化效应。政策扭曲具有自我延续性：企业质量分布的下行偏差使得未来危机中需要更大规模的干预。我们的机制在数量上具有重要意义：我们表明，如果政策制定者忽视这种对企业质量动态的扭曲效应，由此产生的信贷干预规模将几乎是最优水平的两倍。

records.title_en: Choice and Opportunity Costs
records.title_cn: 选择与机会成本
records.abstract_en: We define the (physical) opportunity cost of a choice x as the alternative that would be chosen if x were not available, and the opportunity cost of any unchosen alternative as x itself. The agent has preferences over pairs consisting of alternatives and their opportunity costs. Because costs affect choice and vice-versa, choice results from an intrapersonal equilibrium rather than from simple maximisation. In spite of significant rationality assumptions, the resulting behaviour can be highly non-standard, allowing intransitive choices. Rational utility maximisation is ensured by an additional new consistency condition on preferences. However, we argue that the maximised utility cannot be straightforwardly interpreted as a welfare relevant “revealed preference”. A generalisation of our model accommodates additional departures from standard rationality in the form of menu effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将选择x的（实物）机会成本定义为：若x不可获得时将被选择的替代方案，而任何未被选择的替代方案的机会成本则为x本身。行为主体对由替代方案及其机会成本组成的配对具有偏好。由于成本影响选择，反之亦然，选择源于个体内部均衡而非简单最大化。尽管存在显著的理性假设，由此产生的行为可能高度非标准，允许出现不可传递的选择。理性的效用最大化通过一个额外的关于偏好的新一致性条件得以确保。然而，我们认为最大化的效用不能直接解释为福利相关的“显示性偏好”。我们模型的一个推广形式以菜单效应的形式容纳了偏离标准理性的额外情形。

records.title_en: Bridges
records.title_cn: 桥梁
records.abstract_en: Bridges are critical but sparse links in land transport networks. I exploit quasi-experimental variation in bridge construction over major rivers in the U.S. to measure the causal effects of land transport infrastructure. Bridges are more often built upstream than downstream of tributary confluences—where smaller rivers join larger rivers—generating local differences in connectivity. Local connectivity advantages have negative effects on per capita income. In contrast, more substantial changes in connectivity arising from the opening of major bridges increase per capita economic activity. A narrative explanation that can reconcile both results is that land transport infrastructure creates productivity advantages that drive economic growth, structural transformation, and urbanization over large spatial scales, but local sorting within the cities that form around early transport routes then reverses this gradient over smaller spatial scales.
records.abstract_cn: 桥梁是陆路交通网络中至关重要但稀疏的连接点。我利用美国主要河流上桥梁建设的准实验性变化来衡量陆路交通基础设施的因果效应。桥梁更常建在支流汇合处的上游——即较小河流汇入较大河流之处——从而产生局部连通性的差异。局部连通性优势对人均收入有负面影响。相比之下，由主要桥梁开通引起的更显著的连通性变化则增加了人均经济活动。能够调和这两种结果的叙事性解释是，陆路交通基础设施创造了生产力优势，在大空间尺度上推动经济增长、结构转型和城市化，但围绕早期交通路线形成的城市内部的局部排序随后在较小空间尺度上逆转了这一梯度。

records.title_en: Costly Multidimensional Screening
records.title_cn: 高成本多维筛选
records.abstract_en: A screening instrument is costly if it is socially wasteful and productive otherwise. A principal screens an agent with multidimensional private information and quasilinear preferences that are additively separable across two components: a one-dimensional productive component and a multidimensional costly component. Can the principal improve upon simple one-dimensional mechanisms by also using the costly instruments? We show that if the agent has preferences between the two components that are positively correlated in a suitably defined sense, then simply screening the productive component is optimal. The result holds for general type and allocation spaces, and allows for nonlinear and interdependent valuations. We discuss applications to monopoly pricing, bundling, and labour market screening.
records.abstract_cn: 如果一种筛选工具在社会上是浪费的，而另一种则是生产性的，那么这种筛选工具就是高成本的。委托人筛选具有多维私人信息和拟线性偏好的代理人，这些偏好可加性地分离为两个组成部分：一个一维生产性组成部分和一个多维高成本组成部分。委托人能否通过同时使用高成本工具来改进简单的一维机制？我们证明，如果代理人对这两个组成部分的偏好在适当定义的意义上是正相关的，那么仅筛选生产性组成部分就是最优的。该结果适用于一般的类型和配置空间，并允许非线性和相互依存的估值。我们讨论了在垄断定价、捆绑销售和劳动力市场筛选中的应用。

records.title_en: Innovation and its enduring relevance in (the Journal of  ) Economic Geography : shifting perspectives on the semantics, actors, and spaces of entrepreneurial practices
Illuminating the dark sides of innovation: toward an economic geography of controversial innovation
Care in economic geography: foundation and frontier
Planetary boundaries as spatial constraints: rethinking regional development under ecological limits
Cap-and-trade policies and regional environmental innovation: evidence from the EU Emissions Trading System
Co-location of skill-related suppliers: advancing coagglomeration research using firm-to-firm network data
The unintended consequences of special economic zones on crime
Structural change and spatial concentration of high-income earners: evidence from French regions since 1960
What are transfer mechanisms of regional entrepreneurship over time? The impact of historical role models and their economic success
The Extent of the Market for Early American Banknotes
records.title_cn: 早期美国银行券的市场范围
records.abstract_en: Using data on interbank relationships and note holdings in Pennsylvania, I estimate the probability that a bank will redeem the notes of other banks by the distance separating them. If two banks were separated by 50 miles, there was a 40 percent probability that a bank would hold the notes of another at a given time. At 200 miles, the estimated probability is virtually zero. My analysis of notes discounted by a small-town, Connecticut banknote broker reveals that distant notes were offered by travelers and traders who moved along the era’s principal waterways.
records.abstract_cn: 利用宾夕法尼亚州银行间关系和银行券持有数据，我估计了一家银行赎回其他银行券的概率与两者之间距离的关系。如果两家银行相隔50英里，则在给定时间一家银行持有另一家银行券的概率为40%。在200英里处，估计概率几乎为零。我对一家康涅狄格州小镇银行券经纪商贴现的银行券的分析显示，远距离银行券是由沿当时主要水道往来的旅行者和商人提供的。

records.title_en: Pronatalist Policies’ Backlash in Authoritarian Regimes
records.title_cn: 威权政权中鼓励生育政策的反效果
records.abstract_en: European fascist regimes have attached great importance to nationalistic families and designed policies to perpetuate them. Most offered policy packages with interest-free loans repayable through childbirth, along with allowances and tax deductions for large families. Using a difference-in-difference approach and Nazi Germany as a case study, we show that these policies may have counterproductive effects due to negative selection mechanisms in the marriage market. The excessive pressure to marry exerted on singles results in lower quality, ultimately less fertile, and more fragile unions. This finding is important as the main European far-right parties today propose reinstating these policy packages.
records.abstract_cn: 欧洲法西斯政权高度重视民族主义家庭，并设计了旨在使其延续的政策。大多数政权提供了一揽子政策，包括通过生育偿还的无息贷款，以及为大家庭提供的津贴和税收减免。我们采用双重差分方法并以纳粹德国为案例研究，表明由于婚姻市场中的负向选择机制，这些政策可能产生反效果。对单身者施加的过度结婚压力导致结合质量更低、最终生育率更低且更脆弱。这一发现很重要，因为当今欧洲主要的极右翼政党提议恢复这些一揽子政策。

records.title_en: Colonialism on the Cheap: The French Empire 1830–1962
records.title_cn: 廉价的殖民主义：法兰西帝国1830-1962
records.abstract_en: How much did France pay for its colonial empire? Did colonies benefit from large transfers from French taxpayers and private investors, or were they, on the contrary, drained of their capital? This paper uses novel budgetary, private investment, and loan data to compute monetary flows between France and the colonies between 1833 and 1962. Public expenditure spent by France on the empire represented only 1.3 percent of its GDP, of which four-fifths was for the military. Trade balance deficits of French colonies were not counterbalanced by large public or private capital transfers from France to the colonies, but by military expenditure from the metropole. Overall, large sums of money were flowing from the colonies to the metropole, a “drain” representing a couple of percentage points of colonial GDP, making French colonies comparable to British India in the twentieth century.
records.abstract_cn: 法国为其殖民帝国支付了多少代价？殖民地是从法国纳税人和私人投资者的大规模转移支付中获益，还是相反，被抽走了资本？本文使用新的预算、私人投资和贷款数据，计算1833年至1962年间法国与殖民地之间的货币流动。法国在帝国上的公共支出仅占其GDP的1.3%，其中五分之四用于军事。法国殖民地的贸易逆差并非由法国向殖民地的大规模公共或私人资本转移所抵消，而是由宗主国的军事支出所抵消。总体而言，大量资金从殖民地流向宗主国，这种“抽血”占殖民地GDP的几个百分点，使法国殖民地与二十世纪的英属印度具有可比性。

records.title_en: Can Pensions Save Lives? Evidence from the Introduction of Old-Age Assistance in the United Kingdom
records.title_cn: 养老金能拯救生命吗？来自英国老年援助制度引入的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of old-age assistance on mortality using the 1909 introduction of public pensions in the United Kingdom as a quasi-natural experiment. Estimating difference-in-differences and an event-time design, we show that elderly mortality in England and Wales declined with the pension introduction. The estimated decline is economically relevant, stronger in counties with more pensioners, and driven by fewer deaths from both infectious and non-infectious diseases. Analyzing full-count individual-level census data points to a reduction in residential crowding and retirement, especially from occupations associated with high mortality rates, as likely channels.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用英国公共养老金在1909的引入作为准自然实验，研究老年援助对死亡率的影响。通过估计双重差分和事件时间设计，我们发现英格兰和威尔士的老年人死亡率随养老金的引入而下降。估计的下降具有经济相关性，在养老金领取者更多的郡更强，并且由传染病和非传染病死亡人数的减少所驱动。分析全计数个体层面的人口普查数据表明，居住拥挤程度下降和退休——尤其是从与高死亡率相关的职业中退休——可能是其渠道。

records.title_en: Why Was the Wheel (Not) Used in the Andes? A Hypothesis Explaining the Slow Adoption of Wagon Transport and Evidence from Nineteenth-Century Colombia
records.title_cn: 为什么安第斯山脉没有使用轮子？解释马车运输缓慢采用的假设和来自十九世纪哥伦比亚的证据
records.abstract_en: The slow adoption of wagon transport in the Andes is a puzzle. We examine it by developing a threshold technology-adoption model calibrated using human and mule energy consumption and unique historical data from a human trail and the first wagon road in the Andes. Model predictions align with historical social choices. Pre-Columbians selected a straight, steep, short route for human porters to reduce energy costs, while the Spanish used it with mule packs. Late nineteenth-century transport demand growth surpassed the model’s threshold and contributed to construction of the zigzagging, gentle, long wagon road route, as well as incentives to build state capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 马车运输在安第斯山脉的缓慢采用是一个谜。我们通过开发一个阈值技术采用模型来对其进行研究，该模型使用人和骡子的能量消耗以及来自人类足迹和安第斯山脉第一条马车道路的独特历史数据进行校准。模型预测与历史社会选择一致。前哥伦布时代的人为搬运工选择了一条笔直、陡峭、较短的路线，以降低能源成本，而西班牙人则用骡子驮着这条路线。十九世纪末的交通需求增长超过了模型的阈值，促进了曲折、平缓、长的货车道路的建设，并激励了国家能力建设。

records.title_en: Economic Conditions and Incarceration in the United States: Evidence from Missouri, 1850–1930
records.title_cn: 美国的经济状况与监禁：来自密苏里州的证据，1850-1930
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between economic conditions and incarceration in the postbellum United States. Leveraging unique administrative prison records in Missouri from 1850 to 1931 and the differential exposure to national agricultural price changes across counties, I find that positive economic shocks reduce prison admission rates for all crime categories, and negative shocks increase prison admission rates, with the relationship being larger for negative shocks. Although racial disparities in incarceration emerged after Reconstruction, with Black prison admission rates five times higher than white rates, I find no evidence that economic conditions affected prison admission rates differently across racial groups.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了战后美国经济状况与监禁之间的关系。利用密苏里州1850至1931年间独特的行政监狱记录，以及各县对全国农产品价格变化的差异化暴露，我发现正向经济冲击降低了所有犯罪类别的监狱收监率，负向冲击则提高了监狱收监率，且负向冲击的关系更大。尽管种族差异在监禁中于重建后出现，黑人监狱收监率是白人收监率的五倍，但我没有发现证据表明经济状况对不同种族群体的监狱收监率产生了不同影响。

records.title_en: Historical Anti-Fascism and Right-Wing Voting in Italy
records.title_cn: 历史上的反法西斯主义与意大利右翼投票
records.abstract_en: We study how anti-fascist opposition during Mussolini’s dictatorship affects post-war support for right-wing parties in Italy. We construct a measure of anti-fascism from the universe of recorded opponents, and use newly digitized historical data to resolve simultaneity between the supply of opposition and the demand for repression, leveraging the random assignment of judges to the Special Tribunal for the Defense of the State. Stronger local opposition leads to weaker support for right-wing parties decades later. Our model generates predictions about underlying mechanisms, tested using data on collective memorialization and parental voting behavior. The main driver is social transmission of political preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究墨索里尼独裁时期的反法西斯反对派如何影响战后意大利对右翼政党的支持。我们基于有记录的反对者总体构建了一个反法西斯主义度量，并使用新数字化的历史数据来解决反对派供给与镇压需求之间的同时性问题，利用法官被随机分配到保卫国家特别法庭这一机制。更强大的地方反对派导致数十年后对右翼政党的支持更弱。我们的模型对潜在机制做出了预测，并使用集体纪念活动和父母投票行为的数据进行了检验。主要驱动因素是政治偏好的社会传递。

records.title_en: The Progressive Era War on Vice: Public Health Consequences of Closing Red-Light Districts
records.title_cn: 进步时代对恶习的宣战：关闭红灯区对公共卫生的影响
records.abstract_en: In the late 1800s, city leaders in the United States established red-light districts to contain prostitution. Progressive Era reformers argued these districts harmed public health, prompting their closure in the 1910s. This paper analyzes how closing the red-light districts affected neighborhood composition and public health. I find infant mortality from premature births and congenital defects increased after closure, which is consistent with an increase in congenital syphilis. There was also no increase in homicide deaths, suggesting the districts did not increase crime. These findings suggest the public health concerns raised by reformers were likely overstated.
records.abstract_cn: 在1800晚期，美国城市领导人设立了红灯区以遏制卖淫。进步时代改革者认为这些区域损害公共卫生，促使在1910将其关闭。本文分析了关闭红灯区如何影响社区构成和公共卫生。我发现关闭后，早产和先天缺陷导致的婴儿死亡率上升，这与先天性梅毒增加相一致。凶杀死亡也没有增加，表明这些区域并未增加犯罪。这些发现表明改革者提出的公共卫生担忧可能被夸大了。

records.title_en: The macroeconomics of automation
records.title_cn: 自动化的宏观经济学
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a theory in which the degree of automation in the aggregate economy emerges endogenously as an equilibrium outcome and can be inferred from standard macroeconomic data. We define the degree of automation as the share of tasks performed by capital rather than labor and embed it in a task-based production framework with endogenous technology adoption. Aggregating task-level decisions generates a CES production function in which the economy-wide degree of automation emerges endogenously. This structure provides a transparent mapping from standard macroeconomic observables, such as the capital-labor ratio, output per worker, and the elasticity of substitution, into the degree of automation, allowing automation to be measured without relying on technology-specific indicators. Applying the framework to Japanese manufacturing industries, we show that automation increased through capital deepening even during periods of slow productivity growth.
records.abstract_cn: 本文发展了一个理论，其中总体经济的自动化程度作为均衡结果内生出现，并可从标准宏观经济数据中推断。我们将自动化程度定义为由资本而非劳动执行的任务份额，并将其嵌入一个具有内生技术采纳的基于任务的生产框架中。对任务层面决策进行加总，生成一个CES生产函数，其中经济范围的自动化程度内生出现。这一结构提供了从标准宏观经济可观测变量（如资本-劳动比率、人均产出和替代弹性）到自动化程度的透明映射，使得自动化可以在不依赖技术特定指标的情况下被测量。将该框架应用于日本制造业，我们表明，即使在生产率增长缓慢的时期，自动化也通过资本深化而增加。

records.title_en: Armed conflict exposure and trust: evidence from a natural experiment*
records.title_cn: 武装冲突暴露与信任：来自自然实验的证据*
records.abstract_en: This study examines how exposure to armed conflict affects group-specific trust, focusing on individuals exposed during military service. Our identification strategy exploits a population-level natural experiment generated by Turkey’s strict military conscription system and its long-running civil conflict. We combine this setting with an original field survey to identify causal effects and examine individual-level mechanisms while minimizing contextual confounding. We find that men exposed to the armed conflict during their conscription service exhibit elevated ingroup trust, with no corresponding increase in trust toward outgroups or in generalized trust. In contrast, those with battlefield traumas display lower trust overall. Exposed veterans also display stronger ingroup-biased attitudes like nationalism, intolerance, religiosity, and adherence to social norms. These results suggest that conflict exposure shifts social preferences toward ingroup favouritism without strengthening broader forms of trust, a pattern that is likely to hinder the accumulation of social capital and, in turn, adversely affect long-run economic development and institutional quality.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察武装冲突暴露如何影响群体特定信任，重点关注在服兵役期间暴露于冲突的个体。我们的识别策略利用土耳其严格的义务兵役制度及其长期内战所产生的人口层面自然实验。我们将这一背景与一项原创实地调查相结合，以识别因果效应并考察个体层面的机制，同时尽量减少情境混杂。我们发现，在征兵服役期间暴露于武装冲突的男性表现出更高的内群体信任，而对外群体信任或一般化信任没有相应增加。相比之下，那些有战场创伤的人总体上表现出更低的信任。暴露的退伍军人还表现出更强的内群体偏向态度，如民族主义、不宽容、宗教虔诚和对社会规范的遵从。这些结果表明，冲突暴露使社会偏好转向内群体偏袒，而没有增强更广泛形式的信任，这种模式很可能阻碍社会资本的积累，进而对长期经济发展和制度质量产生不利影响。

records.title_en: Manipulation of information in times of crisis: evidence from Covid excess mortality
records.title_cn: 危机时期的信息操纵：来自Covid超额死亡率的证据
records.abstract_en: Governmental information manipulation has been hard to measure and study systematically. This paper provides comparable country-level estimates of the extent of misinformation in official data, in a large and diverse set of countries. We hand-collect data from a variety of sources in 134 countries to estimate misreporting of Covid mortality in 2020-2021. We find that information manipulation by governments during this period was remarkably widespread: between 45%–55% of governments misreport the number of deaths. Misreporting is large in magnitude: together, the countries we study reported 5.08 million Covid deaths during 2020-2021, whereas actual Covid mortality was more than double, at 12.47 million. The lion’s share of misreporting cannot be attributed to a country’s capacity to accurately diagnose and report deaths. Contrary to some theoretical expectations, information manipulation takes the form of downplaying rather than exaggerating the severity of the crisis. What characterizes governments that manipulate information? We examine the role of macroeconomic incentives, culture, audience sophistication, and institutions. The evidence strongly suggests that misreporting is higher where governments face fewer social and institutional constraints; in countries holding elections during this period; and in countries with a communist legacy.
records.abstract_cn: 政府信息操纵一直难以系统性地测量和研究。本文在大量且多样化的国家中，提供了可比的国家层面官方数据中错误信息程度的估计。我们手工收集了134个国家多种来源的数据，以估计2020-2021期间Covid死亡率的误报情况。我们发现，政府在此期间的信息操纵极为普遍：45%–55%的政府误报了死亡人数。误报的幅度很大：我们研究的国家合计在2020-2021期间报告了5.08百万例Covid死亡，而实际Covid死亡率超过其两倍，达到12.47百万。误报的绝大部分不能归因于一个国家准确诊断和报告死亡的能力。与一些理论预期相反，信息操纵采取的形式是淡化而非夸大危机的严重性。操纵信息的政府具有什么特征？我们考察了宏观经济激励、文化、受众成熟度和制度的作用。证据强烈表明，在政府面临较少社会和制度约束的地方、在此期间举行选举的国家以及具有共产主义遗产的国家，误报更高。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects
records.title_cn: 绿氢和蓝氢之间的竞争和间接网络效应
records.abstract_en: Whereas hydrogen is currently a marginal energy carrier, the aim of the EU is to trigger low-carbon hydrogen production that covers around 10 percent of EU's energy needs by 2050. If this comes true, it will be an energy revolution. We study competition between green and blue hydrogen using an extended Salop model that encompasses the value chains for hydrogen and CCS.
