For estimation and inference a novel variant of the self-generated instrument approach called sieve-IVX is introduced, giving a robust approach to inference concerning time-varying predictability that is applicable irrespective of the degrees of persistence. Asymptotic theory of the Sieve-IVX approach is based on a new infinite dimensional invariance principle that delivers limit theory for sieve-IVX estimation, validating pointwise and uniform inference procedures for testing predictability and model specification. Simulations show excellent performance characteristics of the resulting tests in finite samples. An empirical exercise is conducted examining excess S&P 500 returns, applying Sieve-IVX regression with pointwise and uniform tests to reveal evidence of time-varying patterns in the predictive capability of commonly used fundamental variables.
records.abstract_cn: 预测回归模型常用于评估经济基本面因素对债券和股票收益的预测能力。这些回归中的推断程序通常采用斜率系数的参数恒定性或分段恒定性。此类设定容易产生设定误差，尤其是在 prevailing 经济和金融条件发生扰动或演变期间，这可能导致规模扭曲和可预测性的虚假证据。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种半参数预测回归模型，该模型包含混合根回归量和时变系数，允许生成机制随时间平滑演变。为进行估计和推断，引入了一种称为sieve-IVX的自生成工具变量方法的新变体，提供了一种关于时变可预测性的稳健推断方法，无论持久程度如何均适用。Sieve-IVX方法的渐近理论基于一个新的无限维不变性原理，该原理为sieve-IVX估计提供了极限理论，验证了用于检验可预测性和模型设定的逐点和一致推断程序。模拟显示所得检验在有限样本中具有优异的性能特征。进行了一项实证练习，检验S&P 500的超额收益，应用Sieve-IVX回归与逐点和一致检验，揭示了常用基本面变量预测能力中时变模式的证据。

records.title_en: Testing for structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects via discrete Fourier transform
records.title_cn: 通过离散傅里叶变换检验具有交互固定效应的面板数据模型中的结构变化
records.abstract_en: We propose a discrete Fourier transform (DFT)-based test for detecting structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects (IFE). When structural changes are present but ignored, the conventional asymptotic distribution of the least squares (LS) estimator of Bai (2009) may no longer provide reliable inference, and the resulting residuals contain signals of parameter instability. Our test exploits this feature by comparing the DFT of weighted residuals to the flat (zero) spectrum implied under the null hypothesis of no structural change. We establish the theoretical properties of the test, including its asymptotic null distribution and its local and global power, and propose a bootstrap procedure for valid inference in finite samples. Notably, the proposed test can detect a class of local alternatives converging to the null at the rate of N−1/2T−1/2, matching the convergence rate of the slope estimators, where N and T are the cross-sectional and time dimensions, respectively. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the excellent performance of the proposed test across various types of structural changes in both factor loadings and slope coefficients. We further illustrate the empirical relevance of our method by applying it to the environmental Kuznets curve and the relationship between health expenditure and income. Our findings highlight the importance of accounting for structural changes in panel data models with IFE.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出一种基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的检验，用于检测具有交互固定效应（IFE）的面板数据模型中的结构变化。当结构变化存在但被忽略时，Bai（2009）的最小二乘（LS）估计量的常规渐近分布可能不再提供可靠的推断，并且由此产生的残差包含参数不稳定的信号。我们的检验利用这一特征，通过将加权残差的DFT与无结构变化原假设下隐含的平坦（零）谱进行比较。我们建立该检验的理论性质，包括其渐近原分布及其局部和全局功效，并提出一种用于有限样本中有效推断的bootstrap程序。值得注意的是，所提出的检验能够检测一类以N−1/2T−1/2的速率收敛到原假设的局部备择假设，与斜率估计量的收敛速率相匹配，其中N和T分别为横截面维度和时间维度。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的检验在因子载荷和斜率系数中各种类型的结构变化下均具有优异表现。我们进一步通过将其应用于环境库兹涅茨曲线以及卫生支出与收入之间的关系，来说明我们方法的经验相关性。我们的发现凸显了在具有IFE的面板数据模型中考虑结构变化的重要性。

records.title_en: Matrix-valued spatial autoregressions with dynamic heterogeneous spillovers
records.title_cn: 具有动态异质性溢出的矩阵值空间自回归
records.abstract_en: We introduce a new time-varying parameter spatial matrix autoregressive model that integrates matrix-valued time series, heterogeneous spillover effects, outlier robustness, and time-varying parameters in one unified framework. The model allows for separate dynamic spatial spillover effects across both the row and column dimensions of the matrix-valued observations. Robustness can be introduced via a matrix Student’s t distribution. The model can still be estimated straightforwardly by standard maximum likelihood methods, and we establish stationarity and invertibility of the model, as well as consistency and asymptotic normality of its maximum likelihood estimator. Simulations reveal that the two-way spatial spillover dynamics can be successfully recovered even if the model is misspecified. Using a 12 × 12 trade network application, we show that the time-varying, robust matrix features of the new model better fit the empirical data than alternative specifications.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入一个新的时变参数空间矩阵自回归模型，该模型将矩阵值时间序列、异质性溢出效应、异常值稳健性和时变参数整合在一个统一框架中。该模型允许在矩阵值观测的行和列维度上分别存在动态空间溢出效应。稳健性可以通过矩阵Student's t分布引入。该模型仍然可以通过标准最大似然方法直接估计，我们建立了模型的平稳性和可逆性，以及其最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。模拟表明，即使模型被错误设定，双向空间溢出动态也可以被成功恢复。使用一个12 × 12贸易网络应用，我们表明新模型的时变、稳健矩阵特征比替代设定更好地拟合经验数据。

records.title_en: Identification of non-additive fixed effects models: Is the return to teacher quality homogeneous?
records.title_cn: 非可加固定效应模型的识别：教师质量的回报是同质的吗？
records.abstract_en: Panel or grouped data are often used to allow for unobserved individual heterogeneity in econometric models via fixed effects. In this paper, we discuss identification of a panel data model in which the unobserved heterogeneity both enters additively and interacts with treatment variables. We present identification and estimation methods for parameters of interest in this model under both strict and weak exogeneity assumptions. The key identification insight is that other periods’ treatment variables are instruments for the unobserved fixed effects. We apply our proposed estimator to matched student-teacher data used to estimate value-added models of teacher quality. We show that the common assumption that the return to teacher quality is the same for all students is rejected by the data. We also present evidence that No Child Left Behind-era school accountability raised the effectiveness of teacher quality for lower performing students.
records.abstract_cn: 面板数据或分组数据常被用于通过固定效应来允许计量经济学模型中的不可观测个体异质性。在本文中，我们讨论了一个面板数据模型的识别问题，其中不可观测异质性既以可加方式进入，又与处理变量交互。我们在严格外生性和弱外生性假设下，提出了该模型中感兴趣参数的识别和估计方法。关键的识别洞见是，其他时期的处理变量是未观测固定效应的工具变量。我们将所提出的估计量应用于匹配的学生-教师数据，这些数据用于估计教师质量的增值模型。我们表明，教师质量回报对所有学生都相同这一常见假设被数据拒绝。我们还提供了证据表明，《不让一个孩子掉队》时代的学校问责制提高了教师质量对表现较差学生的有效性。

records.title_en: Testing asset pricing factor models: An out-of-sample perspective
records.title_cn: 检验资产定价因子模型：一个样本外视角
records.abstract_en: We develop the Sample Splitting Alpha (SSA) test, a formal out-of-sample (OOS) test for evaluating whether an asset pricing factor model satisfies the zero-alpha restriction in high-dimensional settings. The test uses sample splitting to separate portfolio weight estimation from model evaluation and ridge regularization to stabilize the portfolio problem when the number of test assets is large. We show that each single SSA statistic is asymptotically Gaussian under mild regularity conditions. For the aggregated SSA statistic used in implementation, we characterize the dependence across split statistics and compute p-values by resampling. Economically, the statistic relates to the OOS incremental spanning value of the chosen test assets relative to a candidate factor model, measured by the OOS squared information ratio. The simulation results accord with the asymptotic analysis. In empirical applications, SSA rejects some statistically constructed factor models more often than the in-sample benchmarks, despite those models’ strong in-sample fit.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了样本分割Alpha（SSA）检验，这是一种正式样本外（OOS）检验，用于在高维设定中评估资产定价因子模型是否满足零Alpha约束。该检验使用样本分割将投资组合权重估计与模型评估分离，并使用岭正则化在检验资产数量较大时稳定投资组合问题。我们证明，在温和正则条件下，每个单一SSA统计量渐近服从高斯分布。对于实施中使用的聚合SSA统计量，我们刻画了各分割统计量之间的依赖性，并通过重抽样计算p值。在经济意义上，该统计量与所选检验资产相对于候选因子模型的OOS增量跨度价值相关，由OOS平方信息比率衡量。模拟结果与渐近分析一致。在实证应用中，尽管一些统计构造的因子模型具有强样本内拟合，SSA比样本内基准更频繁地拒绝这些模型。

records.title_en: High dimensional alpha test for linear factor pricing model with L q -norm
records.title_cn: 基于L q 范数的高维线性因子定价模型alpha检验
records.abstract_en: We consider testing zero pricing errors in high-dimensional linear factor pricing models. Existing methods are mainly based on either an L2 statistic, which is effective under dense alternatives, or an L∞ statistic, which is powerful under very sparse alternatives. To bridge these two regimes, we develop a class of Lq-based tests for finite q, including the practically useful L4 and L6 cases. We show that larger q leads to greater sensitivity to sparse alternatives. We further establish the asymptotic independence between the L∞ statistic and the Lq statistic for any finite q, which motivates a Cauchy combination test that adapts to a broad range of sparsity levels. Simulation studies and a real-data analysis show that the proposed methods are more robust to the unknown sparsity of the alternative and can outperform existing procedures in finite samples.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑检验高维线性因子定价模型中的零定价误差。现有方法主要基于在稠密备择假设下有效的L2统计量，或基于在非常稀疏备择假设下具有高功效的L∞统计量。为衔接这两种情形，我们发展了一类基于Lq的检验，适用于有限q，包括实际中常用的L4和L6情形。我们表明，较大的q导致对稀疏备择假设更敏感。我们进一步建立了L∞统计量与任意有限q的Lq统计量之间的渐近独立性，这启发了一种适用于广泛稀疏水平的Cauchy组合检验。模拟研究和实际数据分析表明，所提方法对未知的备择假设稀疏性更为稳健，并在有限样本中能够优于现有方法。

records.title_en: Panel threshold regression with unobserved individual-specific threshold effects
records.title_cn: 具有未观测个体特定阈值效应的面板阈值回归
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a new approach to estimation and inference in multiple regime panel threshold regression with unobserved individual-specific threshold effects. Such effects are practically relevant and have features that distinguish them from traditional linear panel data models. It is shown that within-regime demeaning in the static model or within-regime first-differencing in the dynamic model both fail to deliver consistent threshold estimators. Instead, correlated random effects models are suggested to address endogeneity in such panel threshold systems. The paper develops a unified framework of estimation and inference for both static and dynamic models that applies irrespective of whether the unobserved individual-specific threshold effects exist or whether the number of regimes is correctly specified. The approach involves model selection based on sequential testing which allows for underestimation of the number of regimes, develops asymptotic theory for least squares estimation that is robust to such model misspecification, and proposes new inferential methods for the model parameters which have improved asymptotic and empirical properties over existing methods. Simulations combined with an empirical application illustrate the practical utility of the new methodology.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为具有未观测个体特定阈值效应的多机制面板阈值回归中的估计和推断提供了一种新方法。此类效应在实际中具有相关性，并且具有使其区别于传统线性面板数据模型的特征。研究表明，静态模型中的机制内去均值或动态模型中的机制内一阶差分均无法提供一致的阈值估计量。相反，建议采用相关随机效应模型来处理此类面板阈值系统中的内生性。本文为静态和动态模型开发了一个统一的估计和推断框架，该框架无论未观测个体特定阈值效应是否存在，或机制数量是否被正确设定，均适用。该方法涉及基于序贯检验的模型选择，允许对机制数量的低估，为最小二乘估计开发了对这种模型误设稳健的渐近理论，并针对模型参数提出了新的推断方法，这些方法相比现有方法具有改进的渐近和实证性质。模拟结合实证应用说明了新方法的实际效用。

records.title_en: Measurement error and peer effects in networks
records.title_cn: 网络中的测量误差与同伴效应
records.abstract_en: In many practical applications, only noisy proxies for the true regressors are available, which is commonly believed to induce an attenuation bias. In the linear-in-means model, however, estimated peer effects might be inflated, potentially leading to false positives. This paper shows that the asymptotic bias depends on the interplay between individual characteristics and network links and demonstrates how the network structure can facilitate identification without the need for additional external information. Based on these identification results, we present consistent GMM and 2SLS estimators that are easily implementable. Our results are illustrated by means of a Monte Carlo simulation.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多实际应用中，仅能获得真实回归变量的含噪代理变量，这通常被认为会导致衰减偏误。然而，在线性均值模型中，估计的同伴效应可能被夸大，从而可能导致假阳性。本文表明，渐近偏误取决于个体特征与网络链接之间的相互作用，并展示了网络结构如何能够在无需额外外部信息的情况下促进识别。基于这些识别结果，我们提出了易于实施的一致GMM和2SLS估计量。我们的结果通过蒙特卡洛模拟加以说明。

records.title_en: Real-time monitoring for stock return predictability in nonstationary volatility environments
records.title_cn: 非平稳波动率环境下股票收益可预测性的实时监测
records.abstract_en: Stock return predictability, should it exist, is likely to be episodic in nature. In order to exploit such pockets of predictability it is essential that they are rapidly detected, in real-time, as the nascent predictive regime emerges. This will typically entail the repeated (sequential) application of one-shot end-of-sample predictability statistics, updated as new data become available. Consequently, in addition to dealing with the usual inference problems caused by unknown regressor persistence and predictive regression endogeneity, one must also account for the multiple testing issues inherent in such monitoring procedures. In addition, stock returns and/or the predictors commonly used typically exhibit time-varying volatility and it is known that ignoring such data features can result in the spurious detection of predictability. We propose real-time monitoring procedures which take account of these issues. Our preferred monitoring strategy uses a CUSUM-type procedure based on a specific moment condition related to the predictive power of the putative predictor. We implement nonparametric adjustment methods to allow for the possibility of time-varying volatility which do not require the practitioner to assume any particular parametric model for volatility. Monte Carlo simulations confirm that our proposed detection procedures display well-controlled false positive rates across a range of feasible volatility paths coupled with good power to rapidly detect an emerging predictive episode. The empirical relevance of our proposed monitoring strategy is illustrated in a pseudo real-time monitoring exercise using a well-known dataset of S&P 500 returns.
records.abstract_cn: 股票收益可预测性，如果存在的话，很可能在本质上是间歇性的。为了利用这些可预测性的窗口，至关重要的是在新生的预测机制出现时，能够实时地迅速检测到它们。这通常需要对一次性样本末端可预测性统计量进行重复（序贯）应用，并随着新数据的可用而更新。因此，除了处理由未知回归变量持续性和预测回归内生性引起的通常推断问题外，还必须考虑此类监测程序中固有的多重检验问题。此外，股票收益和/或常用的预测变量通常表现出时变波动率，并且已知忽略此类数据特征可能导致可预测性的虚假检测。我们提出了考虑这些问题的实时监测程序。我们偏好的监测策略使用基于与假定预测变量预测能力相关的特定矩条件的CUSUM型程序。我们实施非参数调整方法，以允许时变波动率的可能性，而不要求实践者假设任何特定的波动率参数模型。蒙特卡洛模拟证实，我们提出的检测程序在一系列可行的波动率路径上显示出良好控制的假阳性率，同时具有良好的功效来迅速检测新出现的预测期。我们提出的监测策略的经验相关性通过使用著名的S&P 500收益数据集的伪实时监测练习进行了说明。

records.title_en: Jackknife variance estimators for two-way clustering with serially correlated time effects
records.title_cn: 具有序列相关时间效应的双向聚类中的刀切方差估计量
records.abstract_en: Chiang et al. (2024) and Chen and Vogelsang (2024) developed cluster-robust variance estimators (CRVEs) for linear regressions with two-way clustered data allowing for arbitrary serial dependence. However, conventional CRVEs can perform poorly in finite samples. We propose jackknife CRVEs and establish their theoretical validity. Our theoretical and simulation results demonstrate several advantages of the proposed procedures. First, the jackknife CRVE delivers more reliable finite-sample inference than the conventional two-way CRVE. Second, it avoids undefined standard errors arising from non-positive definite CRVEs. Third, in a benchmark setting, it is never downward biased. Finally, when the limiting distribution may be non-Gaussian, the proposed max-jackknife test remains asymptotically conservative.
records.abstract_cn: Chiang等（2024）以及Chen和Vogelsang（2024）为允许任意序列依赖的双向聚类数据的线性回归开发了聚类稳健方差估计量（CRVEs）。然而，传统CRVEs在有限样本中可能表现不佳。我们提出刀切CRVEs并建立其理论有效性。我们的理论和模拟结果展示了所提出程序的若干优势。第一，刀切CRVE比传统双向CRVE提供更可靠的有限样本推断。第二，它避免了由非正定CRVEs产生的未定义标准误。第三，在一个基准设定中，它从不会向下偏误。最后，当极限分布可能非高斯时，所提出的最大刀切检验保持渐近保守。

records.title_en: Robust estimation and inference for high-dimensional panel data models
records.title_cn: 高维面板数据模型的稳健估计与推断
records.abstract_en: This paper provides the relevant literature with a complete toolkit for conducting robust estimation and inference about the parameters of interest involved in a high-dimensional panel data framework. Specifically, (1) we allow for non-Gaussian, serially and cross-sectionally correlated and heteroskedastic error processes, (2) we develop an estimation method for the high-dimensional long-run covariance matrix using a thresholded estimator, (3) we also allow for the number of regressors to grow faster than the sample size.Methodologically and technically, we develop two Nagaev-type concentration inequalities: one for a partial sum and the other for a quadratic form, subject to a set of easily verifiable conditions. Leveraging these two inequalities, we derive a non-asymptotic bound for the LASSO estimator, achieve asymptotic normality via the node-wise LASSO regression, and establish a sharp convergence rate for the thresholded heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent (HAC) estimator.We demonstrate the practical relevance of these theoretical results by investigating a high-dimensional panel data model with interactive effects. Moreover, we conduct extensive numerical studies using simulated and real data examples.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为相关文献提供了一个完整的工具包，用于对高维面板数据框架中涉及的感兴趣参数进行稳健估计和推断。具体而言，(1) 我们允许非高斯、序列相关和横截面相关以及异方差误差过程，(2) 我们使用阈值估计量开发了一种高维长期协方差矩阵的估计方法，(3) 我们还允许回归变量数量增长快于样本量。在方法论和技术上，我们开发了两个Nagaev型集中不等式：一个用于部分和，另一个用于二次型，均在一组易于验证的条件下成立。利用这两个不等式，我们推导了LASSO估计量的非渐近界，通过逐节点LASSO回归实现了渐近正态性，并为阈值异方差和自相关一致（HAC）估计量建立了尖锐的收敛速度。我们通过研究一个具有交互效应的高维面板数据模型来展示这些理论结果的实际相关性。此外，我们使用模拟和真实数据示例进行了广泛的数值研究。

records.title_en: Panel data models with interactive fixed effects and (relatively) small T
records.title_cn: 具有交互固定效应和（相对）小T的面板数据模型
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the estimation of a linear panel data model with interactive fixed effects. A transformation is introduced which, after having been applied, renders the least squares (LS) estimator of Bai (2009) consistent and asymptotically unbiased when n is large and T is fixed. This is termed the transformed least squares (TLS) estimator. Going further, these properties are shown to also carry over to the large n, large T setting, provided T/n → 0. This contrasts sharply with the usual case, where the LS estimator is, in general, inconsistent when n is large and T is fixed, and is asymptotically biased when both n and T are large.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有交互固定效应的线性面板数据模型的估计。引入了一种变换，在应用该变换后，当n大且T固定时，Bai（2009）的最小二乘（LS）估计量变得一致且渐近无偏。这被称为变换最小二乘（TLS）估计量。进一步，这些性质被证明在n大、T也大的情形下同样成立，只要T/n → 0。这与通常情形形成鲜明对比，在通常情形下，当n大且T固定时，LS估计量一般不一致，而当n和T都大时，则具有渐近偏差。

records.title_en: Treatment evaluation at the intensive and extensive margins
records.title_cn: 在集约边际和广延边际上的处理效应评估
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a solution to the evaluation of treatment effects in selective samples when neither instruments nor parametric assumptions are available. We provide sharp bounds for average treatment effects under a conditional monotonicity assumption for all principal strata, i.e. units characterizing the complete intensive and extensive margins. Most importantly, we allow for a large share of units whose selection is indifferent to treatment, e.g. due to non-compliance. The existence of such a population is crucially tied to the regularity of sharp population bounds and thus conventional asymptotic inference for methods such as Lee bounds can be misleading. This problem can be solved using smoothed outer identification regions for inference. We provide semiparametrically efficient debiased machine learning estimators for both regular and smooth bounds that can accommodate high-dimensional covariates and flexible functional forms. Our study of active labor market policy reveals the empirical prevalence of the aforementioned indifference population and supports results from previous impact analyses under much weaker assumptions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为在既无工具变量也无参数假设可用时，选择性样本中处理效应的评估提供了一种解决方案。我们在对所有主层（即刻画完整集约边际和广延边际的单元）的条件单调性假设下，提供了平均处理效应的尖锐界。最重要的是，我们允许存在很大比例的单元，其选择对处理无差异，例如由于不依从。此类总体的存在与尖锐总体界的正则性密切相关，因此诸如Lee界之类方法的传统渐近推断可能产生误导。该问题可通过使用平滑外识别区域进行推断来解决。我们为规则界和平滑界提供了半参数有效的去偏机器学习估计量，能够容纳高维协变量和灵活的函数形式。我们对积极劳动力市场政策的研究揭示了上述无差异总体在经验上的普遍性，并在弱得多的假设下支持了先前影响分析的结果。

records.title_en: Nonparametric identification of first-price auction with unobserved competition: A density discontinuity framework
records.title_cn: 未观测竞争下第一价格拍卖的非参数识别：一个密度断点框架
records.abstract_en: We consider nonparametric identification of independent private value first-price auction models, in which the analyst only observes winning bids. Our benchmark model assumes an exogenous number of bidders N. We show that, if the bidders observe N, the resulting discontinuities in the winning bid density can be used to identify the distribution of N. The private value distribution can be nonparametrically identified in a second step. This extends, under testable identification conditions, to the case where N is a number of potential buyers, who bid with some unknown probability. Identification also holds in presence of additive unobserved heterogeneity drawn from some parametric distributions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑独立私人价值第一价格拍卖模型的非参数识别，其中分析者仅观测到中标出价。我们的基准模型假设投标人数N为外生。我们证明，如果投标人观测到N，则中标出价密度中由此产生的断点可用于识别N的分布。私人价值分布可在第二步中非参数识别。在可检验的识别条件下，这扩展到N为潜在买家数量、他们以某个未知概率投标的情形。在存在来自某些参数分布的加性未观测异质性时，识别同样成立。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Noise and Learning: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 噪声与学习：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite high noise pollution, empirical research on the impact of noise on learning in developing economies has been sparse. We investigate this question by analyzing spatial and temporal variation in noise pollution recorded by monitoring stations in India and academic performance in high-stakes Class 12 examinations across schools. We find that a 10-percentage-point increase in noisy days during the exam quarter is associated with a 2.3% increase in the failure rate of Class 12 boys. This pattern is not gender neutral, as no association between noise pollution and failure rate is observed for girls. We do not find any effect of noise pollution recorded during non-exam months. By documenting how noise pollution hinders learning in India and shedding light on cognitive burden explanation, our study highlights an overlooked threat to human capital accumulation in developing economies and underscores the importance of integrating noise pollution mitigation strategies into education and urban policies.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管噪声污染严重，但关于噪声对发展中经济体学习影响的实证研究一直较为稀少。我们通过分析印度监测站记录的噪声污染在空间和时间上的变化，以及各学校高利害关系Class 12考试中的学业表现，来研究这一问题。我们发现，考试季度内噪声天数增加10个百分点，与Class 12男生失败率上升2.3%相关。这一模式并非性别中性，因为未观察到噪声污染与女生失败率之间的关联。我们未发现非考试月份记录的噪声污染有任何影响。通过记录噪声污染如何阻碍印度的学习，并揭示认知负担解释，我们的研究凸显了发展中经济体人力资本积累中一个被忽视的威胁，并强调了将噪声污染缓解策略纳入教育和城市政策的重要性。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Increasing Household Waste Segregation Rates in the Presence of a Segregated Collection Service: A Randomized Controlled Trial in India
records.title_cn: 在存在分类收集服务的情况下提高家庭垃圾分类率：印度的一项随机对照试验
records.abstract_en: Proper waste management is an increasingly important challenge in developing countries, and waste segregation at source is a critical step toward greater efficiency and smaller environmental impacts. This study presents the results of a field experiment in India, examining whether and how a household campaign can change households’ waste segregation behavior in the presence of a reliable segregated collection service. The campaign has two variants: (1) a one-shot household campaign providing an information brochure and a bucket and (2) the same one-shot campaign enhanced by weekly reminders. We find that, with a reliable collection service in place, a household campaign providing information brochures and buckets increases the waste segregation rate by 45 percentage points, and the “campaign plus reminders” treatment increases the segregation rate by 60 percentage points. We show that a low-cost, soft-touch household campaign can quickly and significantly increase waste segregation when a reliable segregated collection service exists.
records.abstract_cn: 适当的废物管理是发展中国家日益重要的挑战，而源头垃圾分类是提高效率和减少环境影响的关键一步。本研究呈现了印度一项实地实验的结果，考察在存在可靠的分类收集服务的情况下，家庭宣传活动能否以及如何改变家庭的垃圾分类行为。该宣传活动有两种变体：（1）一次性家庭宣传活动，提供信息手册和一个桶；（2）相同的一次性宣传活动，但增加了每周提醒。我们发现，在存在可靠收集服务的情况下，提供信息手册和桶的家庭宣传活动使垃圾分类率提高了45个百分点，而“宣传加提醒”处理使分类率提高了60个百分点。我们表明，当存在可靠的分类收集服务时，低成本、温和的家庭宣传活动能够快速且显著地提高垃圾分类率。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: The Impact of Offshoring and Import Competition on Carbon Emissions
records.title_cn: 离岸外包与进口竞争对碳排放的影响
records.abstract_en: We use Danish firm-level data to jointly examine the causal effects of offshoring and Chinese import competition on carbon emissions, output, and the emission intensity of output. Offshoring reduces firms’ emission intensity but also increases their production such that firm-level emissions do not change. Chinese import competition reduces firms’ production and their emission intensity. Next, we apply our firm-level estimates in counterfactual decompositions and in the computation of emission-leakage rates. The resulting evidence shows that offshoring leads to cleaner production in the manufacturing sector while import competition from China mostly leads to more emissions abroad.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用丹麦企业层面数据，联合考察离岸外包和中国进口竞争对碳排放、产出和产出排放强度的因果效应。离岸外包降低了企业的排放强度，但也增加了其生产，因此企业层面排放没有变化。中国进口竞争降低了企业的生产及其排放强度。接下来，我们将企业层面估计应用于反事实分解和排放泄漏率的计算。由此得到的证据表明，离岸外包导致制造业部门的生产更清洁，而来自中国的进口竞争主要导致国外排放增加。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Energy Efficiency Dynamics and Climate Policy
records.title_cn: 能源效率动态与气候政策
records.abstract_en: We study the effectiveness of climate change mitigation policies in reducing carbon emissions, focusing on the channel of economy-wide energy efficiency. Using US data, we estimate an impulse response function (IRF) that characterizes how energy efficiency responds to energy price shocks. Standard climate-economy models cannot replicate the slow transition dynamics observed in the data. We build a tractable model that nests the existing literature and can closely replicate the empirical IRF. The slow dynamics in our model imply that carbon taxes reduce short-run and cumulative emissions less than predicted by standard models. The slow dynamics also imply that higher carbon taxes and greater reductions in output are needed to achieve a given environmental target.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究气候变化减缓政策在减少碳排放方面的有效性，重点关注经济整体能源效率这一渠道。利用美国数据，我们估计了一个脉冲响应函数（IRF），刻画能源效率如何对能源价格冲击作出反应。标准气候-经济模型无法复制数据中观察到的缓慢转型动态。我们构建了一个可处理的模型，该模型嵌套了现有文献，并能够紧密复制实证IRF。我们模型中的缓慢动态意味着，碳税减少短期和累积排放的程度低于标准模型的预测。缓慢动态还意味着，要实现给定的环境目标，需要更高的碳税和更大的产出削减。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: The Potential of Carbon Border Adjustments to Foster Climate Cooperation
records.title_cn: 碳边境调整促进气候合作的潜力
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the potential of the European Union’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (EU CBAM) to foster a climate coalition. Using a general equilibrium quantitative trade model to evaluate the payoffs of a coalition formation game, we find that the EU CBAM motivates the adoption of carbon pricing in four countries. This results in a 73% greater reduction in global emissions compared to a scenario in which only the EU prices carbon, with the coalition-building effect outweighing the direct anti-leakage effect of the CBAM. This effect holds across a broad range of policy designs and modeling assumptions. The size of the induced climate coalition varies strongly with trade elasticities and marginally with input substitutability. Next to the carbon price level, the CBAM implementation plays a decisive role: a CBAM that covers more products or indirect emissions leads to larger coalitions. By contrast, introducing export rebates renders the coalition unattractive.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了欧盟碳边境调整机制（EU CBAM）促进气候联盟的潜力。使用一般均衡定量贸易模型来评估联盟形成博弈的收益，我们发现EU CBAM激励了四个国家采用碳定价。与只有欧盟对碳定价的情景相比，这使得全球排放量额外减少了73%，联盟构建效应超过了CBAM的直接反泄漏效应。这一效应在广泛的政策设计和建模假设下均成立。所诱导的气候联盟规模随贸易弹性强烈变化，并随投入品可替代性边际变化。除碳价格水平外，CBAM的实施也起着决定性作用：覆盖更多产品或间接排放的CBAM会导致更大的联盟。相比之下，引入出口退税使联盟变得缺乏吸引力。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Electricity, Agricultural Productivity, and Deforestation: Evidence from Brazil
records.title_cn: 电力、农业生产率与森林砍伐：来自巴西的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of improved access to electricity on deforestation through the incentives it creates for farms to switch from cattle grazing to croplands. We generate a model that elucidates the conditions under which increases in agricultural productivity can increase the incentives to intensify rather than expand land use and examine the predictions of that model using county-level data from five waves of the Brazilian Census of Agriculture and satellite-based measures of land use. We estimate the impact of rural electrification in Brazil from 1960 to 2000 and the resulting increases in agricultural productivity. We show that locations suitable for hydropower generation experienced improvements in crop yields incentivizing credit-constrained farmers to shift away from land-intensive cattle grazing and into cropping. As a result, agricultural land use declined, more native vegetation was protected, and these effects persist 25 years later in both census and satellite data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察改善电力可及性通过为农场从放牧转向耕地所创造的激励对森林砍伐的影响。我们构建了一个模型，阐明农业生产率提高在何种条件下会增加集约化而非扩张土地利用的激励，并使用来自五轮巴西农业普查的县级数据和基于卫星的土地利用测量来检验该模型的预测。我们估计了巴西农村电气化从1960到2000的影响以及由此带来的农业生产率提高。我们表明，适合水力发电的地点经历了作物产量的改善，激励受信贷约束的农民从土地密集型的放牧转向种植。结果，农业土地利用下降，更多原生植被得到保护，且这些效应在25年后仍在普查和卫星数据中持续存在。

records.journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
records.title_en: Mismeasured and Misunderstood: Unmasking the Temperature Proxy Problem in Climate Impact Estimates
records.title_cn: 测量错误与理解偏差：揭示气候影响估计中的温度代理变量问题
records.abstract_en: Thousands of studies estimate climate change impacts related to temperature, but temperature is rarely measured at the exact location where impacts occur. Empirical work uses proxies such as closest station readings or estimates from gridded data products like PRISM. Measurement error introduced from this practice is routinely ignored. When acknowledged, it is typically assumed small in magnitude and classically (i.i.d. normal) distributed, implying that impact estimates are modestly attenuated toward zero. This assumption is formally examined by treating temperature readings at US weather stations as ground truth, then predicting daily mean temperature there using various proxies. This allows precise identification of measurement errors in an otherwise error-free relationship. The results contradict the standard assumption. These errors exhibit strong spatial and temporal components and, often, are large in magnitude. While proxy measurement errors typically cause downward bias, overestimates are common. Estimation problems are concentrated where attention focuses—the temperature distribution’s tails.
records.abstract_cn: 数千项研究估计与温度相关的气候变化影响，但温度很少在影响发生的精确位置被测量。实证研究使用诸如最近气象站读数或来自PRISM等网格化数据产品的估计值等代理变量。这种做法引入的测量误差通常被忽略。当被承认时，通常假定其幅度较小且为经典（i.i.d. 正态）分布，意味着影响估计会适度向零衰减。本文通过将美国气象站的温度读数视为地面真值，然后使用各种代理变量预测那里的日平均温度，对这一假设进行了正式检验。这使得能够在原本无误差的关系中精确识别测量误差。结果与标准假设相矛盾。这些误差表现出强烈的空间和时间成分，并且通常幅度很大。虽然代理测量误差通常导致向下偏误，但高估也很常见。估计问题集中在注意力聚焦之处——温度分布的尾部。

records.title_en: A Demand Theory of the Price Level
records.title_cn: 价格水平的需求理论
records.abstract_en: Heterogeneous agent incomplete markets models offer a new perspective on price and inflation determination. In contrast to complete markets, the price level is determined from the asset‐market clearing condition. Fiscal and monetary policy then jointly and uniquely determine the finite steady‐state price level and the inflation rate, including in a steady state in which the nominal interest rate is constant. Fiscal policy can determine the long‐run inflation rate for a fiscal rule which sets the growth rate of nominal government debt, whereas both fiscal and monetary policy determine the long‐run inflation rate under different tax rules.
records.abstract_cn: 异质性代理人不完全市场模型为价格和通货膨胀的决定提供了新的视角。与完全市场相比，价格水平由资产市场出清条件决定。财政和货币政策随后共同且唯一地决定有限的稳态价格水平和通货膨胀率，包括在名义利率恒定的稳态中。对于设定名义政府债务增长率的财政规则，财政政策可以决定长期通货膨胀率，而在不同的税收规则下，财政和货币政策共同决定长期通货膨胀率。

records.title_en: Do Parents Propagate Inequality Among Children? Evidence From Chinese and Swedish Twins
records.title_cn: 父母会在子女间传递不平等吗？来自中国和瑞典双胞胎的证据
records.abstract_en: Economists have long studied how parental behavior shapes within‐family inequality, yet empirical findings remain mixed. Using twins data from China and Sweden, we examine the predominant mechanisms reported in the literature. Parents in both countries invest similarly during childhood. Inter vivos transfers, however, differ: Chinese parents reinforce income inequality, whereas Swedish parents distribute wealth equally; the reinforcing pattern reflects exchange motives. Bequests are divided equally in both countries. Parental education plays a key role: less educated parents reinforce income inequality, whereas more educated parents transfer wealth equally. Cross‐country differences in parental education may thus help explain the mixed findings.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家长期研究父母行为如何塑造家庭内部不平等，但实证发现仍不一致。我们使用来自中国和瑞典的双胞胎数据，检验文献中报告的主要机制。两国父母在童年时期的投资相似。然而，生前转移有所不同：中国父母强化收入不平等，而瑞典父母平等分配财富；强化模式反映了交换动机。两国的遗赠均被平等分配。父母教育发挥关键作用：受教育程度较低的父母强化收入不平等，而受教育程度较高的父母平等转移财富。因此，父母教育的跨国差异可能有助于解释这些不一致的发现。

records.title_en: Accounting for the Evolution of China's Production and Trade Patterns
records.title_cn: 解释中国生产与贸易模式的演变
records.abstract_en: We study the evolution of China's production and trade patterns during its integration into the global economy. Using firm‐level microdata, we document how production and exports shifted across industries and within industries across firms. We quantify a Ricardian–Heckscher–Ohlin model with heterogeneous firms to account for these changes. Counterfactuals show capital deepening pushed China's production and exports toward greater capital intensity, while labor‐biased productivity growth provided an offsetting force. The model generates an inverted‐U pattern in China's trade openness—peaking in the mid‐2000s and declining through the 2020s—alongside a continuous rise in the world's exposure to Chinese exports.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中国融入全球经济过程中生产与贸易模式的演变。利用企业层面微观数据，我们记录了生产和出口如何在行业之间以及行业内部不同企业之间转移。我们量化了一个包含异质性企业的李嘉图-赫克歇尔-俄林模型来解释这些变化。反事实表明，资本深化推动中国的生产和出口向更高的资本密集度转变，而劳动偏向型生产率增长提供了抵消力量。该模型生成了中国贸易开放度的倒U型模式——在2000中期达到峰值，并在2020期间下降——同时世界对中国出口的暴露度持续上升。

records.title_en: Place‐Based Land Policy and Spatial Misallocation: Theory and Evidence From China
records.title_cn: 基于土地的政策与空间错配：来自中国的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate a land policy in China that allocated more urban land quotas to underdeveloped regions to reduce regional gaps. Empirically, the policy decreased productivity in eastern areas relative to the inland. A spatial equilibrium model with migration, land quota constraints, and agglomeration shows the policy distorts labor and production across regions, causing substantial output losses. Though regional gaps narrowed, workers from underdeveloped areas migrated less and earned less. Without the policy, national output would have been 1.8% higher, and workers in underdeveloped areas would have earned 1.6% more in 2010. Regional transfers offer a less distortionary alternative for reducing inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中国的一项土地政策，该政策向欠发达地区分配了更多的城市土地配额，以缩小区域差距。从经验上看，该政策降低了东部地区相对于内陆地区的生产率。一个包含迁移、土地配额约束和集聚效应的空间均衡模型表明，该政策扭曲了区域间的劳动力和生产，造成了巨大的产出损失。尽管区域差距缩小了，但来自欠发达地区的工人迁移更少，收入也更低。如果没有该政策，全国产出会高出1.8%，欠发达地区的工人收入会高出1.6%，在2010。区域转移支付为减少不平等提供了一种扭曲性较小的替代方案。

records.title_en: How Does Progressivity Affect the Tax Cut Multiplier?
records.title_cn: 累进性如何影响减税乘数？
records.abstract_en: How does the targeting of personal income tax cuts affect the output multiplier? This paper provides quantitative evidence using a heterogeneous‐agent New‐Keynesian model calibrated to match US distributions of income, wealth, marginal tax rates, and marginal propensities to consume. Labor supply is determined by household preferences on the intensive margin and search frictions on the extensive margin. The model evaluates tax cuts for the bottom‐90 (B90%) and top‐10% of the income distribution in national and cross‐region settings, replicating influential empirical research designs. B90 tax cuts generate larger output effects while incentive effects play a central role in transmission.
records.abstract_cn: 个人所得税减税的靶向性如何影响产出乘数？本文使用一个异质性主体新凯恩斯模型提供定量证据，该模型经校准以匹配美国的收入、财富、边际税率和边际消费倾向分布。劳动供给由家庭在集约边际上的偏好和广延边际上的搜寻摩擦决定。该模型在全国和跨区域设定中评估了对收入分布底部90（B90%）和顶部10%的减税，复现了有影响力的实证研究设计。B90减税产生更大的产出效应，而激励效应在传导中发挥核心作用。

records.title_en: The Short and the Long of It: Stock‐Flow Matching in the US Housing Market
records.title_cn: 长短之间：美国住房市场中的存量-流量匹配
records.abstract_en: From 2006 until 2020, the probability of selling a house in the U.S. declined sharply after listing for 2 weeks. Moreover, sales within the first 2 weeks of listing (“quick sales”) and sales happening afterward (“slow sales”) behaved differently over the housing cycle. The probability and associated price of a quick sale recovered from the slump sooner, faster, and more prominently than a slow sale. This paper demonstrates that a calibrated stock‐flow matching model not only generates quantitatively consistent sales, prices, listings, and time on the market but also captures distinctions between fast and slow sales over the housing cycle.
records.abstract_cn: 从2006到2020，美国房屋在挂牌2周后售出的概率急剧下降。此外，在挂牌最初2周内完成的销售（“快速销售”）与之后发生的销售（“缓慢销售”）在住房周期中表现不同。快速销售的概率及相关价格从低迷中恢复得更早、更快、更显著，而缓慢销售则不然。本文表明，一个校准的存量-流量匹配模型不仅能生成在数量上一致的销售量、价格、挂牌量和市场停留时间，还能捕捉住房周期中快速销售与缓慢销售之间的差异。

records.title_en: The Decentralization of Liquor Policies in Texas During the Post‐Prohibition Era
records.title_cn: 后禁酒时代德克萨斯州酒类政策的分权化
records.abstract_en: We examine the decentralization of liquor policies in Texas during the Post‐Prohibition era using newly collected historical legislative roll call data. By combining these data with local referendum vote shares, we analyze both legislators' and constituents' preferences on liquor policy. We develop a probabilistic voting model incorporating spillovers and peer effects. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity in preferences among voters, reflecting differing attitudes toward alcohol regulation. Spillover effects are significant, yet the model predicts notable gains from decentralization. Finally, we link legislators' policy preferences to alcohol consumption data and compare model‐based welfare estimates with traditional consumption‐based measures.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用新收集的历史立法点名投票数据，考察后禁酒时代德克萨斯州酒类政策的分权化。通过将这些数据与地方公投得票份额相结合，我们分析了立法者和选民在酒类政策上的偏好。我们构建了一个纳入溢出效应和同伴效应的概率投票模型。结果显示，选民偏好存在显著异质性，反映出对酒精监管的不同态度。溢出效应显著，但模型预测分权化会带来显著收益。最后，我们将立法者的政策偏好与酒精消费数据相联系，并将基于模型的福利估计与传统的基于消费的度量进行比较。

records.title_en: Labor Market Monopsony Power and the Dynamic Gains to Openness Reforms
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场买方垄断势力与开放改革的动态收益
records.abstract_en: We embed labor market monopsony into a dynamic heterogeneous‐firm general equilibrium model with exporting, horizontal FDI, and rich firm lifecycle dynamics. Rising marginal costs with monopsony slow and limit incumbent firm growth in response to liberalization, shifting adjustment to the extensive margin. Calibrated to US micro data, welfare gains from tariff reduction are over four times larger under monopsony than with perfect labor markets. The difference is mostly driven by new exporter creation and firm entry along the transition path. By contrast, lowering outward FDI taxes gives powerful quantitative welfare losses under monopsony, as firms undertake FDI to escape domestic wage pressure.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将劳动力市场买方垄断嵌入一个包含出口、水平FDI和丰富企业生命周期动态的动态异质性企业一般均衡模型。在买方垄断下，边际成本上升会减缓并限制现有企业在自由化后的增长，使调整转向广延边际。根据美国微观数据校准，在买方垄断下，关税削减带来的福利收益是完美劳动力市场下的四倍以上。这一差异主要由新出口商创建和转型路径上的企业进入驱动。相比之下，在买方垄断下，降低对外FDI税会带来巨大的定量福利损失，因为企业进行FDI以逃避国内工资压力。

records.title_en: The Interaction Between Credit and Labor Market Frictions
records.title_cn: 信贷与劳动力市场摩擦之间的相互作用
records.abstract_en: I study a novel two‐way feedback between credit and labor market frictions. Running from credit to labor markets, amplitude in capital demand caused by collateral constraints spills over onto labor demand due to the complementarity of capital and labor; and, furthermore, credit frictions raise effective financial hiring costs, prompting firms to delay hiring in recessions. Running back from labor to credit markets, search frictions imply that wages move less than one‐to‐one with productivity; this induces greater volatility of net worth, via the wage bill, which then spills over onto capital demand. Together, these considerably amplify labor and capital market dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究信贷与劳动力市场摩擦之间一种新颖的双向反馈。从信贷市场到劳动力市场，由于资本与劳动的互补性，抵押品约束引起的资本需求波动会溢出到劳动力需求；此外，信贷摩擦提高了有效财务招聘成本，促使企业在衰退中推迟招聘。从劳动力市场回到信贷市场，搜寻摩擦意味着工资随生产率的变动小于一比一；这通过工资总额导致净值波动更大，进而溢出到资本需求。这些共同显著放大了劳动力和资本市场动态。

records.title_en: Gender Criteria Gap in Evaluation: Role of Perceived Intentions and Outcomes
records.title_cn: 评价中的性别标准差距：感知意图与结果的作用
records.abstract_en: We investigate whether different criteria are used in evaluating male and female leaders when outcomes are determined by unobservable choices and luck. Evaluators form beliefs about leaders’ choices (perceived intentions) and make discretionary payments. We find that while payments to male leaders are determined by both outcomes and perceived intentions, those to female leaders are determined by outcomes only. We label this new source of gender bias as the gender criteria gap. Our findings imply that high outcomes are necessary for women to get bonuses, but men can receive bonuses for low outcomes if evaluators hold them in high regard.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究当结果由不可观察的选择和运气决定时，评价男性和女性领导者是否使用不同的标准。评价者形成关于领导者选择的信念（感知意图）并做出自由裁量的支付。我们发现，对男性领导者的支付由结果和感知意图共同决定，而对女性领导者的支付仅由结果决定。我们将这一新的性别偏见来源称为性别标准差距。我们的发现意味着，女性获得奖金必须有高结果，但如果评价者高度认可男性，男性即使结果低也能获得奖金。

records.title_en: What Determines State Heterogeneity in Response to U.S. Tariff Changes?
records.title_cn: 什么决定了各州对美国关税变化的异质性反应？
records.abstract_en: We develop a structural framework to identify the sources of cross‐state heterogeneity in response to U.S. tariff changes. A unilateral 25‐percentage‐point U.S. tariff increase across sectors induces consumption changes ranging from −0.8% in Oregon to 2.3% in Montana. This variation stems from the interaction between states' internal comparative advantage and the nation's external comparative advantage. Factor mobility lowers aggregate consumption and reshapes the cross‐state impacts by shifting resources toward more distorted states and sectors. Consequently, preferred tariff changes vary systematically across states, necessitating transfers to align regional policy incentives. Foreign retaliation reduces aggregate gains while perpetuating cross‐state variation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个结构性框架，以识别各州对美国关税变化反应的异质性来源。美国各部门单边关税提高25个百分点，引起的消费变化从俄勒冈州的−0.8%到蒙大拿州的2.3%不等。这种差异源于各州内部比较优势与国家外部比较优势之间的相互作用。要素流动降低了总消费，并通过将资源转向扭曲更严重的州和部门，重塑了跨州影响。因此，各州偏好的关税变化存在系统性差异，需要转移支付来协调区域政策激励。外国报复减少了总收益，同时使跨州差异持续存在。

records.title_en: College Loans and Human Capital Investment
records.title_cn: 大学贷款与人力资本投资
records.abstract_en: College loans facilitate access to education, but the repayment burden may distort posteducation human capital investment. We examine the role of college loans and loan repayment policies through a structural model of individuals' dynamic decisions on borrowing/saving, labor supply, and costly human capital investment. We estimate two versions of the model using data from NLSY79: one with natural borrowing limits and another with parameterized limits. Counterfactual simulations suggest that, relative to the standard fixed repayment plan, income‐driven repayment (IDR) plans modestly increase educational attainment, lifetime earnings, and individual welfare; accounting for lifetime income taxes, they also increase government revenue.
records.abstract_cn: 大学贷款促进了教育机会，但还款负担可能扭曲教育后的人力资本投资。我们通过一个关于个人在借贷/储蓄、劳动供给和有成本的人力资本投资方面动态决策的结构模型，考察大学贷款和贷款还款政策的作用。我们使用来自NLSY79的数据估计了两个版本的模型：一个具有自然借贷限制，另一个具有参数化限制。反事实模拟表明，相对于标准的固定还款计划，收入驱动还款（IDR）计划适度提高了教育程度、终身收入和个体福利；在考虑终身所得税后，它们还增加了政府收入。

records.title_en: Rational Expectations Fools' Bubbles
records.title_cn: 理性预期的愚人泡沫
records.abstract_en: We develop a rational, Walrasian model of speculative bubbles inspired by the Kindleberger–Minsky view, which describes bubbles as wave‐like market processes. Touched off by an initial shock, price booms are initially self‐reinforcing but become self‐destructive later when prices surpass fundamental value. Previous models in this vein have been criticized due to ad hoc features, such as prices driven by behavioral forces or particular trading protocols. Our model allays these concerns by relying only on multidimensional uncertainty to prevent unraveling via backward induction. Standard market clearing, moreover, makes the model more compatible with established macroeconomic and asset pricing frameworks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们受Kindleberger–Minsky观点启发，构建了一个理性的瓦尔拉斯投机泡沫模型，该观点将泡沫描述为波浪式的市场过程。在初始冲击的触发下，价格繁荣起初是自我强化的，但当价格超过基本面价值后，后期会变为自我毁灭的。此前这类模型因临时性特征而受到批评，例如价格由行为力量或特定交易协议驱动。我们的模型通过仅依赖多维不确定性来防止逆向归纳导致的瓦解，从而缓解了这些担忧。此外，标准市场出清使该模型与既有的宏观经济和资产定价框架更加兼容。

records.title_en: Entry and Welfare in General Equilibrium With Heterogeneous Firms and Endogenous Markups
records.title_cn: 异质性企业与内生加成的一般均衡中的进入与福利
records.abstract_en: We analyze market entry efficiency in single‐ and two‐sector closed‐economy Melitz–Ottaviano (MO) models without an outside good. Comparing market and second‐best outcomes, we find that market entry is efficient in the single‐sector model. This efficiency also holds in a symmetric two‐sector setting. When sectors have asymmetric demand and the level of asymmetry is sufficiently small, the market yields excessive entry into the “high‐demand” sector. This inefficiency arises from the presence of an additional aggregator in MO preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在没有外部商品的单部门和两部门封闭经济Melitz–Ottaviano（MO）模型中的市场进入效率。比较市场结果与次优结果，我们发现单部门模型中市场进入是有效率的。这种效率在对称的两部门设定中也成立。当部门间需求不对称且不对称程度足够小时，市场会导致对“高需求”部门的过度进入。这种无效率源于MO偏好中额外聚合器的存在。

records.title_en: Entrepreneurship and Financial Deregulation
records.title_cn: 创业与金融放松管制
records.abstract_en: We quantitatively analyze the impact of US banking deregulation in the 1980s on the aggregate economy. Using recent econometric techniques, we first reexamine existing empirical evidence on the real effects of banking deregulation. We then construct a quantitative model that integrates imperfectly competitive banks into a general equilibrium framework of firm dynamics and occupational choice. Consistent with the empirical evidence, deregulation significantly increases output growth and firm entry. Increased competition among banks and the entrepreneurs' occupational choices play an important role in shaping the economy's response to deregulation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们定量分析了美国银行业在1980的放松管制对总体经济的影响。使用近期的计量经济学技术，我们首先重新检验了关于银行业放松管制实际效应的现有经验证据。然后，我们构建了一个定量模型，将不完全竞争的银行融入企业动态和职业选择的一般均衡框架。与经验证据一致，放松管制显著提高了产出增长和企业进入。银行间竞争的加剧以及企业家的职业选择在塑造经济对放松管制的反应中发挥了重要作用。

records.title_en: Money Shortages and Complementary Currencies in Small Local Economies
records.title_cn: 小型地方经济中的货币短缺与补充货币
records.abstract_en: This paper rationalizes the adoption of a complementary currency (CC) in a small, local economy. A local money shortage occurs when the supply of official currency, determined endogenously by trade with a larger economy, falls short of the liquidity needed for first‐best activity. A CC then supplements liquidity and boosts local trade at the expense of external trade; the welfare‐maximizing CC supply is strictly positive. A calibration to coca‐growing villages in Colombia, where coca‐base circulates as a local CC, suggests its liquidity role raises local trade by roughly a third.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为小型地方经济中采用补充货币（CC）提供了理性解释。当官方货币的供给——由与更大规模经济的贸易内生决定——低于实现最优活动所需的流动性时，就会出现地方货币短缺。此时，CC 补充流动性，并以牺牲外部贸易为代价促进本地贸易；使福利最大化的 CC 供给严格为正。对哥伦比亚古柯种植村庄的校准——当地古柯膏作为地方 CC 流通——表明其流动性作用使本地贸易提高约三分之一。

records.title_en: Stochastic sequential screening
records.title_cn: 随机序贯筛选
records.abstract_en: We study a sequential screening model with discrete ex ante types and continuously distributed ex post values. The approach — solving a relaxed problem by pointwise maximization and focusing on deterministic cutoffs — relies on strong regularity conditions and can fail when they are violated. We develop an alternative method that retains local incentive constraints, allowing deterministic and stochastic mechanisms, and derive surplus-to-slack ratio tests that identify each case. We propose the weak alignment condition, a strengthening of first-order stochastic dominance that guarantees stochastic allocations respect global incentive constraints, and the strong alignment condition, under which the gap between deterministic and stochastic conditions closes. We extend the analysis to a continuum of types and solve for optimal mechanisms in the three-type case under additional shape restrictions on the surplus-to-slack ratios. Our results show that randomization can be essential and tractable in optimal dynamic mechanisms when regularity fails.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个具有离散事前类型和连续分布事后价值的序贯筛选模型。该方法——通过逐点最大化求解松弛问题并聚焦于确定性截止值——依赖于强正则性条件，当这些条件被违反时可能失效。我们提出一种替代方法，保留局部激励约束，允许确定性和随机机制，并推导出识别每种情况的盈余与松弛比率检验。我们提出弱对齐条件，这是对一阶随机占优的强化，保证随机分配满足全局激励约束，以及强对齐条件，在该条件下确定性与随机条件之间的差距消失。我们将分析扩展到连续统类型，并在对盈余与松弛比率的额外形状限制下求解三种类型情况下的最优机制。我们的结果表明，当正则性失效时，随机化在最优动态机制中可能是必要且可处理的。

records.title_en: Elections with job-motivated bureaucrats
records.title_cn: 具有工作动机官僚的选举
records.abstract_en: Bureaucratic voters are guided both by their preferences over public goods and by their job motivation: they bear costs from policies that downsize the government workforce. Job-motivated voters lead to (i) nonexistence of Condorcet-winning platforms in the short run, and (ii) bureaucratic persistence in the long run: equilibrium outcomes converge to alternations around at most two platforms, in which parties compete over the scale of public investment but keep the size of the bureaucracy fixed. Long-run bureaucracies are never smaller than the ideal bureaucracy of median private sector workers, and parties typically underinvest, so that public goods production is inefficient.
records.abstract_cn: 官僚选民既受其对公共品的偏好引导，也受其工作动机引导：他们承担缩减政府劳动力规模的政策所带来的成本。具有工作动机的选民导致（i）短期内不存在孔多塞获胜平台，以及（ii）长期内官僚持续性：均衡结果收敛于围绕至多两个平台的交替，其中政党围绕公共投资规模竞争，但保持官僚机构规模固定。长期官僚机构规模从不小于中位私营部门工人的理想官僚机构规模，且政党通常投资不足，因此公共品生产是无效率的。

records.title_en: Regulating investments when both costs and need are private
records.title_cn: 当成本和需求均为私人信息时的投资监管
records.abstract_en: Large-scale infrastructure investments are often carried out in settings where their eventual usefulness or importance is difficult to predict. This paper studies optimal incentives for investment when the agent undertaking the investment has superior information on two dimensions: the cost of investment and the likelihood it is useful or beneficial to the principal. Usefulness eventually becomes public, but punishments are limited as the regulator aims at ensuring the agent earns non-negative profits irrespective of eventual usefulness. We characterize the optimal screening mechanism and show that the optimal mechanism depends heavily on the degree of asymmetric information about usefulness. When the asymmetry of information about usefulness is severe, the optimal mechanism can feature upward distortions in investment and rent for all agent types.
records.abstract_cn: 大规模基础设施投资往往在最终有用性或重要性难以预测的环境中进行。本文研究了当进行投资的代理人拥有两个维度上的优势信息时的最优投资激励：投资成本以及投资对委托人有用或有益的可能性。有用性最终会公开，但由于监管者旨在确保代理人无论最终有用性如何都能获得非负利润，惩罚是有限的。我们刻画了最优筛选机制，并表明最优机制在很大程度上取决于关于有用性的信息不对称程度。当关于有用性的信息不对称严重时，最优机制可能表现为对所有代理人类型的投资和租金向上扭曲。

records.title_en: Legitimate decision authority and motivation in organizations
records.title_cn: 组织中的合法决策权威与动机
records.abstract_en: The allocation of decision rights—and the decision hierarchies it creates—shape incentives in organizations and thus individual motivation. We study whether the motivational effects of decision hierarchies go beyond pecuniary incentives and how they relate to the perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy. In a laboratory experiment, we exogenously manipulate the payoff structure of an organization in a way that leaves the pecuniary incentives of all involved parties unaffected but shifts subordinates’ perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy. Our data show that subordinates’ motivation to provide effort is causally affected by the organizational payoff structure, and significantly associated with the perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy.
records.abstract_cn: 决策权的分配——及其所创造的决策层级——塑造了组织中的激励，从而影响个人动机。我们研究决策层级的动机效应是否超越金钱激励，以及它们如何与决策层级的感知合法性相关。在一项实验室实验中，我们外生地操纵组织的支付结构，其方式使所有相关方的金钱激励不受影响，但改变了下属对决策层级合法性的感知。我们的数据表明，下属提供努力的动机受到组织支付结构的因果影响，并与决策层级的感知合法性显著相关。

records.title_en: Motivation complementarities in prosocial behavior: Evidence from social networks of blood donors
records.title_cn: 亲社会行为中的动机互补性：来自献血者社交网络的证据
records.abstract_en: If individuals’ prosocial motivations are complements, this creates an important lever for the provision of social capital. We develop a framework to identify motivation complementarities and apply it in the context of voluntary blood donations—a key example of a purely prosocial behavior. Using quasi-random phone calls to identify causal effects, we find that a 10 percentage point increase in the donation rate for a blood drive raises a focal donor’s turnout by about 5.6 percentage points, creating a policy multiplier of 2.3. We also rule out lower costs from joint traveling as the main driver of the motivation complementarities. Rather, they result, at least partly, from more general mechanisms, such as utility from social approval, peer pressure, or social image concerns.
records.abstract_cn: 如果个人的亲社会动机是互补的，这为提供社会资本创造了一个重要的杠杆。我们开发了一个识别动机互补性的框架，并将其应用于自愿献血的背景——这是纯粹亲社会行为的一个关键例子。利用准随机电话来识别因果效应，我们发现，一次献血活动的献血率提高10个百分点，会使一个焦点献血者的到场率提高约5.6个百分点，从而产生2.3的政策乘数。我们还排除了共同出行带来的更低成本作为动机互补性的主要驱动因素。相反，它们至少部分源于更一般的机制，例如来自社会认可、同伴压力或社会形象关注的效用。

records.title_en: Tournaments with managerial discretion
records.title_cn: 具有管理者自主权的锦标赛
records.abstract_en: We study tournaments with managerial discretion in hiring. A manager selects a coworker from a pool of candidates and then competes against him in a Lazear–Rosen–style tournament with a prize equal to a share of total output. A profit-maximizing principal sets the prize share together with a head start (or handicap)—an advantage (or disadvantage) in the output comparison—granted to the manager. The head start affects output through three channels: (i) encouraging the manager, (ii) discouraging the new hire, and (iii) inducing the manager to hire a stronger candidate. The hiring effect dominates the discouragement effect until the strongest candidate is hired; beyond that point, any further head start discourages the new hire more than it encourages the manager. The optimal contract therefore grants a head start just large enough to induce the manager to hire the strongest candidate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究在招聘中具有管理者自主权的锦标赛。管理者从候选人池中选择一位同事，然后在一场Lazear–Rosen式锦标赛中与其竞争，奖金等于总产出的一部分。追求利润最大化的委托人设定奖金份额以及给予管理者的先发优势（或劣势）——在产出比较中的一种优势（或劣势）。先发优势通过三个渠道影响产出：（i）激励管理者，（ii）抑制新员工，（iii）诱使管理者雇用更强的候选人。雇用效应在最强候选人被雇用之前主导抑制效应；超过该点后，任何进一步的先发优势对新员工的抑制都大于对管理者的激励。因此，最优合同给予的先发优势恰好大到足以诱使管理者雇用最强候选人。

records.title_en: Competing for power in multilateral negotiations under majority and unanimity rules
records.title_cn: 多数决与一致决规则下多边谈判中的权力竞争
records.abstract_en: Competition for power is a costly practice present in organizations and groups where collective decisions are made. In a multilateral bargaining experiment, we study how different agreement rules affect competition for power through a contest for the right to propose a distribution of benefits. Although unanimity leads to less wasteful competition investments, it also generates a greater delay in negotiations and a higher likelihood of disagreement. These opposing inefficiencies offset each other across a wide range of bargaining horizons, contest technologies, voting procedures, and subject pools. We find no statistically significant evidence of efficiency dominance by either rule over the parameters studied once competition for power is taken into account. Under equal proposal rights absent a contest, agreements are reached more quickly, demonstrating the causal effect of competition for power on bargaining gridlock and its compounding effect on efficiency losses. In addition, we find that bargaining behavior is conditioned on prior power-seeking efforts: subjects reward higher effort with higher shares, indicating that efforts enter fairness considerations despite their unproductive and competitive nature.
records.abstract_cn: 在集体决策的组织和群体中，权力竞争是一种代价高昂的实践。在一项多边讨价还价实验中，我们研究不同的协议规则如何通过争夺提出利益分配方案的权利来影响权力竞争。尽管一致决导致更少的浪费性竞争投资，但它也导致谈判中出现更大的延迟和更高的分歧可能性。在广泛的讨价还价期限、竞争技术、投票程序和受试者群体中，这些相反的低效率相互抵消。一旦将权力竞争纳入考虑，我们未发现在所研究的参数范围内任一规则具有效率优势的统计显著证据。在没有竞争的情况下，在平等的提案权下，协议达成得更快，这表明权力竞争对讨价还价僵局的因果效应及其对效率损失的复合效应。此外，我们发现讨价还价行为以先前的权力寻求努力为条件：受试者以更高的份额奖励更高的努力，表明努力进入了公平考量，尽管其具有非生产性和竞争性。

records.title_en: Eliciting moral preferences under image concerns: Theory and experiment
records.title_cn: 在形象关注下引出道德偏好：理论与实验
records.abstract_en: We analyze how the impact of image motives on behavior varies with two key features of the choice mechanism: single versus multiple decisions, and certainty versus uncertainty of consequences. Using direct elicitation (DE) versus multiple-price-list (MPL) or equivalently Becker-DeGroot-Marschak (BDM) schemes as exemplars, we develop a game-theoretic model to characterize how image-seeking inflates prosocial giving. The signaling bias (relative to true preferences) is shown to depend on the interaction between elicitation method and visibility level: it is greater under DE for low image concerns, and greater under MPL/BDM for high ones. We experimentally test the model’s predictions and find the predicted crossing effect.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析形象动机对行为的影响如何随选择机制的两个关键特征而变化：单一决策与多重决策，以及后果的确定性与不确定性。以直接引出法（DE）与多重价格列表法（MPL）或等价的Becker-DeGroot-Marschak（BDM）方案作为范例，我们构建了一个博弈论模型，以刻画寻求形象如何抬高亲社会给予。信号偏差（相对于真实偏好）被证明取决于引出方法与可见度水平之间的交互作用：在低形象关注下，DE下的偏差更大；在高形象关注下，MPL/BDM下的偏差更大。我们通过实验检验了模型的预测，并发现了所预测的交叉效应。

records.title_en: Multi-agent contract design with a budget
records.title_cn: 带预算的多智能体合同设计
records.abstract_en: We study a multi-agent contract design problem with moral hazard. In our model, each agent exerts costly effort towards an individual task at which it may either succeed or fail, and the principal, who wishes to encourage effort, has an exclusive-use budget that it can use to reward the agents. A motivating application is crowdsourcing for innovation, where a fixed budget is provided to a crowdsourcing platform to use for rewarding participants based on their submissions. Our main contribution is to introduce a novel class of contracts, which we call Luce contracts, and show that there is always a Luce contract that is optimal. A Luce contract assigns weights and a priority order to the agents, and distributes the entire budget among the highest-priority successful agents in proportion to their weights. Furthermore, we characterize effort profiles that can be implemented by Luce contracts and show that Luce contracts offer a way to mitigate the uncertainty in total payments compared to alternative contracts—such as piece-rate or bonus-pool contracts—suggesting their desirability even in environments without budget constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个带有道德风险的多智能体合同设计问题。在我们的模型中，每个智能体对一项可能成功或失败的个体任务付出有成本的努力，而希望激励努力的委托人拥有一个排他性使用预算，可用于奖励智能体。一个具有启发性的应用是创新众包，其中向众包平台提供固定预算，用于根据参与者的提交来奖励他们。我们的主要贡献是引入一类新颖的合同，我们称之为Luce合同，并证明总是存在一个最优的Luce合同。Luce合同为智能体分配权重和优先级顺序，并将整个预算按权重比例分配给优先级最高的成功智能体。此外，我们刻画了可由Luce合同实施的努力配置，并表明与替代合同——如计件合同或奖金池合同——相比，Luce合同提供了一种缓解总支付不确定性的方式，这表明即使在无预算约束的环境中它们也是可取的。

records.title_en: The effects of global and local heterogeneity on cooperation in multi-level public goods: experimental evidence
records.title_cn: 全球和地方异质性对多级公共品合作的影响：实验证据
records.abstract_en: Using an artefactual field experiment in a bilingual Swiss state with participants speaking different languages, this paper investigates how both heterogeneity and majority and minority statuses influence cooperation in a repeated multiple-level public good game in which participants can simultaneously contribute to a global good and local goods. Heterogeneity is based on language by using two native groups, German and French speakers, as our subject pool. We find that group heterogeneity has a negative effect on cooperation, which is mainly driven by a decrease in contributions to local public goods while contributions to the global good are not affected. The lower contributions to the local goods in the heterogeneous treatments are mainly due to lower contributions by majority members while the minority members contribute similar amounts to the reference group or even more. Furthermore, we observe that the impact of heterogeneity on contributions is magnified for individuals who are members of a linguistic minority in their real life. Finally, our article has implications for managerial and public policy, highlighting the fact that global heterogeneity can affect cooperation behaviors in local groups, even when they are homogeneous.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用在瑞士一个双语州进行的、参与者使用不同语言的人工实地实验，考察异质性以及多数和少数地位如何影响一个重复多级公共品博弈中的合作，在该博弈中参与者可以同时向一个全球公共品和地方公共品做出贡献。异质性基于语言，使用两个母语群体，即德语和法语使用者，作为我们的被试池。我们发现，群体异质性对合作有负面影响，这主要由对地方公共品贡献的下降所驱动，而对全球公共品的贡献未受影响。异质性处理中对地方公共品较低的贡献，主要归因于多数群体成员较低的贡献，而少数群体成员的贡献与参照组相似甚至更多。此外，我们观察到，异质性对贡献的影响对于在现实生活中属于语言少数群体的个体被放大。最后，我们的文章对管理者和公共政策具有启示，强调了全球异质性会影响地方群体中的合作行为，即使这些群体是同质的。

records.title_en: Maxmin expected utility as resulting from disagreement among experts
records.title_cn: 专家分歧导致的极大极小期望效用
records.abstract_en: This paper characterizes the Maxmin Expected Utility (MEU) model of Gilboa and Schmeidler (1989) in an environment a´-la Savage, based on information in the form of expert evaluations. The decision maker is assumed to consult with experts whose preferences abide by Savage’s Subjective Expected Utility theory. While the tastes of experts are aligned with those of the decision maker, their prior probabilities may vary, introducing ambiguity into the framework. The decision maker’s derived set of priors is contained in the convex hull of the experts’ subjective probabilities (or models). Thus, no ambiguity prevails when probability is unanimous according to all the experts. We conclude by characterizing methods for updating the decision maker’s beliefs when an expert’s evaluation is discarded.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在萨维奇框架下，基于专家评估形式的信息，刻画了 Gilboa 和 Schmeidler（1989）的极大极小期望效用（MEU）模型。决策者被假定为咨询那些偏好遵循萨维奇主观期望效用理论的专家。虽然专家的偏好与决策者一致，但他们的先验概率可能不同，从而在框架中引入模糊性。决策者推导出的先验集合包含在专家主观概率（或模型）的凸包之中。因此，当所有专家的概率一致时，不存在模糊性。最后，我们刻画了在舍弃某位专家的评估时更新决策者信念的方法。

records.title_en: Corridors in Shallow Lakes: The Case of Intermediate Pollution
records.title_cn: 浅水湖泊中的走廊：中间污染的情形
records.abstract_en: We study optimal management of the standard shallow lake model with special attention to the damage caused by the accumulated phosphorus in the water of the lake. The occurrence of a tipping point leads to a stronger increase in the damage after moving from the low-damage to the high-damage regime, because of the loss of ecosystem services. We modify the standard quadratic damage function by introducing a jump in marginal damage when moving from the low-damage to the high-damage regime. Connecting the lower and the higher marginal damage functions yields a continuous piecewise linear marginal damage function with a strong increase around the jump. In addition to the well-known oligotrophic and eutrophic steady states, we find that a third steady state can occur, separated by two Skiba points. This implies that a corridor or a basin of attraction arises between these two Skiba points where optimal management of the lake stabilizes the amount of phosphorus somewhere in the middle instead of either moving to the low-damage or to the high-damage regime, as is the result in the standard knife-edge case with one Skiba point.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究标准浅水湖泊模型的最优管理，特别关注湖水中累积的磷所造成的损害。临界点的出现导致从低损害状态转向高损害状态后损害更大幅度增加，原因是生态系统服务的丧失。我们通过引入从低损害状态转向高损害状态时边际损害的跳跃，对标准二次损害函数进行了修改。将较低的边际损害函数与较高的边际损害函数连接起来，得到一个连续的分段线性边际损害函数，其在跳跃点附近有强烈上升。除了众所周知的贫营养和富营养稳态之外，我们发现可能出现第三个稳态，由两个Skiba点分隔。这意味着在这两个Skiba点之间出现了一个走廊或吸引域，在该区域内湖泊的最优管理将磷的数量稳定在中间某处，而不是像具有一个Skiba点的标准刀锋情形那样要么转向低损害状态要么转向高损害状态。

records.title_en: Environmental Policy and Automation
records.title_cn: 环境政策与自动化
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the consequences of a cap-and-trade policy in the presence of a pollution externality and firms that may automate vacancies that are not matched to workers. We find that the emissions cap dampens the share of firms using robots, that is, a composition effect. This effect appears during the nonlinear transition to, and at, the long-run equilibrium with reduced carbon emissions, as well as over the cyclical fluctuations following productivity shocks. The effect implies that the adoption of robots is more elastic than the labor matches with respect to vacancies which fall when the emissions cap becomes more binding and contracts the economy. The effect is slightly amplified under a higher emissions rate for robot firms than for labor firms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在存在污染外部性且企业可能将未与工人匹配的职位自动化的情形下，总量管制与交易政策的后果。我们发现，排放上限抑制了使用机器人的企业份额，即一种构成效应。这种效应出现在向碳排放减少的长期均衡非线性过渡期间以及该均衡处，也出现在生产率冲击后的周期性波动中。该效应意味着，相对于职位而言，机器人的采用比劳动力匹配更具弹性；当排放上限更具约束力并使经济收缩时，职位会下降。当机器人企业的排放率略高于劳动力企业时，该效应略有放大。

records.title_en: Water Markets for Climate Change Adaptation: Trade, Storage, and Investment Under Stochastic Water Supply
records.title_cn: 适应气候变化的水市场：随机供水下的交易、储存与投资
records.abstract_en: It is widely accepted that water markets can support adaptation to climate change. However, quantifying this adaptive capacity is difficult as it requires models that represent both stochastic water supplies and forward-looking behaviour by market participants. We develop a stochastic dynamic model of the Murray-Darling Basin water market in which irrigators form rational expectations over future water prices, and make monthly water use, annual crop planting, and long-run investment decisions. The model is solved using reinforcement learning methods to approximate expectations, combined with mathematical programming to estimate market equilibrium. We validate the model against observed prices and irrigation activity from 2008 to 09 to 2021–22 and apply it to an ensemble of 37 CMIP6 climate projections for the southern Basin. Under drier future climates, water markets support adaptation through increased inter-regional trade flows into the downstream Murray, and larger storage reserves through more conservative crop planting. However, under the driest projections, inter-regional trade constraints bind, price differences widen across zones, and long-run irrigation development contracts by up to 16 per cent. The results highlight both the value and the limits of market-based adaptation, with implications for the design of water market institutions under a non-stationary climate.
records.abstract_cn: 人们普遍认为水市场能够支持对气候变化的适应。然而，量化这种适应能力是困难的，因为它需要同时刻画随机供水和市场参与者前瞻性行为的模型。我们构建了墨累-达令流域水市场的随机动态模型，其中灌溉者对未来水价形成理性预期，并做出月度用水、年度作物种植和长期投资决策。该模型采用强化学习方法近似预期，并结合数学规划估计市场均衡来求解。我们利用2008至09至2021-22期间观测到的价格和灌溉活动对模型进行验证，并将其应用于流域南部37个CMIP6气候预测的集合。在更干燥的未来气候下，水市场通过增加向下游墨累河的跨区域贸易流量，以及通过更保守的作物种植形成更大的储存储备来支持适应。然而，在最干燥的预测情景下，跨区域贸易约束趋紧，各区域间价格差异扩大，长期灌溉开发收缩最多达16%。结果既凸显了基于市场的适应的价值，也凸显了其局限，并对非平稳气候下水市场制度的设计具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Renewable Natural Resources, Regime Shift and Hysteresis
records.title_cn: 可再生自然资源、状态转换与滞后效应
records.abstract_en: Many of the world’s renewable resources are in decline. Optimal harvests with smooth recruitment is well studied but in recent years, ecologists have concluded that tipping points in recruitment are common. Recruitment with a tipping point has low-fecundity below the tipping point and high-fecundity above. When the discounted value of high-fecundity is sufficiently high, there is a high-fecundity steady-state. This steady-state is stable but in some cases, small perturbations may result in large, temporary reductions in recruitment and harvests. Below the tipping point, a low-fecundity steady-state need not exist. When a low-fecundity steady-state does exist, there is an endogenous tipping (Skiba) point: below, harvests converge to the low-fecundity steady-state and above, an austere harvest policy transitions the renewable resource to high-fecundity recruitment. If there is hysteresis in recruitment, the high steady-state may not be stable. Moreover, if the high-/low-fecundity differential is large then following a downward perturbation, fecundity optimally remains low.
records.abstract_cn: 世界上许多可再生资源正在衰退。平滑补充下的最优捕捞已被充分研究，但近年来，生态学家已得出结论：补充中的临界点很常见。具有临界点的补充在临界点以下具有低繁殖力，在临界点以上具有高繁殖力。当高繁殖力的折现值足够高时，存在一个高繁殖力稳态。该稳态是稳定的，但在某些情况下，小扰动可能导致补充和捕捞的大幅、暂时性减少。在临界点以下，低繁殖力稳态未必存在。当低繁殖力稳态确实存在时，存在一个内生临界（Skiba）点：在该点以下，捕捞收敛于低繁殖力稳态；在该点以上，一种严厉的捕捞政策使可再生资源向高繁殖力补充过渡。如果补充中存在滞后效应，高稳态可能不稳定。此外，如果高/低繁殖力差异很大，那么在向下扰动之后，繁殖力最优地保持在低水平。

records.title_en: How Will Hybrid Work Schedules Impact the Demand for Natural Resources? The Case of Urban Water Demand
records.title_cn: 混合工作安排将如何影响自然资源需求？以城市用水需求为例
records.abstract_en: This paper aims to explore the impact that hybrid-work schedules will have on urban spatial structure and how that in turn will impact urban residential water demand. I develop a variant of the monocentric city model in which workers have an additional margin in their housing consumption decision through the choice of both indoor floor area and outdoor yard area, both of which require water as an input. The transition to a hybrid work schedule impacts households through three channels: (1) a decline in commuting costs, (2) additional demand for home-office space, and (3) a potential decline in wages through lost agglomeration economies due to fewer in-person interactions. The analysis suggests that the city may expand or contract, and aggregate water use could rise or fall when hybrid-work is introduced, depending on whether the reductions in commuting costs outweigh the additional costs of home-office space and lower wages from reduced agglomeration externalities. When aggregate water use does rise, this increase is less pronounced for households in suburban areas, which become denser and land becomes relatively more expensive, slowing the demand for additional yard space. In contrast, households located closer to the core use relatively more water as land values fall and average housing consumption rises. I extend the model to consider four additional components: subsidizing in-person work, increasing marginal water prices, improvements to home water use technology, and year-round lawn irrigation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文旨在探讨混合工作安排将对城市空间结构产生的影响，以及这种影响反过来将如何影响城市居民用水需求。我构建了一个单中心城市模型的变体，其中工人在住房消费决策中拥有额外的边际，通过同时选择室内建筑面积和室外庭院面积来实现，二者都需要水作为投入。向混合工作安排的转变通过三个渠道影响家庭：（1）通勤成本下降，（2）对家庭办公空间的额外需求，以及（3）由于面对面互动减少导致集聚经济丧失而可能带来的工资下降。分析表明，当引入混合工作时，城市可能扩张或收缩，总用水量可能上升或下降，这取决于通勤成本的降低是否超过家庭办公空间的额外成本和因集聚外部性减少而降低的工资。当总用水量确实上升时，这种增加在郊区家庭中不那么明显，因为郊区变得更加密集且土地变得相对更昂贵，从而减缓了对额外庭院空间的需求。相比之下，位于更靠近核心区的家庭用水相对更多，因为土地价值下降且平均住房消费上升。我扩展了模型以考虑四个额外组成部分：补贴现场工作、提高边际水价、改进家庭用水技术以及全年草坪灌溉。

records.title_en: Do Protected Areas Affect the Income Levels in Remote Regions? Evidence from Italian Inner Areas
records.title_cn: 保护区是否影响偏远地区的收入水平？来自意大利内陆地区的证据
records.abstract_en: The economic impact of protected areas (PAs) on local development remains a debated topic in regional economics, particularly in peripheral regions facing demographic and economic decline. While protected areas provide essential ecological benefits, their effects on local economies remain debated, with concerns about land-use restrictions potentially limiting economic opportunities alongside potential gains from tourism and ecosystem services. This study investigates the causal effect of PAs on per capita income in Italian municipalities classified as inner areas under the National Strategy for Inner Areas. We exploit variation in the share of municipal land covered by protected areas using a Difference-in-differences approach with continuous treatment in a dose-response framework. The results show a robust, positive, and statistically significant relationship between PAs and local economic growth. The expansion of protected areas is associated with increased per capita income, suggesting that environmental protection contributes to development in Italy’s marginalized inner regions.
records.abstract_cn: 保护区（PAs）对地方发展的经济影响仍是区域经济学中一个存在争议的话题，尤其是在面临人口和经济衰退的边缘地区。虽然保护区提供重要的生态效益，但其对地方经济的影响仍存在争议，人们担心土地利用限制可能限制经济机会，同时旅游和生态系统服务可能带来潜在收益。本研究考察保护区对根据《国家内陆地区战略》被归类为内陆地区的意大利市镇人均收入的因果效应。我们采用双重差分方法，在剂量—反应框架下以连续处理方式，利用市镇土地被保护区覆盖比例的变异。结果表明，保护区与地方经济增长之间存在稳健、正向且统计显著的关系。保护区的扩张与人均收入增加相关，表明环境保护有助于意大利边缘化内陆地区的发展。

records.title_en: Valuing the UHV transmission lines in China: productivity gains, macroeconomic spillovers, and high returns
records.title_cn: 中国特高压输电线路的价值评估：生产率提升、宏观经济溢出效应与高回报
records.abstract_en: Ultra-high voltage (UHV) transmission infrastructure is central to China's strategy for resolving spatial mismatches in electricity supply and demand. Given its substantial capital requirements, a systematic evaluation of UHV projects' economic impact and cost-effectiveness is critical. Existing literature predominantly emphasizes causal inference on specific economic outcomes, with limited assessment of aggregate economic contributions. To address this gap, we quantify the macroeconomic effects of UHV investments through a productivity enhancement mechanism. Using a propensity score matching difference-in-differences (PSM-DID) approach with time-varying treatment, we first estimate UHV-induced firm productivity gains based on firm-level data from China. These micro-level effects are then embedded into a multi-regional, multi-sectoral general equilibrium model, capturing direct and spatial spillover effects via interregional trade and intersectoral linkages. Results indicate: (1) UHV projects elevate firm productivity by 3.62% on average; (2) UHV infrastructure raises national GDP by approximately 0.78%, including a 0.14% gain in provinces without direct UHV construction; (3) Assuming a 7% discount rate and a 30-year lifespan, UHV investments yield a 268% macroeconomic return. Our findings highlight the macroeconomic value of UHV expansion and provide empirical support for future investment prioritization.
records.abstract_cn: 特高压（UHV）输电基础设施是中国解决电力供需空间错配战略的核心。鉴于其巨大的资本需求，对特高压项目经济影响和成本效益进行系统评估至关重要。现有文献主要侧重于对特定经济结果的因果推断，对总体经济贡献的评估有限。为填补这一空白，我们通过生产率提升机制量化特高压投资的宏观经济效应。采用具有时变处理的倾向得分匹配双重差分（PSM-DID）方法，我们首先基于中国企业层面数据估计特高压引致的厂商生产率提升。随后将这些微观层面的效应嵌入多区域、多部门一般均衡模型，通过区域间贸易和部门间联系捕捉直接和空间溢出效应。结果表明：（1）特高压项目平均提升厂商生产率3.62%；（2）特高压基础设施使全国GDP提高约0.78%，其中包括未直接建设特高压省份的0.14%增长；（3）假设7%贴现率和30年寿命，特高压投资产生268%的宏观经济回报。我们的发现凸显了特高压扩张的宏观经济价值，并为未来投资优先次序提供了实证支持。

records.title_en: The macroeconomic effects of a greener technology mix
records.title_cn: 更绿色技术组合的宏观经济效应
records.abstract_en: What are the macroeconomic implications of a technology-driven green transition? Leveraging granular data on the universe of patents granted in the U.S., we construct a monthly green-innovation indicator defined as the share of U.S. patents filed since 1980 that are classified under climate change mitigation categories. After purging this measure from the effects of oil shocks, credit conditions, and other predictable macroeconomic components, we use it in a structural VAR model as a proxy for reallocation from brown to green innovation and we document that a positive green-innovation shock generates a temporary negative supply effect: industrial production falls, unemployment rises and consumer prices increase, reflecting lower aggregate productivity. These short-run costs, however, are not permanent and the negative implications for economic activity and prices dissipate in the medium run. Technology adjustment leads to a persistent decline in the emissions intensity of output and a shift in energy mix towards renewables, resulting in an overall Pareto improvement for the economy. Our findings are independent of variations in national and international climate policy commitments and point to a dynamic trade-off: greening the technology mix is costly in the short run, but it delivers lasting environmental gains without permanent macroeconomic losses.
records.abstract_cn: 技术驱动的绿色转型对宏观经济有何影响？利用美国全部授权专利的细粒度数据，我们构建了一个月度绿色创新指标，定义为自1980以来提交的、被归类为气候变化减缓类别的美国专利所占份额。在剔除石油冲击、信贷条件及其他可预测宏观经济成分的影响后，我们在结构VAR模型中使用该指标作为从棕色创新向绿色创新再配置的代理变量，并记录到：正向绿色创新冲击会产生暂时的负向供给效应：工业生产下降、失业上升、消费者价格上涨，反映出总生产率下降。然而，这些短期成本并非永久性的，对经济活动和价格的负面影响在中期内消散。技术调整导致产出的排放强度持续下降，能源结构向可再生能源转变，从而为经济带来整体帕累托改进。我们的发现独立于国家和国际气候政策承诺的变化，并指向一种动态权衡：使技术组合绿色化在短期内有成本，但它带来持久的环境收益，且不造成永久的宏观经济损失。

records.title_en: Container shipping disruptions and the economics of decarbonization
records.title_cn: 集装箱航运中断与脱碳经济学
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how containerized shipping disruptions affect macroeconomic and financial conditions for decarbonization. The analysis identifies supply chain shocks using exogenous price surcharges from major container carriers in a structural vector autoregression. Supply chain disruptions weaken the economic case for clean energy investment through three channels. Policy uncertainty raises the Transition Risk Index while depressing carbon prices on impact. Clean technology costs rise and suppress expected decarbonization investment returns. Damage to climate policy credibility advantages fossil fuel interests. Carbon prices fall on impact before recovering as substitution toward more carbon-intensive production raises allowance demand. Expected decarbonization investment returns remain depressed while fossil fuel stocks appreciate, as markets price in weaker future climate policy. Supply chain vulnerabilities generate persistent headwinds for the energy transition that operate through financial market channels.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察集装箱航运中断如何影响脱碳的宏观经济与金融条件。分析在结构向量自回归中使用来自主要集装箱承运商的外生价格附加费来识别供应链冲击。供应链中断通过三个渠道削弱清洁能源投资的经济理由。政策不确定性推高转型风险指数，同时在冲击当期压低碳价格。清洁技术成本上升并抑制预期脱碳投资回报。对气候政策可信度的损害有利于化石燃料利益。碳价格在冲击当期下降，随后随着生产向更高碳密集度替代而提高配额需求，碳价格回升。预期脱碳投资回报持续低迷，而化石燃料股票升值，因为市场计入了未来气候政策走弱的预期。供应链脆弱性通过金融市场渠道为能源转型带来持续阻力。

records.title_en: Bubble detection with application to green bubbles: A noncausal approach
records.title_cn: 泡沫检测及其在绿色泡沫中的应用：一种非因果方法
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a new approach for bubble detection based on mixed causal and noncausal autoregressive processes and their tail process representation during an explosive episode. Departing from traditional definitions of bubbles as nonstationary and temporarily explosive processes, we adopt a perspective in which prices are assumed to follow a strictly stationary process, with the bubble considered an intrinsic component of its nonlinear dynamics. The proposed approach provides a bubble indicator for detecting bubbles and measuring their duration. We implement our strategy to investigate the phenomenon called the “green bubble” in the field of renewable energy investment.
records.abstract_cn: 本文引入了一种基于混合因果与非因果自回归过程及其在爆炸性阶段尾部过程表示的新泡沫检测方法。不同于将泡沫定义为非平稳且暂时爆炸性过程的传统定义，我们采用了一种视角，即假设价格遵循严格平稳过程，而泡沫被视为其非线性动态的内在组成部分。所提出的方法提供了一个泡沫指标，用于检测泡沫并测量其持续时间。我们实施我们的策略来研究可再生能源投资领域中被称为“绿色泡沫”的现象。

records.title_en: The impact of Daylight Saving Time (DST) on electricity consumption in Iran
records.title_cn: 夏令时（DST）对伊朗电力消费的影响
records.abstract_en: Daylight Saving Time (DST) shifts clock time relative to daylight and routine activities, with ambiguous effects on electricity consumption: later evening daylight may reduce lighting demand but may also affect cooling, heating, and activity-related load.
