The New Horizon reform, initiated by the Ministry of Education, was gradually implemented in elementary schools beginning in 2008. It increased the time teachers spend in school, introduced small-group learning, raised teachers’ and principals’ salaries, and established higher requirements and incentives for professional development. Using a staggered difference-in-differences approach, we evaluate the reform’s effects on student achievement and the school learning environment. We find that in the four years following implementation, math and English test scores improved alongside various aspects of the learning environment. We offer suggestive evidence that the math gains are driven by small-group learning targeting lower-achieving students, while English gains are consistent with improved net working conditions for English teachers.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了以色列一项全国性学校改革对学生成绩和学校学习环境的影响。由教育部发起的“新视野”改革于2008年开始在小学逐步实施。该改革增加了教师在校时间，引入了小组学习，提高了教师和校长的工资，并建立了更高的专业发展要求和激励措施。我们使用交错双重差分方法评估了改革对学生成绩和学校学习环境的影响。我们发现，在实施后的四年里，数学和英语考试成绩以及学习环境的各个方面都有所改善。我们提供了提示性证据，表明数学成绩的提高是由针对成绩较低学生的小组学习驱动的，而英语成绩的提高与英语教师净工作条件的改善相一致。

records.title_en: A time-varying approach to assessing fiscal cyclicality: The role of the European fiscal framework
records.title_cn: 评估财政周期性的时变方法：欧洲财政框架的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper offers new empirical insights into the relationship between the European fiscal framework and the cyclical stance of fiscal policy in EMU countries. By employing a Time-Varying Coefficient (TVC) model, we generate country- and year-specific measures of fiscal cyclicality from 1995 to 2019. We then quantify the evolving intensity of fiscal rules through a country- and year-specific composite index and examine its relationship with fiscal cyclicality via panel regressions with multiple estimators, including a robust IV-GMM specification that addresses endogeneity concerns. This dual-framework strategy enables us to capture the distortion introduced by real-time revisions and identify a significant procyclical bias in peripheral countries, which is largely masked when ex post data are used. In other words, our findings reveal a marked asymmetry: while the estimated relationship between fiscal rules and cyclicality is neutral or mildly countercyclical in core countries, it is significantly procyclical in peripheral ones when real-time data are considered. These results have important implications for the revised European fiscal framework, as the new indicator (i.e., net expenditure) continues to rely on cycle-sensitive variables and may therefore perpetuate the same structural basis. Our analysis calls for a deeper reconsideration of the methodology used to estimate potential output in the EU. By demonstrating how the interaction between fiscal rules and real-time macroeconomic estimates can generate unintended policy outcomes, this study contributes to a more informed debate on the future of fiscal governance in the euro area.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为欧洲财政框架与EMU国家财政政策周期性立场之间的关系提供了新的经验证据。通过采用时变系数（TVC）模型，我们生成了从1995到2019的国别和年度特定的财政周期性度量。随后，我们通过一个国别和年度特定的综合指数来量化财政规则的演变强度，并通过使用多种估计量的面板回归来考察其与财政周期性的关系，其中包括一个解决内生性问题的稳健IV-GMM设定。这种双重框架策略使我们能够捕捉实时修订引入的扭曲，并识别出外围国家显著的顺周期偏差，而这一偏差在使用事后数据时在很大程度上被掩盖。换言之，我们的发现揭示了一种显著的不对称性：当考虑实时数据时，财政规则与周期性之间的估计关系在核心国家为中性或轻度逆周期，而在外围国家则显著为顺周期。这些结果对修订后的欧洲财政框架具有重要含义，因为新指标（即净支出）继续依赖对周期敏感的变量，因此可能延续相同的结构性基础。我们的分析呼吁对欧盟潜在产出估算方法进行更深入的重新考虑。通过展示财政规则与实时宏观经济估算之间的相互作用如何产生意外的政策结果，本研究为关于欧元区财政治理未来的更知情辩论做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Policy interventions to mitigate the long-run costs of Brexit
records.title_cn: 缓解英国脱欧长期成本的政策干预
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the long-term macroeconomic impacts of Brexit on the UK economy employing a dynamic general equilibrium model that incorporates endogenous firm entry, price markups and market competition. By integrating the trade frictions introduced by Brexit, the model explains how increased trade costs have altered firm behaviour, market structure, and broader economic performance. We assess a range of policy responses, from theoretically optimal but practically difficult tax-subsidy schemes, to more realistic measures aimed at reducing firm entry barriers, encouraging private and public investment, and subsidising labour costs. Our findings underscore the critical role of policies that can most directly influence firm creation, investment, and competition in addressing the structural challenges Brexit has introduced.
records.abstract_cn: 本文采用一个纳入内生企业进入、价格加成和市场竞争的动态一般均衡模型，考察英国脱欧对英国经济的长期宏观经济影响。通过纳入英国脱欧带来的贸易摩擦，该模型解释了贸易成本上升如何改变企业行为、市场结构以及更广泛的经济表现。我们评估了一系列政策应对措施，从理论上最优但实践中难以实施的税收-补贴方案，到更现实的旨在降低企业进入壁垒、鼓励私人和公共投资以及补贴劳动力成本的措施。我们的发现强调了那些能够最直接影响企业创建、投资和竞争的政策在应对英国脱欧带来的结构性挑战中的关键作用。

records.title_en: Determinants of gender discrimination by teachers: Evidence from an online experiment
records.title_cn: 教师性别歧视的决定因素：来自在线实验的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines whether teachers’ gender biases stem from discrimination, and focuses on two of its potential drivers: gender preferences and beliefs. In an online experiment, 1840 teachers evaluated fictitious transcripts with randomized gender information. Preferences are measured via dictator games, and beliefs through an Implicit Association Test. While teachers show no gender preferences, they do hold gender beliefs. Analysing 19,000 transcript evaluations, we find no evidence of gender-based discrimination. Our findings suggest that when only exposed to student gender, even teachers with biased beliefs do not discriminate.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察教师的性别偏见是否源于歧视，并聚焦于其两个潜在驱动因素：性别偏好与信念。在一项在线实验中，1840名教师评估了性别信息随机化的虚构成绩单。偏好通过独裁者博弈衡量，信念则通过内隐联想测验衡量。尽管教师未表现出性别偏好，他们确实持有性别信念。分析19,000份成绩单评估后，我们未发现基于性别的歧视证据。我们的发现表明，当仅接触学生性别时，即使持有偏见信念的教师也不会歧视。

records.title_en: Oil prices and inequality
records.title_cn: 石油价格与不平等
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a unified framework to understand the effect of oil price changes on the dynamics of consumption, income and wealth inequality. Using data on macroeconomic aggregates, oil prices, and inequality metrics, we first employ a structural vector autoregressive model to show that an increase in oil prices leads to a persistent rise in income and wealth inequality. To understand these dynamics, we then solve an incomplete market model with aggregate oil price shocks, and calibrate the model to the US data. We find that when oil serves as both a consumption good and a production input, positive oil price shocks increase inequality. While the initial rise in inequality is driven by oil-induced stagflation, which forces poorer households to deplete more of their wealth to cover basic consumption, the quicker rebound in interest rates compared to the slower recovery in wages explains why inequality remains persistently elevated.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一个统一框架，以理解石油价格变化对消费、收入和财富不平等动态的影响。利用宏观经济总量、石油价格和不平等指标的数据，我们首先采用结构向量自回归模型表明，石油价格上升会导致收入和财富不平等持续上升。为了理解这些动态，我们随后求解了一个包含总体石油价格冲击的不完全市场模型，并根据美国数据对模型进行校准。我们发现，当石油既作为消费品又作为生产投入品时，正向石油价格冲击会加剧不平等。虽然不平等的初始上升由石油引发的滞胀驱动，这迫使较贫困家庭消耗更多财富以支付基本消费，但利率相对于工资的较慢复苏更快反弹，解释了为何不平等持续居高不下。

records.title_en: The long-term effects of military occupations: Evidence from post-world war II Austria
records.title_cn: 军事占领的长期影响：来自二战后奥地利的证据
records.abstract_en: What are the long-run economic consequences of short-lived but intense institutional shocks? We study the post-World War II occupation of Austria, where the country was divided into Soviet and Western Allied zones for ten years before reunification. Using a spatial regression discontinuity design combined with a difference-in-differences approach, we show that areas initially occupied by Soviet forces remain significantly less economically developed today. These regions are less populated, host fewer and lower-paying jobs, and exhibit substantially higher rates of out-commuting than comparable areas in the former Western zones. We show that these persistent differences are driven by a large population flight triggered by the onset of the Soviet occupation, which durably shifted the spatial distribution of economic activity. This initial migration shock altered local agglomeration forces, leading to sustained regional divergence despite the restoration of a unified institutional framework. Our findings highlight how even temporary institutional shocks can have long-lasting economic effects.
records.abstract_cn: 短暂但强烈的制度冲击会带来怎样的长期经济后果？我们研究二战后对奥地利的占领，当时该国在重新统一前被分为苏联占领区和西方盟国占领区长达十年。我们使用空间断点回归设计并结合双重差分方法，表明最初被苏联军队占领的地区如今经济发展水平仍显著较低。与旧西方占领区的可比地区相比，这些地区人口更少，就业岗位更少且工资更低，通勤外出率也显著更高。我们表明，这些持续差异是由苏联占领开始引发的大规模人口外流所驱动，这一外流持久地改变了经济活动的空间分布。这一初始迁移冲击改变了本地集聚力量，导致尽管统一制度框架得以恢复，区域分化仍持续存在。我们的发现凸显了即使是暂时的制度冲击也能产生持久的经济影响。

records.title_en: Routine-biased technical change, structure of employment, and cross-country income differences
records.title_cn: 偏向常规型的技术变化、就业结构与跨国收入差异
records.abstract_en: We investigate links between routine-biased technical change, the structure of occupational employment, and cross-country income differences. To implement this, we combine several data sources, including national labour force surveys and the Penn World Tables. In our novel dataset spanning 92 countries, we document a negative relationship between the employment share of routine occupations and GDP per hour worked. We then conduct a development accounting exercise in which we differentiate labour inputs by occupation and allow for occupation-specific technologies. We find a systematic relationship between occupation-specific productivities and development. Labour in routine occupations tends to be much more productive in richer countries, with effective productivity in the top 25 percent being about 14 times higher than in the bottom 25 percent of countries ranked by GDP per hour worked. Cross-country gaps in routine technology alone account for about 17 percent of the 90–10 ratio of GDP per hour worked, whereas differences in abstract labour technology do not contribute to the observed GDP dispersion. Eliminating all occupations’ and capital’s technology differences would compress the GDP distribution by 32 to 40 percent.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究偏向常规型的技术变化、职业就业结构与跨国收入差异之间的联系。为实现这一目标，我们结合了多个数据来源，包括各国劳动力调查和佩恩世界表。在我们涵盖92个国家的新数据集中，我们记录了常规职业就业份额与每小时GDP之间的负向关系。随后，我们进行了一项发展核算练习，其中我们按职业区分劳动投入，并允许职业特定技术存在。我们发现职业特定生产率与发展之间存在系统性关系。常规职业中的劳动在较富裕国家往往生产率高得多，按每小时GDP排名最高的25%个国家中常规职业的有效生产率约比最低的25%个国家高14倍。仅常规技术的跨国差距就解释了每小时GDP的90-10比率中约17%，而抽象劳动技术的差异对观察到的GDP离散度没有贡献。消除所有职业和资本的技术差异将使GDP分布压缩32至40%。

records.title_en: Local shocks and internal migration: The disparate effects of robots and Chinese imports in the US
records.title_cn: 局部冲击与国内迁移：美国机器人与中国进口的差异化影响
records.abstract_en: Migration is a key mechanism through which local labor markets adjust to economic shocks. In this paper, we analyze the migration response of American workers to two of the most important shocks that hit US manufacturing since the 1990s: Chinese import competition and the introduction of industrial robots. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in exposure across US local labor markets over time, we establish a new fact. Even though both shocks drastically reduced employment in the manufacturing sector, only robots led to a sizable decline in population size. We provide evidence that negative employment spillovers outside manufacturing, caused by robots but not by Chinese imports, can explain the different migration responses. We interpret our findings through the lens of a model that highlights two mechanisms: the cost savings that each shock provides and the degree of complementarity between directly and indirectly exposed industries.
records.abstract_cn: 迁移是本地劳动力市场调整以适应经济冲击的关键机制。在本文中，我们分析了美国工人对自1990以来冲击美国制造业的两个最重要冲击的迁移反应：中国进口竞争和工业机器人的引入。利用美国各地方劳动力市场随时间推移面临的看似外生的暴露程度变化，我们确立了一个新的事实。尽管这两种冲击都大幅减少了制造业部门的就业，但只有机器人导致了人口规模的显著下降。我们提供的证据表明，由机器人而非中国进口引起的制造业之外的负面就业溢出效应，可以解释不同的迁移反应。我们通过一个强调两种机制的模型来解读我们的发现：每种冲击带来的成本节约，以及直接和间接暴露行业之间的互补程度。

records.title_en: Reference-point effects in bargaining
records.title_cn: 讨价还价中的参照点效应
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether an earned endowment can serve as a salient reference point in unstructured bargaining and thereby reshape focal agreements. In a laboratory experiment with 166 participants, subjects earn endowments in a real-effort task, and subsequent bargaining menus are framed as changes relative to these earned endowments, while disagreement yields zero payoffs. The design distinguishes agreements that equalize total earnings (equal splits in final payoffs) from agreements that equalize the incremental surplus relative to the reference point (equal changes). Under symmetric endowments these notions coincide; under asymmetric endowments they diverge, so equalizing total earnings requires an unequal division of the incremental surplus. Results show that equal splits are not universal even under symmetry, and when endowments are asymmetric they lose focality in favor of equal-change and intermediate compromise agreements. The findings are robust across environments in which the reference point is available, dominated by some feasible agreements, or an infeasible claim. The results highlight how the salience and asymmetry of a reference point affects which notion of equality is focal in bargaining.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究挣得的禀赋能否在非结构化讨价还价中充当显著的参照点，从而重塑焦点协议。在一项有166名参与者的实验室实验中，被试在真实努力任务中挣得禀赋，随后的讨价还价菜单被框定为相对于这些挣得禀赋的变化，而未能达成协议则收益为零。该设计区分了使总收益均等化的协议（最终收益的均等分配）与使相对于参照点的增量剩余均等化的协议（均等变化）。在对称禀赋下，这些概念一致；在不对称禀赋下，它们发生分歧，因此使总收益均等化需要对增量剩余进行不均等的分割。结果表明，即使在对称条件下，均等分配也并非普遍存在；而当禀赋不对称时，均等分配失去焦点性，让位于均等变化和中间妥协协议。这些发现在参照点可得、被某些可行协议占优、或作为不可行要求的环境中均稳健。结果凸显了参照点的显著性和不对称性如何影响讨价还价中哪种平等概念成为焦点。

records.title_en: Goal setting and feedback: the power of joint use
records.title_cn: 目标设定与反馈：联合使用的力量
records.abstract_en: This study examines the effects of goal setting and feedback, both in isolation and in combination, and how these effects vary depending on who sets the goal. We study these effects in a non-pecuniary environment common to workplace settings such as the public sector. We compare outcomes across treatments with no goal setting, worker-set goals, and employer-set goals, each implemented with and without employer feedback, and document several key findings. Employers set substantially higher goals than workers, and this gap widens with feedback because employer-set goals increase significantly while worker-set goals remain unchanged. Effort is significantly higher only under the joint use of employer-set goals and feedback; otherwise, effort levels are similar. Specifically, neither feedback nor goal setting has a significant effect on effort when used in isolation. The effect of feedback on effort is positive and statistically significant only when goals are employer-set. Likewise, when feedback is present, only employer-set goals raise effort significantly relative to no goal setting. Finally, employer feedback is sensitive to goal attainment only when goals are set by employers. One possible explanation is that employer-set goals, when paired with feedback, create a sense of social pressure or accountability that leads workers to increase effort.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察目标设定与反馈单独使用及联合使用的效果，以及这些效果如何因目标由谁设定而异。我们在公共部门等职场环境中常见的非金钱环境中研究这些效果。我们比较了无目标设定、工作者设定目标和雇主设定目标三种处理下的结果，每种处理均在有雇主反馈和无雇主反馈的情况下实施，并记录了若干关键发现。雇主设定的目标显著高于工作者，且这一差距在反馈下扩大，因为雇主设定的目标显著提高，而工作者设定的目标保持不变。只有在雇主设定目标与反馈联合使用时，努力才显著更高；否则，努力水平相似。具体而言，反馈或目标设定单独使用时，对努力均无显著影响。只有当目标由雇主设定时，反馈对努力的影响才为正且统计显著。同样，当存在反馈时，只有雇主设定的目标相对于无目标设定显著提高努力。最后，只有当目标由雇主设定时，雇主反馈才对目标达成敏感。一种可能的解释是，雇主设定的目标与反馈搭配时，会产生一种社会压力或问责感，促使工作者增加努力。

records.title_en: History-dependent monetary policy – less is more
records.title_cn: 历史依赖型货币政策——少即是多
records.abstract_en: History-dependent monetary policies (HDMP) can potentially address the challenges that standard monetary policy frameworks face, especially at the ELB. Using controlled laboratory experiments, we identify several vulnerabilities in HDMP. Our analysis of experimental data shows that a weakened expectations channel can undermine HDMP. Experimental participants’ expectations feed off past data; they are not forward-looking and do not internalize the stabilization properties or future make-up strategies of HDMP. Conditional on these expectations, we highlight two risks associated with HDMP: inflation overshoots under average inflation targeting and deflationary spirals under price level targeting and nominal GDP level targeting. However, effective central bank communication through medium-term macroeconomic projections can improve the performance of price level targeting.
records.abstract_cn: 历史依赖型货币政策（HDMP）可能有助于应对标准货币政策框架所面临的挑战，尤其是在有效下限（ELB）处。通过受控实验室实验，我们识别出HDMP中的若干脆弱性。我们对实验数据的分析表明，减弱的预期渠道可能削弱HDMP。实验参与者的预期依赖于过去的数据；他们并非前瞻性，也不会内化HDMP的稳定属性或未来弥补策略。在这些预期条件下，我们强调与HDMP相关的两个风险：平均通胀目标制下的通胀超调，以及价格水平目标制和名义GDP水平目标制下的通缩螺旋。然而，通过中期宏观经济预测进行有效的央行沟通，可以改善价格水平目标制的表现。

records.title_en: Original sin redux: A model-based evaluation
records.title_cn: 原罪重现：基于模型的评估
records.abstract_en: Using a two-country model, this paper shows that the shift from foreign currency to local currency external borrowing does not eliminate the vulnerability of EMs to foreign financial shocks but instead results in “original sin redux.” A monetary tightening abroad is propagated to EM financial conditions through a tightening of foreign lenders’ financial constraints, driven in part by currency mismatches on their balance sheets. Foreign exchange intervention and capital flow management measures can mitigate global financial spillovers to EMs in the short run and a larger domestic investor base can reduce the vulnerability in the longer run.
records.abstract_cn: 本文运用两国模型表明，从外币外部借款转向本币外部借款并未消除新兴市场对外国金融冲击的脆弱性，反而导致“原罪重现”。国外的货币紧缩通过收紧外国贷款人的金融约束传导至新兴市场的金融条件，部分原因是其资产负债表上的货币错配。外汇干预和资本流动管理措施可以在短期内缓解全球金融溢出对新兴市场的影响，而更大的国内投资者基础可以在长期内降低脆弱性。

records.title_en: The structure of discrimination against Turkish migrants in Germany
records.title_cn: 德国对土耳其移民的歧视结构
records.abstract_en: We study the structure and heterogeneity of discriminatory behavior using an incentivized choice experiment with a representative sample of over 2000 adults in Germany. Decision-makers allocate a fixed endowment between two receivers whose migration background, education, gender, and age are randomly varied. This design allows us to compare discrimination across attributes within an integrative framework, analyze how these dimensions interact, and classify individuals into behavioral types. We show pronounced discrimination against Turkish migrants in allocation choices, comparable in magnitude to gender-based preferential treatment in favor of women. Discrimination against Turkish migrants varies systematically with other receiver attributes and across decision makers, and is particularly strong among non-migrants and individuals with right-wing political preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一项激励性选择实验，以德国超过2000名成年人的代表性样本为对象，研究歧视行为的结构与异质性。决策者在两个接受者之间分配一笔固定禀赋，接受者的移民背景、教育、性别和年龄被随机变化。这一设计使我们能够在一个整合框架内比较不同属性上的歧视，分析这些维度如何相互作用，并将个体分类为行为类型。我们表明，在分配选择中存在对土耳其移民的显著歧视，其程度与基于性别的、有利于女性的优待相当。对土耳其移民的歧视随其他接受者属性以及决策者不同而系统性变化，并且在非移民和具有右翼政治偏好的个体中尤为强烈。

records.title_en: The spoils of algorithmic collusion: Profit allocation among asymmetric firms
records.title_cn: 算法合谋的掠夺物：非对称企业间的利润分配
records.abstract_en: We study the propensity of independent algorithms to collude in repeated asymmetric Cournot duopolies, specifically the predictive power of various oligopoly and bargaining solutions with respect to the effect of asymmetry among firms. We find that total quantities are below the static Nash level in all specifications, and they increase with asymmetry. Thus, both consumers and firms can benefit from asymmetry. For low (high) levels of asymmetry, the simulated quantities are above (below) the joint profit-maximizing output. While the static Nash equilibrium provides accurate predictions regarding total welfare, bargaining solutions, such as equal relative gains, better capture our finding of convergence to Pareto-efficient outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了独立算法在重复非对称古诺双寡头中合谋的倾向，具体而言是各种寡头与讨价还价解对于企业间非对称性效应的预测能力。我们发现，在所有设定中总产量均低于静态纳什水平，且随非对称性增加而增加。因此，消费者和企业都能从非对称性中受益。对于低（高）水平的非对称性，模拟产量高于（低于）联合利润最大化产出。虽然静态纳什均衡对总福利提供了准确预测，但讨价还价解，如均等相对收益，更好地捕捉了我们发现的向帕累托有效结果的收敛。

records.title_en: Leverage constraints and bank monitoring: Bank regulation versus monetary policy
records.title_cn: 杠杆约束与银行监督：银行监管与货币政策
records.abstract_en: Bank leverage constraints can arise from regulatory capital requirements or from central bank collateral requirements in reserve lending. We compare these two policy channels within the so-called “bank money creation” approach. We show that monetary policy via collateral requirements leads to a novel and unique collateral leverage channel. Through this channel, banks facing liquidity constraints can expand loan supply and deposit issuance by raising the collateral value of their loans, which they achieve through tighter loan monitoring. The collateral leverage channel can improve welfare beyond standard bank capital regulation and inform the design of central bank collateral frameworks.
records.abstract_cn: 银行杠杆约束可能来自监管资本要求，也可能来自央行在准备金贷款中的抵押品要求。我们在所谓的“银行货币创造”方法内比较这两种政策渠道。我们表明，通过抵押品要求实施的货币政策会导致一种新颖且独特的抵押品杠杆渠道。通过这一渠道，面临流动性约束的银行可以通过提高其贷款的抵押品价值来扩大贷款供给和存款发行，而它们通过更严格的贷款监督来实现这一点。抵押品杠杆渠道可以在标准银行资本监管之外改善福利，并为央行抵押品框架的设计提供信息。

records.title_en: On the empirical relevance of the exchange rate as a shock absorber at the zero lower bound
records.title_cn: 论汇率在零利率下限作为冲击吸收器的经验相关性
records.abstract_en: The New Keynesian argument is that flexible exchange rate regimes cannot stabilize cyclical developments at the ZLB, as the real exchange rate appreciates in response to adverse demand shocks. We estimate the effects of a negative domestic demand shock on the real exchange rate for the euro area vis-à-vis the United States, Canada, and Japan by state-dependent sign-restricted local projection methods. We find a real depreciation when interest rates are not at the ZLB, but also when they are. The exchange rate can accommodate considerable variations in output, confirming its shock-absorbing capacity away from and during ZLB episodes. The stabilizing role of the exchange rate is accompanied by a significant expansion of the ECB’s balance sheet at the ZLB, while it remained unaffected in the non-ZLB period.
records.abstract_cn: 新凯恩斯主义的论点是，在零利率下限（ZLB），浮动汇率制度无法稳定周期性发展，因为实际汇率会因不利的需求冲击而升值。我们通过状态依赖的符号约束局部投影方法，估计了不利的国内需求冲击对欧元区相对于美国、加拿大和日本的实际汇率的影响。我们发现，当利率不在ZLB时会出现实际贬值，但当利率处于ZLB时也会出现实际贬值。汇率能够吸收产出的大幅波动，证实了其在ZLB之外和ZLB期间吸收冲击的能力。在ZLB，汇率的稳定作用伴随着欧洲央行资产负债表的显著扩张，而在非ZLB时期，欧洲央行资产负债表则未受影响。

records.title_en: Income redistribution, preventive care, and longevity
records.title_cn: 收入再分配、预防性护理与寿命
records.abstract_en: Would government intervention aimed at reducing socioeconomic inequalities lead to a healthier population and longer lives? We address this question using a structural life-cycle model with heterogeneous agents. The model is calibrated to U.S. survey and actuarial data, reproducing the age-at-death distribution, income inequality, medical expenditure patterns, the value of a statistical life, and the education–longevity gradient. We find that a universal basic income flattens the longevity gap across education levels but reduces overall longevity by weakening incentives for preventive care, a result that contrasts with recent statistical studies suggesting redistribution would increase population longevity. Instead, subsidies for preventive care raise average longevity but steepen the education–longevity gradient. In both cases, welfare effects remain uneven across education groups.
records.abstract_cn: 旨在减少社会经济不平等的政府干预是否会使人口更健康、寿命更长？我们使用一个具有异质性主体的结构性生命周期模型来研究这一问题。该模型根据美国调查和精算数据进行校准，能够复现死亡年龄分布、收入不平等、医疗支出模式、统计生命价值以及教育与寿命的梯度。我们发现，普遍基本收入缩小了不同教育水平之间的寿命差距，但通过削弱预防性护理的激励降低了总体寿命，这一结果与近期表明再分配会提高人口寿命的统计研究形成对比。相反，对预防性护理的补贴提高了平均寿命，但加剧了教育与寿命的梯度。在这两种情况下，福利效应在不同教育群体之间仍然不均衡。

records.title_en: Do women comply more than men? Experimental evidence from a general population sample
records.title_cn: 女性比男性更顺从吗？来自一般人群样本的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Women are typically perceived as more compliant than men; however, the literature provides inconclusive evidence. Using a novel experimental design comprising two complementary experiments, we test this claim in online samples representative of the German adult population. The first experiment (N = 1600) features a probabilistic social dilemma game (PDG) in which participants can increase their individual payoff at the expense of exposing themselves and their group to probabilistic losses. In two treatment conditions, they receive either a recommendation on socially optimal behavior or the same recommendation plus information on weakly non-compliant peer behavior. We find that the recommendation strongly affects behavior, but more so for women than for men. The welfare improvement is substantial. Information on the non-compliant behavior of others erodes compliance with the recommendation but does not induce significantly different responses in men and women. In the second experiment (N = 522), we elicit empirical and normative expectations about behavior in the PDG with a behavioral recommendation, in order to study the role of norms in adhering to it. While men and women are expected to hold similar normative beliefs, men are expected to follow the recommendation less often, suggesting that compliance is a (strong) female social norm.
records.abstract_cn: 女性通常被认为比男性更顺从；然而，文献提供的证据尚无定论。我们采用包含两个互补实验的新颖实验设计，在代表德国成年人口的在线样本中检验这一说法。第一个实验（N = 1600）采用概率社会困境博弈（PDG），参与者可以通过让自己和所在群体面临概率性损失为代价来提高个人收益。在两种处理条件下，他们要么收到关于社会最优行为的建议，要么收到同样的建议加上关于弱不顺从同伴行为的信息。我们发现，建议强烈影响行为，但对女性的影响大于男性。福利改善是巨大的。关于他人不顺从行为的信息会削弱对建议的顺从，但并未在男性和女性中引起显著不同的反应。在第二个实验（N = 522）中，我们引出对带有行为建议的PDG中行为的实证和规范预期，以研究规范在遵从建议中的作用。虽然男性和女性被预期持有相似的规范信念，但男性被预期更不经常遵循建议，这表明顺从是一种（强烈的）女性社会规范。

records.title_en: Ratcheting up Paris
records.title_cn: 逐步提高巴黎协定的力度
records.abstract_en: The Paris Agreement is designed to increase climate ambition gradually through a process of ratcheting up. What is the plausible endpoint of this process? To answer this question, we develop a tractable integrated assessment model in which countries interact through a decentralized general equilibrium and negotiate unanimously over a global carbon budget, with all mitigation implemented via a global carbon price. We prove the existence and uniqueness of a unanimous international agreement on global emissions, in which carbon pricing revenues are redistributed across countries in proportion to marginal climate damages. In a quantitative application for 154 countries, the resulting equilibrium limits global mean surface temperature change to 1.51°C, at a carbon price of 320 USD/tCO2. The associated international transfers of carbon pricing revenue are progressive toward lower-income countries and amount to about 0.8% of global GDP annually — an order of magnitude larger than the Paris Agreement’s climate finance target.
records.abstract_cn: 《巴黎协定》旨在通过逐步提高力度的过程来增加气候雄心。这一过程的合理终点是什么？为了回答这个问题，我们开发了一个易于处理的综合评估模型，其中各国通过分散的一般均衡相互作用，并一致谈判全球碳预算，所有减排都通过全球碳价格实施。我们证明了关于全球排放的一致国际协议的存在性和唯一性，其中碳定价收入按边际气候损害的比例在各国之间重新分配。在对154个国家的定量应用中，由此产生的均衡将全球平均地表温度变化限制在1.51°C，碳价格为320 USD/tCO2。相关的碳定价收入国际转移对低收入国家是累进的，每年约为全球GDP的0.8%——比《巴黎协定》的气候融资目标大一个数量级。

records.title_en: Green jobs require green skills: Why production subsidies are not enough
records.title_cn: 绿色岗位需要绿色技能：为什么生产补贴还不够
records.abstract_en: Large structural transitions require both firms and workers to act: firms must create jobs in expanding sectors, and workers must acquire the skills to move into them. The green transition is a leading example, yet most climate policy focuses on the firm side. This paper asks whether production support alone is sufficient for the constrained-efficient allocation, or whether worker-side support is also needed. I develop a two-sector Diamond–Mortensen–Pissarides model with sectoral choice and pre-match human-capital investment. Green workers acquire sector-specific skills before matching with firms; because training is sunk at the time of wage bargaining, workers do not internalize the full social return to their investment, even under the Hosios condition. A Pigouvian production subsidy corrects the environmental wedge and aligns vacancy creation for a given level of human capital, but it does not implement the planner’s training choice; so exact decentralization also requires a worker-side training subsidy. In a calibration to the United States, the central quantitative comparison holds fixed the green-employment target: a production-only policy is chosen to reach the same 14% benchmark as the coordinated policy, but it does so with lower green human capital and lower output. The break-even environmental value of green output for the coordinated policy is 1.13% of the numeraire output unit. It thus shows that, even conditional on the same green employment expansion, policy design determines the skill intensity and productivity of the green expansion.
records.abstract_cn: 大规模结构性转型需要企业和工人共同行动：企业必须在扩张部门创造岗位，工人必须获得技能以进入这些岗位。绿色转型是一个典型例子，但大多数气候政策聚焦于企业一侧。本文追问：仅靠生产支持是否足以实现约束有效配置，还是也需要工人一侧的支持。我构建了一个包含部门选择与匹配前人力资本投资的两部门Diamond–Mortensen–Pissarides模型。绿色工人在与企业匹配之前获得部门特定技能；由于培训在工资谈判时已成沉没成本，工人不会将其投资的全部社会回报内部化，即使在Hosios条件下也是如此。庇古生产补贴纠正了环境楔子，并在给定人力资本水平下使空缺创造对齐，但它并不实施规划者的培训选择；因此，精确分权还需要工人一侧的培训补贴。在对美国的校准中，核心定量比较固定绿色就业目标：选择仅生产政策以达到与协调政策相同的14%基准，但它以更低的绿色人力资本和更低的产出实现这一目标。协调政策的绿色产出盈亏平衡环境价值为计价产出单位的1.13%。因此这表明，即使以相同的绿色就业扩张为条件，政策设计也决定了绿色扩张的技能强度与生产率。

records.title_en: International anti-tax avoidance, tax fairness and domestic tax compliance
records.title_cn: 国际反避税、税收公平与国内企业税收遵从
records.abstract_en: This study investigates how international anti-tax avoidance measures promote domestic firms' tax compliance by improving tax fairness, using the implementation of the Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) project in China as a quasi-natural experiment. The BEPS project curtails multinationals' tax avoidance and elevates their tax burden, improving overall tax fairness. The expanded tax base also incentivizes tax authorities to mitigate enforcement inconsistencies and establish a fairer tax administration environment. In response to heightened tax fairness, domestic firms exhibit increased tax compliance. Following the BEPS project implementation, a one standard deviation increase in multinationals' market share is associated with a 0.49 percentage point (8.75%) decrease in domestic firms' book-tax differences. This study identifies the spillover effects of multinationals' tax avoidance on domestic firms' tax compliance and demonstrates a previously unexplored mechanism whereby international anti-tax avoidance measures influence government revenue.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究以中国实施税基侵蚀与利润转移（BEPS）项目作为准自然实验，考察国际反避税措施如何通过改善税收公平促进国内企业税收遵从。BEPS项目遏制跨国公司的避税行为并提高其税负，改善整体税收公平。扩大的税基也激励税务机关减少执法不一致，建立更公平的税收征管环境。面对税收公平的提升，国内企业表现出更高的税收遵从。BEPS项目实施后，跨国公司市场份额每增加一个标准差，国内企业的账面-税收差异下降0.49个百分点（8.75%）。本研究识别了跨国公司避税对国内企业税收遵从的溢出效应，并揭示了国际反避税措施影响政府收入的一个此前未被探索的机制。

records.title_en: The Returns to Government R&D: Evidence from US Appropriations Shocks
records.title_cn: 政府研发的回报：来自美国拨款冲击的证据
records.abstract_en: Based on a narrative classification of all significant postwar changes in R&D appropriations for five major federal agencies, we find that an increase in nondefense R&D appropriations leads to increases in various measures of innovative activity and higher business-sector productivity in the long run. We structurally estimate the production function elasticity of nondefense government R&D capital using the SP-IV methodology of Lewis and Mertens (2024) and obtain implied returns of 140 to 210 percent over the postwar period. The estimates indicate that government-funded R&D accounts for one-fifth of business-sector TFP growth since WWII and imply substantial under-funding of nondefense R&D.
records.abstract_cn: 基于对战后五个主要联邦机构研发拨款所有重大变化的叙述性分类，我们发现非国防研发拨款的增加会在长期带来各种创新活动指标的上升以及更高的企业部门生产率。我们使用Lewis and Mertens（2024）的SP-IV方法结构性地估计非国防政府研发资本的生产函数弹性，并得到战后时期140至210%的隐含回报。估计结果表明，政府资助的研发占二战以来企业部门TFP增长的五分之一，并意味着非国防研发存在大幅资金不足。

records.title_en: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
records.title_cn: 碳定价的不平等经济后果
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征和高频数据，我识别碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。限制性碳政策冲击会提高能源价格、减少排放、促进绿色创新，但会降低经济活动——不成比例地加重较贫困家庭的负担。穷人不仅因能源支出更高而受到更大影响，而且还经历更大的收入损失。这些通过收入和就业产生的间接一般均衡效应在碳定价政策的传导中发挥重要作用，约占总体消费响应的三分之二。

records.title_en: Residential Segregation and Unequal Access to Local Public Services in India: Evidence from 1.5 Million Neighborhoods
records.title_cn: 印度居住隔离与地方公共服务获取不平等：来自1.5百万个邻里的证据
records.abstract_en: We study residential segregation and access to public services across 1.5 million urban and rural neighborhoods in India. Muslim and Scheduled Caste segregation in India is high by global standards and only slightly lower than Black-White segregation in the United States. Within cities, public facilities and infrastructure are systematically less available in Muslim and Scheduled Caste neighborhoods. Nearly all regressive allocation is across neighborhoods within cities—at the most informal and least studied form of government. These inequalities are not visible in the aggregate data typically used for research and policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了印度1.5百万个城市和农村邻里的居住隔离与公共服务获取情况。按全球标准衡量，印度穆斯林和表列种姓的隔离程度较高，仅略低于美国的黑白隔离。在城市内部，穆斯林和表列种姓邻里在公共设施和基础设施的可获得性上系统性更低。几乎所有累退性分配都发生在城市内部各邻里之间——即最非正规且研究最少的政府形式。这些不平等在通常用于研究和政策的汇总数据中不可见。

records.title_en: Durables and the Marginal Propensity to Spend
records.title_cn: 耐用品与边际支出倾向
records.abstract_en: Durables represent a large share of households' marginal propensity to spend (MPX). We develop a quantitative model of spending that takes durables into account and matches a rich set of empirical regularities simultaneously. Scaling the response of nondurables provides a poor approximation of the MPX on durables when it comes to its distribution in the population, its persistence over time, and its cyclicality. As an application, we study how the MPX varies with the size of stimulus checks and find that it declines more slowly compared to a model of purely nondurable spending.
records.abstract_cn: 耐用品在家庭边际支出倾向（MPX）中占很大份额。我们构建了一个考虑耐用品的支出定量模型，并同时匹配了一组丰富的经验规律。在耐用品MPX的人口分布、时间持续性和周期性方面，按非耐用品响应进行缩放会给出较差的近似。作为一个应用，我们研究了MPX如何随刺激支票规模变化，并发现与纯非耐用品支出模型相比，其下降得更慢。

records.title_en: Union Bargaining Power and the Amenity-Wage Trade-Off
records.title_cn: 工会谈判力量与便利设施-工资权衡
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how collective bargaining affects wages and amenities. By merging collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) to linked employer-employee data in Brazil, I combine rich contracted amenities with wage information. I implement a difference-in-differences strategy that exploits a court ruling enforcing CBA continuation (i.e., ultra-activity) to estimate the effects of union bargaining power. Strengthening unions raises wages and amenities without reducing employment—increasing retention despite some labor-labor substitution. A revealed-preference approach shows that amenities account for 45 percent of total compensation gains. These findings suggest that collective bargaining can offset monopsony power, but employers retain the right-to-manage workforce composition.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究集体谈判如何影响工资和便利设施。通过将集体谈判协议（CBAs）与巴西的雇主-雇员匹配数据合并，我将丰富的合同约定便利设施与工资信息相结合。我实施了一项双重差分策略，利用一项强制执行CBA延续（即超期效力）的法院裁决来估计工会谈判力量的影响。加强工会提高了工资和便利设施，而没有减少就业——尽管存在一些劳动-劳动替代，仍提高了留任率。显示偏好方法表明，便利设施占总体报酬增益的45%。这些发现表明，集体谈判可以抵消买方垄断力量，但雇主保留管理劳动力构成的权利。

records.title_en: Inequality and Racial Backlash: Evidence from the Reconstruction Era and the Freedmen's Bureau
records.title_cn: 不平等与种族反弹：重建时代与自由民局的证据
records.abstract_en: How do majority groups respond to narrowing inequality in racially polarized environments? We study this by examining the Freedmen's Bureau, an agency created after the US Civil War to aid former slaves and launch institutional reform in the South. Using new historical records and an event-study approach, we estimate the bureau's impact on political, social, and economic outcomes. Vote shares for Democrats, the party that previously championed slavery and opposed Black civil rights, initially eroded in bureau counties, but these impacts faded as federal oversight weakened. Racial backlash emerged rapidly and persisted, suggesting White majorities sought to offset Black progress.
records.abstract_cn: 在种族两极化的环境中，多数群体如何应对不平等的缩小？我们通过考察自由民局来研究这一问题，该机构在美国内战之后创建，旨在援助前奴隶并在南方启动制度改革。利用新的历史记录和事件研究法，我们估计了该局对政治、社会和经济结果的影响。民主党——此前曾倡导奴隶制并反对黑人公民权利的政党——的得票份额在自由民局所在县最初出现下降，但随着联邦监管的削弱，这些影响逐渐消退。种族反弹迅速出现并持续存在，表明白人多数群体试图抵消黑人的进步。

records.title_en: The Inflation Attention Threshold and Inflation Surges
records.title_cn: 通胀关注阈值与通胀飙升
records.abstract_en: The recent inflation surge brought inflation back on people's minds. I quantify when and how much attention to inflation changes and derive the macroeconomic implications of these attention changes. I estimate an attention threshold at an inflation rate of 4 percent, that attention doubles when inflation exceeds this threshold, and that supply shocks have stronger and more persistent effects on inflation in times of high attention. Developing a model featuring the attention threshold, I show that attention changes offer a joint explanation for inflation surges, inflation's co-movement with inflation expectations, and a long last mile of disinflation.
records.abstract_cn: 近期的通胀飙升使通胀重新回到人们的关注之中。我量化了人们对通胀变化的关注程度及其变化时机，并推导出这些关注变化的宏观经济含义。我估计出通胀率为4%时的关注阈值，当通胀超过该阈值时关注度翻倍，并且在高关注时期供给冲击对通胀的影响更强且更持久。通过构建一个包含关注阈值的模型，我表明关注变化为通胀飙升、通胀与通胀预期的共同变动以及去通胀的漫长最后一英里提供了联合解释。

records.title_en: The Causal Effects of Global Supply Chain Disruptions on Macroeconomic Outcomes: Evidence and Theory
records.title_cn: 全球供应链中断对宏观经济结果的因果效应：证据与理论
records.abstract_en: We study the causal effects of global supply chain disruptions by constructing a new index of real-time port congestion using Automatic Identification System data from container ships and a spatial clustering algorithm. We develop a model with search frictions between producers and retailers that links upstream production slack to downstream supply shortages and captures output and price responses to supply chain shocks. The co-movements of output, prices, spare capacity, and market tightness provide novel identification restrictions. We find that demand and supply shocks drove US disinflation in 2020, while the inflation surge in 2021 was driven mainly by supply chain shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过使用集装箱船的自动识别系统数据和空间聚类算法构建一个新的实时港口拥堵指数，研究全球供应链中断的因果效应。我们开发了一个包含生产商与零售商之间搜索摩擦的模型，该模型将上游生产松弛与下游供应短缺联系起来，并捕捉产出和价格对供应链冲击的响应。产出、价格、闲置产能和市场紧俏度的共同变动提供了新的识别限制。我们发现，需求冲击和供给冲击推动了2020美国的通胀放缓，而2021的通胀飙升主要由供应链冲击驱动。

records.title_en: Firm Adaptation in Production Networks: Evidence from Extreme Weather Events in Pakistan
records.title_cn: 生产网络中的企业适应：来自巴基斯坦极端天气事件的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper considers how far private adaptation may reduce future vulnerability to climate risks. Using data on monthly firm-to-firm transactions from Pakistan, we find that flood-affected firms are more likely to relocate to safer ground and shift purchases toward suppliers in less flood-prone regions and reached via less flood-prone roads. The results indicate that firms are imperfectly informed about flood risk and update their beliefs following floods. We quantify aggregate impacts using a spatial model of endogenous production network formation. The findings suggest that firms' learning will shape the economic impact of increasingly frequent climate-related disasters.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察私人适应能在多大程度上降低未来对气候风险的脆弱性。使用巴基斯坦企业间月度交易数据，我们发现受洪水影响的企业更可能迁往更安全的地段，并将采购转向位于洪水较少发生地区、且通过洪水较少发生道路抵达的供应商。结果表明，企业对洪水风险的信息是不完全的，并会在洪水后更新其信念。我们使用内生生产网络形成的空间模型量化总体影响。研究结果表明，企业的学习将塑造日益频繁的气候相关灾害的经济影响。

records.title_en: Reproducible Aggregation of Sample-Split Statistics
records.title_cn: 样本分割统计量的可复现聚合
records.abstract_en: Statistical inference is often simplified by sample splitting. This simplification comes at the cost of the introduction of randomness not native to the data. We propose a simple procedure for sequentially aggregating statistics constructed with multiple splits of the same sample. The user specifies a bound and a nominal error rate. If the procedure is implemented twice on the same data, the nominal error rate approximates the chance that the results differ by more than the bound. We illustrate the application of the procedure to several widely applied econometric methods.
records.abstract_cn: 统计推断常因样本分割而简化。这种简化以引入非数据本身固有的随机性为代价。我们提出一个简单程序，用于对同一样本多次分割所构造的统计量进行序贯聚合。用户指定一个界限和一个名义错误率。若该程序在同一数据上实施两次，名义错误率近似于结果差异超过该界限的概率。我们说明了该程序在若干广泛应用的计量经济学方法中的应用。

records.title_en: Competitive Bottlenecks and Platform Spillovers
records.title_cn: 竞争性瓶颈与平台溢出效应
records.abstract_en: We provide a general framework to analyze competition between oligopolistic platforms in competitive bottleneck settings, allowing for pricing and nonprice design choices by platforms, and post-participation buyer-seller decisions. We show that equilibrium choices by platforms are distorted against sellers' interests in a way harmful to welfare (e.g., setting excessive commission fees), and that an increase in the number of competing platforms can exacerbate this distortion. We also characterize how buyer-side heterogeneity in interaction benefits, partial market coverage, platform asymmetry, and cross-platform spillovers further amplify or mitigate welfare distortions. Based on our findings, we discuss policy implications for mobile app platforms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个一般性框架，用于分析竞争性瓶颈环境中寡头平台之间的竞争，允许平台进行定价和非价格设计选择，以及参与后的买方-卖方决策。我们表明，平台的均衡选择以损害卖方利益的方式被扭曲，从而有害于福利（例如，设定过高的佣金费用），并且竞争平台数量的增加可能加剧这种扭曲。我们还刻画了互动收益中的买方异质性、部分市场覆盖、平台不对称性和跨平台溢出如何进一步放大或缓解福利扭曲。基于我们的发现，我们讨论了对移动应用平台的政策启示。

records.title_en: Recurring Auctions with Costly Entry: Theory and Evidence
records.title_cn: 具有高昂进入成本的重复拍卖：理论与证据
records.abstract_en: Recurring auctions are widely used to sell durable assets, with follow-up auctions held for unsold items. We investigate such auctions theoretically and empirically. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that recurring auctions outperform single-round auctions when buyers face entry costs, enhancing efficiency and revenue due to sorted entry of potential buyers. Optimal reserve price sequences are characterized. Empirical findings from home foreclosure auctions in China reveal significant annual gains in efficiency (US$3.40 billion, 16.60 percent) and revenue (US$2.97 billion, 15.92 percent) using recurring auctions compared with single-round auctions. Implementing optimal reserve prices can further improve efficiency (3.35 percent) and revenue (3.06 percent).
records.abstract_cn: 重复拍卖被广泛用于出售耐用资产，未售出物品会举行后续拍卖。我们从理论和实证两方面研究此类拍卖。理论分析表明，当买方面临进入成本时，重复拍卖优于单轮拍卖，由于潜在买方的分类进入，提高了效率和收入。最优保留价序列得到了刻画。来自中国住房止赎拍卖的实证发现显示，与单轮拍卖相比，使用重复拍卖在效率（US$3.40 billion，16.60%）和收入（US$2.97 billion，15.92%）方面带来显著的年度增益。实施最优保留价可以进一步提高效率（3.35%）和收入（3.06%）。

records.title_en: Innovation and Competition on a Rugged Technological Landscape
records.title_cn: 崎岖技术景观上的创新与竞争
records.abstract_en: We integrate innovation into Hotelling's classic model of spatial competition. Potential entrants arrive sequentially and choose whether and where to innovate. They can innovate beyond the frontier, expanding the boundary of the market, or within a niche between incumbent products. Product quality is learned only after introduction, and uncertainty increases with novelty. Innovation on a rugged technological landscape is irregular, with frequent changes in direction and cycles between frontier and niche innovation. The ruggedness of the technological landscape itself deters innovation, generating fewer entrants, less product differentiation, narrower markets, and more intense competition than under certainty.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将创新融入Hotelling的经典空间竞争模型。潜在进入者依次到达，并选择是否创新以及在哪里创新。它们可以在前沿之外进行创新，扩展市场边界，也可以在现有产品之间的利基中进行创新。产品质量只有在引入后才会被了解，且不确定性随新颖性增加而上升。崎岖技术景观上的创新是不规则的，方向频繁变化，并在前沿创新与利基创新之间循环。技术景观本身的崎岖性会抑制创新，与确定性情形相比，产生更少的进入者、更少的产品差异化、更窄的市场以及更激烈的竞争。

records.title_en: Targeted Advertising in Elections
records.title_cn: 选举中的定向广告
records.abstract_en: How does targeted advertising influence electoral outcomes? This paper presents a one-dimensional spatial model of voting in which a privately informed challenger persuades voters to support him over the status quo. I show that targeted advertising enables the challenger to persuade voters with opposing preferences and swing elections decided by such voters. Ex ante commitment power is unnecessary—the challenger succeeds by strategically revealing different pieces of verifiable information to different voters. Publicizing all political ads would mitigate the negative effects of targeted advertising and help voters collectively make the right choice.
records.abstract_cn: 定向广告如何影响选举结果？本文提出了一个一维空间投票模型，其中拥有私人信息的挑战者说服选民支持他而非现状。我表明，定向广告使挑战者能够说服偏好相反的选民，并扭转由这类选民决定的选举。事前承诺能力并非必要——挑战者通过策略性地向不同选民披露不同的可验证信息而取得成功。公开所有政治广告将减轻定向广告的负面影响，并帮助选民集体做出正确选择。

records.title_en: Degree-Weighted Social Learning
records.title_cn: 度数加权社会学习
records.abstract_en: We study social learning in which agents weight neighbors' opinions differently based on their degrees, capturing situations in which agents place more trust in well-connected individuals or, conversely, discount their influence. We derive asymptotic properties of learning outcomes in large stochastic networks and analyze how the weighting rule affects societal wisdom and convergence speed. We find that assigning greater weight to higher-degree neighbors harms wisdom but has a non-monotonic effect on convergence speed, depending on the diversity of views within high- and low-degree groups, highlighting a potential trade-off between convergence speed and wisdom.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究社会学习，其中代理人根据邻居的度数对其意见赋予不同权重，刻画了代理人更信任关系广泛的个体或反过来 discount 其影响的情形。我们推导大型随机网络中学习结果的渐近性质，并分析加权规则如何影响社会智慧与收敛速度。我们发现，赋予高度数邻居更大权重会损害智慧，但对收敛速度具有非单调效应，取决于高度数群体与低度数群体内部观点的多样性，凸显了收敛速度与智慧之间潜在的权衡。

records.title_en: Cognitive Ability and Perceived Disagreement in Learning
records.title_cn: 认知能力与学习中的感知分歧
records.abstract_en: Do agents believe they agree more with others over time? This paper explores how individuals perceive the belief-updating behavior of others and the resulting disagreement in a sequential experiment with public information. We uncover a persistent gap in the perception of disagreement as a function of cognitive ability. Higher cognitive ability correlates with less perceived disagreement, although the average subject underestimates the extent of actual disagreement. Information about a partner's cognitive ability only impacts perceived disagreement when the partner has a low test score. Our findings highlight the roles of overconfidence and cognitive projection in shaping these perceptions.
records.abstract_cn: 随着时间的推移，个体是否会认为自己与他人更加一致？本文通过一个包含公共信息的序贯实验，探讨个体如何感知他人的信念更新行为以及由此产生的分歧。我们发现，感知分歧中存在一种持续存在的差距，且该差距取决于认知能力。较高的认知能力与较低的感知分歧相关，尽管平均而言，受试者低估了实际分歧的程度。关于伴侣认知能力的信息仅在伴侣测试分数较低时才会影响感知分歧。我们的发现凸显了过度自信和认知投射在塑造这些感知中的作用。

records.title_en: Electoral Campaign Attacks: Theory and Evidence
records.title_cn: 选举竞选攻击：理论与证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the determinants of electoral campaign attacks. We first propose a model to examine the main factors that influence candidates' decisions to attack. Our theoretical analysis yields a number of predictions that we test using information from "right of reply" lawsuits filed in Brazil. Our empirical analysis exploits a regression discontinuity design based on virtual ties between second- and third-place candidates to show that candidates with an electoral advantage are more likely to receive an attack. We then exploit another discontinuity to show that the patterns of campaign attacks differ significantly under single- and dual-ballot plurality systems.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究选举竞选攻击的决定因素。我们首先提出一个模型来考察影响候选人决定攻击的主要因素。我们的理论分析得出若干预测，并利用巴西提起的“答辩权”诉讼信息对这些预测进行检验。我们的实证分析利用基于第二名和第三名候选人之间虚拟平局的回归断点设计，表明具有选举优势的候选人更可能受到攻击。随后我们利用另一个断点表明，在单轮和双轮多数制下，竞选攻击的模式存在显著差异。

records.title_en: Land, Wealth, and Taxation
records.title_cn: 土地、财富与税收
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the role of land in wealth dynamics and its consequences for efficiency and inequality. We focus on the interplay among agents' bidding for location, mortgage market imperfections, and inheritance in a model in which agents leave to their heirs financial bequests and their housing wealth. The borrowing constraint generates a housing return premium and spatial wealth sorting, which translate into persistent wealth inequality. Since altruism and the borrowing constraint distort land price formation, we show that taxing land rent transmitted between generations is optimal. Land taxation cannot be disconnected from taxation on intergenerational wealth transfers.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察土地在财富动态中的作用及其对效率与不平等的影响。我们聚焦于代理人区位竞价、抵押市场不完美与遗产继承之间的相互作用，构建了一个代理人向继承人留下金融遗赠与住房财富的模型。借贷约束产生了住房回报溢价与空间财富排序，二者转化为持续的财富不平等。由于利他主义与借贷约束扭曲了土地价格形成，我们证明对代际间传递的土地租金征税是最优的。土地税收不能与代际财富转移税收相分离。

records.title_en: The Perils of Overreaction
records.title_cn: 过度反应的危险
records.abstract_en: To study updating rules, we consider the problem of a malevolent principal screening an imperfectly Bayesian agent. We uncover a fundamental dichotomy between underreaction and overreaction to information. If, for some signal realization, the agent's updating rule produces a posterior that lies outside the convex hull of the Bayesian posteriors induced by the signal structure, she can be exploited by the principal without bound: Her ex ante expected loss can be made arbitrarily large. In contrast, an agent who underreacts—whose posterior after each signal realization lies between the prior and the corresponding Bayesian posterior—cannot be exploited at all.
records.abstract_cn: 为了研究更新规则，我们考虑一个恶意委托人筛选一个不完全贝叶斯代理人的问题。我们揭示了对信息反应不足与反应过度之间的根本二分法。如果对于某个信号实现，代理人的更新规则产生的后验位于由信号结构诱导的贝叶斯后验的凸包之外，那么她可以被委托人无限制地利用：她的事前预期损失可以被弄得任意大。相反，一个反应不足的代理人——其在每个信号实现后的后验位于先验与相应贝叶斯后验之间——完全不能被利用。

records.title_en: Optimal Procurement Design: A Reduced-Form Approach
records.title_cn: 最优采购设计：一种简化形式方法
records.abstract_en: Standard procurement models assume that the buyer knows the quality of the good at the time of procurement; however, in many settings, the quality is learned only long after the transaction. We study procurement problems in which the buyer's valuation of the supplied good depends directly on its quality, which is unverifiable and unobservable to the buyer. For a broad class of procurement problems, we identify procurement mechanisms maximizing any weighted average of the buyer's expected payoff and social surplus. The optimal mechanism can be implemented via an auction that restricts sellers to submitting bids within specific intervals.
records.abstract_cn: 标准采购模型假设买方在采购时知道商品的质量；然而，在许多情形下，质量只有在交易很久之后才能得知。我们研究买方对所供应商品的估值直接取决于其质量的采购问题，而该质量对买方而言不可验证且不可观测。对于一大类采购问题，我们识别出使买方期望收益与社会剩余的任意加权平均最大化的采购机制。最优机制可通过一种限制卖方在特定区间内提交投标的拍卖来实施。

records.title_en: Reputation and Competitive Selection
records.title_cn: 声誉与竞争性选择
records.abstract_en: We demonstrate how selection in competitive markets can impede long-run reputational incentives. In our model, competent firms can exert costly effort to improve expected product quality, but inept firms cannot. With low entry barriers, we show competent firms cannot persistently exert effort, despite bounded memory. Such effort would cause consumers to select firms based on reputations for competence, eventually selecting a monopolist with an arbitrarily high reputation, which has no incentive for effort. More generally, reputation-based selection rules out long-run effort, which undermines the basis for such selection. Intermediate entry barriers provide stronger reputational incentives than low or high barriers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们展示了竞争市场中的选择如何阻碍长期声誉激励。在我们的模型中，有能力的企业可以付出 costly effort 来提高预期产品质量，而无能力的企业则不能。在低进入壁垒下，我们表明有能力的企业无法持续付出努力，尽管记忆是有界的。这种努力会导致消费者基于能力声誉来选择企业，最终选择一个拥有任意高声誉的垄断者，而该垄断者没有努力激励。更一般地，基于声誉的选择排除了长期努力，这削弱了这种选择的基础。中等进入壁垒比低或高壁垒提供了更强的声誉激励。

records.title_en: Symmetric Equilibrium in Pre-auction Investment
records.title_cn: 拍卖前投资中的对称均衡
records.abstract_en: We characterize the symmetric equilibria of a pre-auction game of investment in an internet ad auction environment. For a wide class of auction formats, we show a symmetric equilibrium exists for the pre-auction investment game, is essentially unique, and is the same for all auction formats in the class. We give sufficient conditions for the symmetric equilibrium to be in pure strategies and to achieve the efficient level of investment. Finally, we show comparative statics results with respect to a variety of parameters.
records.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了互联网广告拍卖环境中拍卖前投资博弈的对称均衡。对于一大类拍卖形式，我们证明拍卖前投资博弈存在对称均衡，该均衡本质上是唯一的，并且对于该类中的所有拍卖形式都相同。我们给出了对称均衡为纯策略并实现有效投资水平的充分条件。最后，我们展示了一系列参数下的比较静态结果。

records.title_en: Competing Diffusions in a Social Network
records.title_cn: 社交网络中的竞争性扩散
records.abstract_en: We develop a model of competing diffusions of goods on a social network. There are two types of goods and individuals: mass-market and niche-market. There is a unique stable steady state, and the adoption of a mass-market good is greater than its population share. Greater connectivity and homophily will concurrently increase the prevalence of niche-market goods. If there is a strategic agent who wants to promote a niche good, she will invest more in influencing activities than one promoting mass-market goods. When individuals choose their degree of homophily, niche-market individuals exhibit greater homophily than mass-market ones.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个社交网络中商品竞争性扩散的模型。商品和个体均分为两种类型：大众市场与利基市场。存在唯一的稳定稳态，且大众市场商品的采用率高于其人口份额。更高的连通性和同质性将同时提高利基市场商品的普及率。若存在一个旨在推广利基商品的策略性主体，其影响力活动投入将高于推广大众市场商品的主体。当个体选择其同质性程度时，利基市场个体表现出比大众市场个体更高的同质性。

records.title_en: Learning in the Marriage Market: The Economics of Dating
records.title_cn: 婚姻市场中的学习：约会经济学
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a search-and-matching model where potential partners can learn about their compatibility as a couple by spending time together (interpreted as dating). We show that a steady-state equilibrium exists and characterize its induced dating patterns. In equilibrium, highly attractive individuals are more selective. We derive conditions under which equilibria induce positive assortative matching and show that even when these conditions hold, the socially optimal outcome can exhibit negative assortative matching. Finally, the framework is applied to study the effect of recent advances in search technologies on dating patterns and the connection between dating and interracial segregation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个搜寻匹配模型，其中潜在伴侣可以通过共度时光（解释为约会）来了解他们作为一对的契合度。我们证明稳态均衡存在，并刻画其引致的约会模式。在均衡中，高吸引力个体更具选择性。我们推导出均衡引致正向 assortative matching 的条件，并表明即使这些条件成立，社会最优结果也可能呈现负向 assortative matching。最后，该框架被应用于研究近期搜索技术的进步对约会模式的影响，以及约会与跨种族隔离之间的联系。

records.title_en: Strategic Limit Orders and Intertemporal Price Dispersion
records.title_cn: 策略性限价订单与跨期价格离散
records.abstract_en: We study a two-period commodity market with competitive consumers and Cournot sellers. Without speculation, equilibrium is stationary. A storage-capable, strategically large speculator can profitably create deterministic intertemporal price dispersion using standard order types. A period-1 limit buy order flattens residual demand, induces higher output, and yields a low purchase price. With mandatory liquidation, resale remains below the no-speculation price but above the purchase price, so the speculator profits; consumers gain and sellers lose. With free disposal and a stop-loss, the period-2 price can exceed the benchmark, benefiting sellers but harming consumers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个具有竞争性消费者和古诺卖者的两期商品市场。在没有投机的情况下，均衡是平稳的。一个具备储存能力、具有策略性规模的大型投机者可以利用标准订单类型有利可图地制造确定性的跨期价格离散。一个第1期的限价买入订单使剩余需求变平，引致更高产出，并产生较低的购买价格。在强制清算下，转售价格仍低于无投机价格但高于购买价格，因此投机者获利；消费者获益而卖者受损。在自由处置和止损条件下，第2期价格可能超过基准，使卖者受益但损害消费者。

records.title_en: Monopolistic Data Dumping
records.title_cn: 垄断性数据倾销
records.abstract_en: A profit-maximizing monopolist curates a database for users seeking to learn a parameter. There are two user types: "Nowcasters" wish to learn the parameter's current value, while "forecasters" target its long-run value. Data storage involves a constant marginal cost. The monopolist designs a menu of contracts described by fees and data-access levels. The profit-maximizing menu offers full access to historical data, while current data are fully provided to nowcasters but may be withheld from forecasters. Compared to the social optimum, the monopolist keeps too much historical data, keeps too little current data, and may store too much data overall.
records.abstract_cn: 一个追求利润最大化的垄断者为寻求学习某一参数的用户整理数据库。用户有两种类型：“即时预测者”希望了解该参数的当前值，而“预测者”则以其长期值为目标。数据存储涉及不变的边际成本。垄断者设计一份由费用和数据访问水平描述的合同菜单。利润最大化的菜单提供对历史数据的完全访问，而当前数据完全提供给即时预测者，但可能对预测者保留。与社会最优相比，垄断者保留过多的历史数据，保留过少的当前数据，并且总体上可能存储过多的数据。

records.title_en: Coalitional manipulability in school choice
records.title_cn: 择校中的联盟可操纵性
records.abstract_en: We compare the degree of coalitional manipulability across stable school‐choice mechanisms. Although no stable mechanism is group strategy‐proof for all school choice contexts, we show that the student‐optimal stable mechanism is the least manipulable by coalitions, whereas the school‐optimal stable mechanism is the most coalitionally manipulable. These results still hold when students can only report truncated preferences, when the set of coalitions is limited, or when schools cannot be declared unacceptable as long as there are more available seats than students. In contrast, if there is a shortage of seats and students have no outside options, the school‐optimal stable mechanism can be less manipulable by coalitions than the student‐optimal stable mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 我们比较了稳定择校机制之间的联盟可操纵程度。尽管没有一种稳定机制在所有择校情境下都是群体策略防篡改的，但我们表明，学生最优稳定机制是最不易被联盟操纵的，而学校最优稳定机制则是最易被联盟操纵的。当学生只能报告截断偏好、当联盟集合受限，或当只要可用席位多于学生时学校不能被声明为不可接受时，这些结果仍然成立。相反，如果席位短缺且学生没有外部选项，学校最优稳定机制可能比学生最优稳定机制更不易被联盟操纵。

records.title_en: Physical versus digital currency A difference that makes a difference
records.title_cn: 实物货币与数字货币：一种产生差异的差异
records.abstract_en: This paper compares digital and physical currency, focusing on a single intrinsic difference: digital, unlike physical currency, allows the monetary authority to trace the monetary flows in and out of the accounts. We show that this technological advance in recordkeeping can be used by the monetary authority to improve upon physical currency and achieve efficiency in a wide range of circumstances.
records.abstract_cn: 本文比较了数字货币与实物货币，聚焦于一个内在差异：与实物货币不同，数字货币允许货币当局追踪账户中货币的流入和流出。我们表明，这种记账技术的进步可以被货币当局用来改进实物货币，并在广泛的情形中实现效率。

records.title_en: Ruth, Anthony, and Clarence
records.title_cn: 露丝、安东尼和克拉伦斯
records.abstract_en: Nonpartisan voters can become polarized not because of ideology but because it is optimal for them to remain uninformed and cancel out the votes of uninformed voters on “the other side.” Indeed, when stuck in such a state of polarization, it is socially optimal to do so. Dynamics can lead an otherwise well‐functioning assembly into irreversible polarization. Reputation effects might only make things worse.
records.abstract_cn: 无党派选民可能变得两极分化，不是因为意识形态，而是因为对他们来说，保持不知情并抵消“另一方”不知情选民的选票是最优的。事实上，当陷入这种两极分化状态时，这样做在社会层面是最优的。动态过程可能导致一个原本运作良好的议会陷入不可逆的两极分化。声誉效应可能只会让情况变得更糟。

records.title_en: When autarky trumps free and costless trade
records.title_cn: 当自给自足胜过自由且无成本的贸易时
records.abstract_en: In the context of Krugman's (1979) canonical new trade model, we demonstrate that a country is better off in autarky than in free and costless trade when the productivity of its trading partner is sufficiently low.
records.abstract_cn: 在Krugman（1979）的经典新贸易模型背景下，我们证明，当其贸易伙伴的生产率足够低时，一个国家在自给自足状态下比在自由且无成本的贸易中境况更好。

records.title_en: Ratings design and barriers to entry
records.title_cn: 评级设计与进入壁垒
records.abstract_en: I study the impact of consumer reviews on the incentives for firms to participate in the market. I develop a model of endogenous entry in which firms produce goods of heterogeneous, unknown quality. Consumers engage in directed search, and prices are exogenously fixed. A rater uses consumer reviews to construct firm‐specific ratings that are informative of quality and help consumers direct their search. The main insight of the paper is that suppressing the reviews of highly‐rated firms strengthens entry incentives and improves consumer welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究消费者评论对企业参与市场激励的影响。我构建了一个内生进入模型，其中企业生产质量异质且未知的商品。消费者进行定向搜索，价格外生固定。评级者利用消费者评论构建企业特定评级，这些评级能提供关于质量的信息并帮助消费者进行定向搜索。本文的主要洞见是，压制高评级企业的评论会增强进入激励并改善消费者福利。

records.title_en: Efficient investment, search, and sorting in matching markets
records.title_cn: 匹配市场中的有效投资、搜索与排序
records.abstract_en: We study markets where heterogeneous agents first make investment decisions and then engage in a costly search to form productive matches. The trading process is a random search and bargaining with explicit search costs. Despite potential hold‐up and matching problems, we prove that the constrained efficient allocation is an equilibrium: the agents' private incentives to invest and to accept/reject potential partners as they search are perfectly aligned with the social benefit. Furthermore, we establish a new sorting result for two‐sided markets, equilibrium existence, and conditions for uniqueness.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究异质性代理人首先做出投资决策，然后进行有成本的搜索以形成生产性匹配的市场。交易过程是带有显性搜索成本的随机搜索与议价。尽管存在潜在的套牢和匹配问题，我们证明约束有效配置是一个均衡：代理人在搜索过程中投资以及接受/拒绝潜在伙伴的私人激励与社会收益完全一致。此外，我们为双边市场建立了一个新的排序结果、均衡存在性以及唯一性的条件。

records.title_en: Engagement maximization
records.title_cn: 参与度最大化
records.abstract_en: We investigate the management of information provision to maximize user engagement. A principal sequentially reveals signals to an agent who has a limited amount of information processing capacity and can choose to exit at any time. We identify a “dilution” strategy—sending rare but highly informative signals—that maximizes user engagement. The platform's engagement metric shapes the direction and magnitude of biases in provided information relative to a user‐optimal benchmark. Even without intertemporal commitment, the platform replicates full‐commitment revenue by inducing the user's belief to remain “as uncertain as” the prior until the rare, decisive signal arrives and induces stopping. We apply our results to two contexts: an ad‐supported internet media platform and a teacher attempting to engage test‐motivated students.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究信息提供管理以最大化用户参与度。一个委托方依次向一个信息处理能力有限且可随时选择退出的代理人揭示信号。我们识别出一种“稀释”策略——发送罕见但信息量极高的信号——能够最大化用户参与度。平台的参与度指标塑造了所提供信息相对于用户最优基准的偏差方向和幅度。即使没有跨期承诺，平台也能通过诱导用户的信念在罕见的决定性信号到来并引发停止之前保持“与”先验“一样不确定”，从而复制完全承诺下的收益。我们将结果应用于两个情境：一个广告支持的互联网媒体平台，以及一位试图吸引应试动机学生的教师。

records.title_en: Improving robust decisions with data
records.title_cn: 利用数据改进稳健决策
records.abstract_en: A decision‐maker faces uncertainty governed by a data‐generating process (DGP), which is only known to belong to a set of sequences of independent but possibly non‐identical distributions. A robust decision maximizes the expected payoff against the worst possible DGP in this set. This paper characterizes when and how such robust decisions can be objectively improved with data; that is, can yield higher expected payoffs under the true DGP regardless of which DGP is the truth. It further develops simple and novel inference procedures that achieve such improvement, while common methods (e.g., maximum likelihood) may fail to do so.
records.abstract_cn: 决策者面临由数据生成过程（DGP）所支配的不确定性，而该过程仅已知属于一组独立但可能非同分布的分布序列。稳健决策最大化在此集合中最不利的可能DGP下的期望收益。本文刻画了此类稳健决策何时以及如何能够借助数据得到客观改进；即在真实DGP下，无论哪个DGP为真，都能产生更高的期望收益。本文进一步提出了简单且新颖的推断程序以实现这种改进，而常见方法（例如最大似然）可能无法做到这一点。

records.title_en: News media as suppliers of narratives (and information)
records.title_cn: 新闻媒体作为叙事（和信息）的提供者
records.abstract_en: We present a model in which news media shape beliefs by providing information (signals about an exogenous state) and narratives (models of what determines outcomes). To amplify consumers' engagement, the media maximize their anticipatory utility. We characterize the optimal monopolistic media strategy, highlighting the synergy between false narratives and biased information. Consumer heterogeneity gives rise to a novel menu‐design problem due to an “equilibrium data externality” among consumers. The optimal menu includes false narratives, and can generate polarized beliefs and choices without any information transmission. False narratives and polarization also feature in a competitive version of our model, albeit coupled with complete information. Nevertheless, competition can make some consumers objectively worse off.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个模型，其中新闻媒体通过提供信息（关于外生状态的信号）和叙事（关于结果决定因素的模型）来塑造信念。为了放大消费者的参与度，媒体最大化其预期效用。我们刻画了最优垄断媒体策略，强调了虚假叙事与有偏信息之间的协同作用。消费者异质性由于消费者之间的“均衡数据外部性”而引发了一个新颖的菜单设计问题。最优菜单包括虚假叙事，并且可以在没有任何信息传递的情况下产生极化的信念和选择。虚假叙事和极化在我们的模型的竞争版本中也存在，尽管伴随着完全信息。然而，竞争可能使一些消费者的客观状况变得更糟。

records.title_en: A general theory of inverse welfare functions
records.title_cn: 逆福利函数的一般理论
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a general theory to recover the inverse welfare function that rationalizes a given tax schedule as optimal. Our theory allows for complex environments including the presence of multidimensional tax schedules, bunching/jumping behavior, optimization frictions, general equilibrium effects, and externalities. We show that inverse welfare functions can be used to test for Pareto efficiency, construct Pareto improving reforms, and characterize the set of welfare improving local reforms, thereby extending previous results to more general environments. We show numerically that allowing for such generalities can have meaningful impacts on inverse welfare functions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文发展了一种一般理论，以恢复使给定税收schedule作为最优的逆福利函数。我们的理论允许复杂环境，包括存在多维税收schedule、聚集/跳跃行为、优化摩擦、一般均衡效应和外部性。我们表明，逆福利函数可用于检验帕累托效率、构建帕累托改进改革，并刻画福利改进的局部改革集合，从而将先前结果扩展到更一般的环境。我们通过数值方法表明，允许此类一般性可能对逆福利函数产生有意义的影响。

records.title_en: Benefits and challenges of ambiguous product information
records.title_cn: 模糊产品信息的益处与挑战
records.abstract_en: We study the welfare effects of ambiguous product information for a buyer with α ‐max‐min preferences and a price‐setting seller. The buyer privately receives information about her valuation. We show that both the seller and the buyer can benefit when this information is ambiguous, and we characterize all possible combinations of producer and consumer surplus, as evaluated under ambiguity‐sensitive preferences. Ambiguity concerning the valuation perceived by the buyer when making the purchase decision can induce the seller to change the price. Before receiving information, ambiguity concerning the purchase decision can make the buyer optimistic about buying only for high valuations, which relaxes the participation constraint.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有α-max-min偏好的买方与设定价格的卖方在模糊产品信息下的福利效应。买方私下收到关于其估值的信号。我们表明，当该信息模糊时，卖方和买方均可受益，并且我们刻画了在模糊敏感偏好下评估的生产者剩余与消费者剩余的所有可能组合。买方在做出购买决策时感知到的关于估值的模糊性可以促使卖方改变价格。在收到信息之前，关于购买决策的模糊性可以使买方仅对高估值持乐观购买态度，从而放松参与约束。

records.title_en: Binary choice under asymmetric loss in a data‐rich environment: Theory and an application to algorithmic fairness
records.title_cn: 数据丰富环境中不对称损失下的二元选择：算法公平性的理论与应用
records.abstract_en: We study the binary choice problem in a data‐rich environment with asymmetric loss functions. The econometrics literature covers nonparametric binary choice problems but does not offer computationally attractive solutions in data‐rich environments. The machine learning literature has many algorithms but is focused mostly on loss functions that are independent of covariates. We show that theoretically valid decisions on binary outcomes with general loss functions can be achieved via a very simple loss‐based reweighting of logistic regression or state‐of‐the‐art machine learning techniques. We apply our analysis to algorithmic fairness in pretrial detentions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有不对称损失函数的数据丰富环境中的二元选择问题。计量经济学文献涵盖了非参数二元选择问题，但没有在数据丰富的环境中提供计算上有吸引力的解决方案。机器学习文献有许多算法，但主要关注独立于协变量的损失函数。我们表明，理论上可以通过非常简单的基于损失的逻辑回归重新加权或最先进的机器学习技术来实现对具有一般损失函数的二元结果的有效决策。我们将分析应用于审前拘留中的算法公平性。

records.title_en: Remittance frictions and seasonal poverty
records.title_cn: 汇款摩擦和季节性贫困
records.abstract_en: Seasonal migration is a common strategy to mitigate rural seasonal deprivation, but migrants need to remit money during the lean season to family members facing food shortages. We observe counterintuitively low remittances in rural Nepal during periods of seasonal hunger, and migrants return with remittances later during harvest when food is relatively abundant. To indirectly overcome this apparent constraint in remittance timing, we provide a $90 consumption loan to randomly selected rural households during the pre‐harvest lean season. Loan‐recipient households increase pre‐harvest investments in fertilizer and time spent working on their own farm, smooth consumption, and save more of their migration income to bring it back home. Food security, subjective well‐being, rice harvest, and revenues improve. Ninety‐eight percent of beneficiaries repay the loan with the increased harvest‐period remittance. In a two‐period model of household decision making, we show that remittance frictions—a market failure—are necessary to qualitatively match our experimental results.
records.abstract_cn: 季节性移民是缓解农村季节性贫困的常见策略，但移民需要在青黄不接的季节向面临粮食短缺的家庭成员汇款。我们观察到，在季节性饥饿期间，尼泊尔农村地区的汇款出乎意料地低，而移民则在粮食相对丰富的收获季节带着汇款返回。为了间接克服汇款时间上的这种明显限制，我们在收获前的淡季期间向随机选择的农村家庭提供90美元的消费贷款。贷款接受户增加收获前化肥投资和自家农场劳动时间，平稳消费，并节省更多外出务工收入带回家。粮食安全、主观幸福感、水稻丰收和收入改善。百分之九十八的受益人通过增加收获期汇款偿还贷款。在家庭决策的二周期模型中，我们表明汇款摩擦（市场失灵）对于定性地匹配我们的实验结果是必要的。

records.title_en: Large structural VARs with multiple sign and ranking restrictions
records.title_cn: 具有多重符号和排名限制的大型结构 VAR
records.abstract_en: Large VARs are increasingly used in structural analysis as a unified framework to study the impacts of multiple structural shocks simultaneously. However, the concurrent identification of multiple shocks using sign and ranking restrictions poses significant practical challenges to the point where existing algorithms cannot be used with such large VARs. To address this, we introduce a new numerically efficient algorithm that facilitates the estimation of impulse responses and related measures in large structural VARs identified with a large number of structural restrictions on impulse responses. The methodology is illustrated using a 35‐variable VAR with over 100 sign and ranking restrictions to identify 8 structural shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 大型 VAR 越来越多地用于结构分析，作为同时研究多种结构冲击影响的统一框架。然而，使用符号和排序限制同时识别多个冲击提出了重大的实际挑战，现有算法无法与如此大的 VAR 一起使用。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种新的数值高效算法，该算法有助于估计大型结构 VAR 中的脉冲响应和相关措施，该 VAR 被识别为对脉冲响应有大量结构限制。该方法使用具有超过 35 符号和排序限制的 100 变量 VAR 来识别 8 结构性冲击。

records.title_en: Welfare and spending effects of consumption stimulus policies
records.title_cn: 消费刺激政策的福利和支出效应
records.abstract_en: Using a heterogeneous agent model calibrated to match spending dynamics over four years following an income shock (Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)), we assess the effectiveness of three fiscal stimulus policies implemented during recent recessions. Unemployment insurance (UI) extensions are the “bang for the buck” winner when the metric is effectiveness in boosting utility. Stimulus checks are second‐best and have two advantages (over UI): they arrive faster, and are scalable. A temporary (two‐year) cut in wage taxation is considerably less effective than the other policies and has negligible effects in the version of our model without a multiplier.
records.abstract_cn: 使用经过校准以匹配收入冲击后 四 年支出动态的异质代理模型（Fagereng、Holm 和 Natvik (2021)），我们评估了最近经济衰退期间实施的 三 财政刺激政策的有效性。当衡量提高效用的有效性时，失业保险（UI）延期是“物有所值”的赢家。刺激检查是第二最好的，并且具有二优势（相对于UI）：它们到达速度更快，并且可扩展。临时（二年）削减工资税的效果远低于其他政策，并且在我们没有乘数的模型版本中的影响可以忽略不计。

records.title_en: The general solution to an autoregressive law of motion
records.title_cn: 自回归运动定律的通解
records.abstract_en: We provide a complete description of the set of all solutions to a vector autoregressive law of motion. Every solution is shown to be the sum of three components, each corresponding to a directed flow of time. One component flows forward from the arbitrarily distant past, one flows backward from the arbitrarily distant future, and one flows outward from time zero. The three components are obtained by applying three complementary spectral projections to the solution, these corresponding to a separation of the eigenvalues of the autoregressive coefficient matrix according to whether they are inside, outside, or on the unit circle. We establish a one‐to‐one correspondence between the set of all solutions and a finite‐dimensional space of initial conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了向量自回归运动定律的所有解集的完整描述。每个解决方案都显示为 三 分量的总和，每个分量对应于有向时间流。 一分量从任意遥远的过去向前流动，一从任意遥远的未来向后流动，一从时间零向外流动。 三 分量是通过将 三 互补谱投影应用于解而获得的，这些投影对应于根据自回归系数矩阵的特征值是在单位圆内部、外部还是在单位圆上进行的分离。我们在所有解的集合和初始条件的有限维空间之间建立了一到一的对应关系。

records.title_en: A new approach to the analysis of cooperation under the shadow of the future: Theory and experimental evidence
records.title_cn: 未来阴影下合作分析的新方法：理论和实验证据
records.abstract_en: The theory of infinitely repeated games may lack predictive power due to its insensitivity to, for example, changes in some game parameters, the timing of players' moves, and communication possibilities. We propose a new approach by studying an infinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma game and its variants where preferences for cooperation are heterogeneous, and strategic risk arises from incomplete information about opponents' preferences. Our model generates a rich set of comparative static predictions in a variety of settings. We show that, unlike standard theory and other existing models, our approach organizes the findings of a host of experiments including our novel experiments.
records.abstract_cn: 无限重复游戏的理论可能缺乏预测能力，因为它对某些游戏参数的变化、玩家移动的时间和通信可能性等不敏感。我们通过研究无限重复的囚徒困境博弈及其变体，提出了一种新方法，其中合作偏好是异质的，并且战略风险来自对手偏好的不完整信息。我们的模型在各种设置下生成一组丰富的比较静态预测。我们表明，与标准理论和其他现有模型不同，我们的方法组织了许多实验的结果，包括我们的新颖实验。

records.title_en: Three reasons to price carbon under uncertainty: Accuracy of simple rules
records.title_cn: 三 在不确定性下对碳定价的原因：简单规则的准确性
records.abstract_en: An easy‐to‐interpret rule for the optimal risk‐adjusted social cost of carbon is derived using perturbation analysis. This rule internalizes the adverse effects of global warming on the risk of recurring climate‐related disasters, the risk of irreversible cascading climate tipping points, and the usual effect on total factor productivity. It and its three components approximate the true numerical optimum well, especially if the small parameters (i.e., the share of damages in GDP, the sensitivity of the risk of disasters to temperature and the risk of climate tipping) are small enough and the discount rate is not too small. The rule is also accurate if applied to AK models with a different supply side, for example, with ongoing technical progress in fossil‐fuel production or multiple economic sectors. With a growth‐adjusted discount rate of 2%/year, the SCC is $172/tCO2, 70% of which is due to recurring climate disasters and 9% to climate tipping risk.
records.abstract_cn: 使用扰动分析得出了一个易于解释的最佳碳风险调整社会成本规则。这一规则内化了全球变暖对气候相关灾害反复发生的风险、不可逆转的级联气候临界点的风险以及对全要素生产率的通常影响的不利影响。它及其三成分很好地逼近了真实的数值最优值，特别是如果小参数（即损害在GDP中所占的份额、灾害风险对温度的敏感性以及气候倾斜风险）足够小并且贴现率不太小的话。如果应用于具有不同供应方的 AK 模型，例如化石燃料生产或多个经济部门不断取得技术进步，该规则也是准确的。按增长调整贴现率为 2%/年，SCC 为 $172/tCO2，其中 70% 归因于反复发生的气候灾害，9% 归因于气候倾斜风险。

records.title_en: Measuring inflation expectations: How the response scale shapes density forecasts
records.title_cn: 衡量通胀预期：响应规模如何影响密度预测
records.abstract_en: In density forecasts, respondents are asked to assign probabilities to a response scale with pre‐specified ranges of inflation. In two large‐scale experiments, one conducted in the US and one in Germany, we show how the specifics of the response scale determine the results: Shifting, compressing, or expanding the scale leads to shifted, compressed, and expanded forecasts. Quantifying this effect using the scale most widely used among central banks, we find that mean forecast, uncertainty, and disagreement can vary by several percentage points. Density forecasts may severely misestimate the “true” inflation expectations, and may generate spurious changes in reported inflation uncertainty. The analysis suggests several ways to reduce this bias.
records.abstract_cn: 在密度预测中，受访者被要求将概率分配给具有预先指定的通货膨胀范围的响应规模。在二在美国和一在美国和一进行的大规模实验中，我们展示了响应规模的细节如何决定结果：移动、压缩或扩大规模会导致移动、压缩和扩大预测。使用央行最广泛使用的量表来量化这种影响，我们发现平均预测、不确定性和分歧可能会存在几个百分点的差异。密度预测可能会严重误估“真实”通胀预期，并可能在报告的通胀不确定性中产生虚假变化。分析提出了几种减少这种偏见的方法。

records.title_en: Profits of Prejudiced Algorithms
records.title_cn: 偏见算法的利润
records.abstract_en: Firms are starting to replace humans with algorithms in important screening decisions, but there are potential spillovers of human biases contained in datasets to subsequent algorithmic predictions. When these biases are motivated by human prejudices, there are risks of algorithms perpetuating discrimination. I prove that when datasets are generated by a sufficiently discriminatory human, firms are more profitable when training discriminatory algorithms. If instead enough affirmative action is instituted in favor of a disadvantaged group, firms are more profitable when training algorithms that inflate scores for this group, but this effect diminishes with excess affirmative action.
records.abstract_cn: 公司开始在重要的筛选决策中用算法替代人类，但数据集中包含的人类偏见可能对后续的算法预测产生潜在的溢出效应。当这些偏见源于人类的偏见时，算法可能会延续歧视。我证明，当数据集是由一个足够歧视的人生成时，公司在训练歧视性算法时更有利可图。如果相反，针对弱势群体实施了足够的平权行动，公司在训练为该群体提高分数的算法时更有利可图，但这种效果在过度平权行动下会减弱。

records.title_en: When Is Discrimination Unfair?
records.title_cn: 何时歧视是不公平的？
records.abstract_en: We use a vignette-based survey experiment to elicit respondents’ assessments of the fairness of race-based hiring decisions and compare these assessments with the predictions of four preregistered ethical frameworks. While conservative respondents are much more accepting of discriminatory actions than others, respondents of all political leanings rate the relative fairness of different actions in a very similar way. A two-group framework in which one group (mostly self-described conservatives) values employers’ decision rights, the other has utilitarian concerns, and both groups use the same race-blind rules to assign relative fairness levels to actions explains our data well.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用基于情境的调查实验来引导受访者评估基于种族的招聘决策的公平性，并将这些评估与四预注册伦理框架的预测进行比较。虽然保守派受访者对歧视性行为的接受程度远高于其他人，但所有政治倾向的受访者对不同行为的相对公平性评估非常相似。一个二群体框架，其中一群体（主要是自我描述为保守派的人）重视雇主的决策权，另一个则关注功利主义，两组都使用相同的无种族规则来为行为分配相对公平性水平，能够很好地解释我们的数据。

records.title_en: Gene-Environment Complementarity in Educational Attainment
records.title_cn: 教育成就中的基因-环境互补性
records.abstract_en: Firstborns, on average, complete more education than laterborns. We study whether individuals’ endowments measured by genetic information amplify this effect. Our family fixed effects approach exploits exogenous variation in birth order and genetic endowments among 14,850 siblings in the UK Biobank. We find that those with higher genetic endowments benefit disproportionately more from being firstborn compared with those with lower endowments—a clean example of how nature and nurture interact in producing human capital. Since parental investments are a dominant channel driving birth order effects, our results are consistent with complementarity between endowments and investments in human capital formation.
